izzyondroid:jorgeff99.keymyinfo.name: KeyCip
izzyondroid:jorgeff99.keymyinfo.summary: encrypt, decrypt and sign data using RSA and AES
izzyondroid:jorgeff99.keymyinfo.description:
We are all aware that our online information is treated as little more than a commodity. In fact, we have naturalised the heavy fines that the big tech giants receive for abusive use of our data. Nevertheless, I strongly believe that our information belongs to us.
 However, it seems that our hands and feet are tied. Social networks, instant messaging applications or cloud storage are present in our personal and working lives. With it, so is the data we send to these tools, which are monitored by large corporations. Therefore, creating a replacement for each of them seems like an arduous task considering the number of them and the development time it would require.
 The latter leaves us with the only solution: control the information that we share, deciding who can access it. But how is that possible? The truth is that encryption algorithms have been around for 500 years, performing the tasks of encrypting and decrypting information.
 So, if there is already a solution, what is the purpose of this application? First of all, you may have been scared when you heard encryption algorithm, don’t worry, you are not alone. KeyCip comes to your rescue
 KeyCip is an application that allows you to encrypt, decrypt, sign and verify signatures of text, photos, videos and other files using RSA and AES algorithms. Complicated? The application’s greatest virtue is that it has been designed with the aim of making the interface and the whole workflow as simple as possible - so that you don’t even need to learn complex security skills!
 What does encrypt mean? 
 To encrypt a text, photo, video or document means to hide its content so that only a specific person can know this information, thus ensuring that when the encrypted text, photo, video or document is sent, its content remains confidential.
 What does decryption mean? 
Decrypting a text, photo, video or document is the reverse of encrypting, in other words, the original content is returned to the encrypted file by a certain process.
 What does it mean to sign? 
 Signing a text, photograph, video or document is similar to signing a letter. The content of the text or file is not changed or hidden but allows the recipient to confirm that the person who sent it to them is indeed the person they claim to be.
 Again, the application will guide you through the whole process. In addition, you can also visit our Youtube channel where you will find guides, in case you have any doubts.
 Wait, we have one last surprise. KeyCip has its own keyboard with which text encryption and decryption operations can be used from any application. This way, you can have a private conversation with your friend, partner or family member without even leaving the social network or instant messaging application you are using.
 The best part about the application? It is an open source project, so don’t hesitate to collaborate and do your bit to improve it.

fdroid:com.supershopaholic.name: SuperShopaholic
fdroid:com.supershopaholic.summary: An infinite shopping cart in an infinite mall: a satire on consumerism
fdroid:com.supershopaholic.description:
SuperShopaholic is a tiny game that is really a sociopolitical statement about
the pointlessness of consumerism. You steer an infinite shopping cart through
an infinite mall, frantically swooping goods off the shelves into a cart that
never fills.
There is no finish line. There never was.
The "rewards" are the joke: you grind to unlock the ability to consume faster,
and the prizes are absurd status symbols that, once bought, change nothing.
Mechanics:
* Grab everything. Emoji products fall down the mall; catch them for cash.
* Power-ups are the fantasy. Grab a GOLD card or a rarer BLACK card to shop
 faster with a 2x / 4x money multiplier. The reward for consuming is the
 ability to consume harder.
* Status symbols. Periodic BUY NOW events offer a Ferrari, Yacht, Mansion or
 Private Jet. Buy it and it joins your trophy shelf, and then absolutely
 nothing changes. You keep shopping.
* A STATUS meter fills up and, as the game helpfully notes, it doesn't do
 anything.
* No win state. The speed only ever increases.
Controls: tap or drag to move the cart. A hardware keyboard works too
(left/right or A/D, P to pause).
Technical notes:
* Fully offline. The app requests no permissions and makes no network
 connections. The whole game is a single self-contained HTML page bundled in
 the app and rendered in a WebView (HTML5 canvas, vanilla JavaScript, Web
 Audio for synthesized sound effects; no audio assets, no tracking, no ads).
This game critiques the enclosure of things; its license resists the enclosure
of itself. SuperShopaholic is free software under the GNU Affero General Public
License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0-or-later). The AGPL's network clause means anyone who
hosts a modified version must also share their source with players. Source is
always one click away: https://gitlab.com/jave/supershopaholic

fdroid:com.yash.xpenc.name: XPENC
fdroid:com.yash.xpenc.summary: Offline expense tracker — accounts, budgets, dues and insights, all on-device
fdroid:com.yash.xpenc.description:
XPENC is a personal finance app that keeps every rupee on your phone. There is no server, no account to create and no ads — your transactions live in a private database on your device and never leave it. Release builds do not even request the INTERNET permission, so transmitting your data is technically impossible.
 Honest numbers. Most expense apps blur where money sits with what it was for. XPENC keeps them apart and enforces one rule everywhere: net worth equals the sum of your account balances. A transfer between your own accounts leaves it unchanged, income raises it, expense lowers it.
 Accounts — Cash, Bank and Card with real balances. Debit cards and UPI are linked instruments that spend their bank's money, so a payment is never counted twice. Credit cards carry their own balance.
 Income, Expense, Transfer — three transaction types kept strictly apart. Transfers never pollute budgets or reports.
 Budgets — per-category budgets with period windows, live progress, and alerts at 80% and on overspend.
 Dues and loans — track what people owe you and what you owe them, with partial settlements and running balances. Lending is not spending, so dues stay out of your budgets.
 Calendar — a day-wise money-in / money-out grid, plus EMI and bill reminders that post nothing until you confirm them.
 Insights — category breakdown, income vs expense, net-worth trend and per-account reports.
 Backup and export — one-tap JSON backup and restore, plus CSV export shaped for accountants.
 True-black design — a clean, monochrome Material 3 interface that is easy on AMOLED screens and on the eyes.
 Private by architecture. Fully offline, no sign-up, no cloud, no analytics, no trackers, no ads. Every runtime permission is optional and asked only when you use the feature that needs it: notifications for budget alerts and reminders, camera for "Take photo" on a receipt, and contacts only if you tap "Pick from contacts" when adding a person — and even then, only the one contact you pick is ever read. Backups are files you create and keep — you decide where they go.
 Accurate by design. All money math is done in whole paise, never floating point, so totals are always exact.
 XPENC is free software under the MIT license.

fdroid:io.github.gplaider.keliboard.description:
KeliBoard is a modern, actively maintained HeliBoard fork focused on stability, usability, and first-class language support.
It is privacy-conscious, fully open source, and works offline without the internet permission.
Optional recent screenshot suggestions are off by default. Enabling this feature requests access to all images on your device (storage access on Android 12 and earlier), although only recent screenshots are suggested. Selected-photo access alone is not sufficient. Images are processed locally; KeliBoard has no internet permission.
Highlights:
 Fixes for long-standing keyboard, composition, emoji, and spacing issues
 First-class Korean support, including Cheonjiin and Korean QWERTY layouts
 Customizable layouts, themes, colors, icons, fonts, and background images
 Dictionaries for suggestions and spell checking
 Multilingual typing
 Clipboard history
 One-handed and split keyboard modes
 Number pad
 Backup and restore for settings and learned data
Korean is a flagship feature, not the limit of the project. KeliBoard remains a general-purpose keyboard for HeliBoard users in every language.
KeliBoard is based on HeliBoard, which is based on AOSP and OpenBoard. Upstream attribution and licenses are preserved.

fdroid:io.github.jtrv.quickword.description:
QuickWord answers "what does this word mean" with the least possible
interruption: select a word in any app, tap QuickWord in the text-selection
menu, and the definition appears as a notification. No app switch, and it
works offline.
Features:
• Lookup from any app's text-selection menu or share sheet
• Notification actions: Thesaurus (swaps to synonyms in place), Open, Save
• 1.4 million words from the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA), fully offline
• Wikipedia fallback for names and places (with attribution), with an
 optional offline pack of the 50,000 most-read articles
• Serif-typeset word pages, prefix search, recents and favourites
• Pronunciation (IPA + text-to-speech)
• No ads, no tracking, no accounts. MIT licensed.
Only a handful of sample words are bundled. The full dictionary (~120 MB)
downloads when you tap Download on the home screen, once; on a metered
connection the app asks first and offers to wait for Wi-Fi. Until then, words
outside the sample still resolve through the Wikipedia fallback when online.
The offline Wikipedia pack (38 MB) is optional; get it from About → Storage &
data.

fdroid:site.leos.setter.name: Setter - A multi-purpose search app for Android
fdroid:site.leos.setter.summary: A meta-search, reverse image search and translator tool packed in one package.
fdroid:site.leos.setter.description:
What is Setter? 
 A setter in volleyball game is a critical player who play the role of building up offensive opportunities by passing the ball to hitters for final scoring. This app, Setter, is the same kind of player when it comes to information searching on Android devices.
 Setter is a meta-search tool, reverse image search tool and translator tool all packed in the same package. Setter will try every possible way to help you pass your query to as many search providers as you can wish for. It can serve as a system-wide assistant app or can be launched by using widget or in selected text context menu.
 What can Setter do? 
 Setter can help you with the following:
 Search for the selected text in multiple search engines all at the same time. Currently support search in two user customized web page search engines, twitter, reddit, Chinese Wechat and Chinese Weibo
 Reverse search for a image file or a image link shared to Setter app, using search engine Google, Bing, Yandex and Chinese Sogou
 Translate selected text in a popup window provided by local installed dictionary app ColorDict, or pass the text to online translator including DeepL, Google Translator and UrbanDictorary
 Multiple search engines for you to choose from as the primary global search engine and specialized local search enginen. Support switching among various searching engines on the fly by long click on it's tab title area
 Privacy focus 
 Setter use Android system webview a lot and it make sure Geolocation API is turned off and MetricsOptOut turned on to prevent leaking browsing data to Google.
 When doing reverse image search, Setter will resize the image to a low resolution and strip off EXIF data before upload it to the search engines. Setter will also rename the file to a generic name.
 Setter support and promot search engines which respect user's privacy, like DuckDuckGo, StartPage and Swisscows. Setter also support and recommend using a local dictionary app to guard your reading habit from leaking.

All-in-one security app

Manage your security in one place
▪ Check the security status of your family’s devices and identity[5].
▪ Get threat alerts, notifications, and recommended steps across your devices.
▪ Receive security tips and take recommended actions to improve your online security.
Safeguard your family’s personal information
▪ Threats to your identity and personal identifying information[4] are continuously scanned on the dark web.
▪ Get credit monitoring with timely alerts and monthly credit reports.[6]
▪ Call an identity theft restoration expert anytime day or night if you need help.

FEATURES
• Measure your heart rate in just 8 seconds using only your finger and the camera.

DISCLAIMER
Instant Pulse measures your heart rate accurately but is not a certified medical device and should not be used for medical diagnosis or treatment.
Normal resting heart rate for adults ranges from 60 to 100 beats per minute.
Consult your doctor if your resting heart rate is consistently above 100 beats per minute (tachycardia), or if you are not a trained athlete and your resting heart rate is consistently below 60 beats per minute (bradycardia) — especially if accompanied by symptoms such as fainting, dizziness, or shortness of breath.

Switch to live wind radar to watch animated streams sweep across the country, or live rain radar to trace precipitation as it tracks toward your locations. Scrub the timeline to replay the last few hours or look ahead — look-ahead availability varies by region. Pan, zoom, and tap any pin for full details.

Runs Everywhere
Native on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Adaptive layouts use the full screen on iPad with a sidebar and side-by-side views. iCloud sync keeps your saved locations consistent across all devices.
Units Your Way
Choose Celsius or Fahrenheit, km/h, mph, knots or m/s for wind, hPa or inHg for pressure, and mm or inches for rainfall.

 Zeiten“, „Myranor“, und dazu die Spielhilfen „Wege der Alchimie“, „Von Toten und Untoten“, „Elementare
 Gewalten“ und weitere, sowie einige Regelerweiterungen aus verschiedenen Aventurischen Boten, Abenteuern und
 die halboffizielle Spielhilfe zu Professionen aus „Unter dem Westwind“.
 Das Programm ist nur sinnvoll nutzbar, wenn ihr über die Regelwerke verfügt und Kenntnisse der Regeln habt.
 Blutigen Anfänger raten wir, dass sie sich von einem erfahrenen Spieler helfen lassen.
 Mit Helden-Online besteht die Möglichkeit, seine Helden online zu speichern und von unterwegs Zugriff auf sie
 zu haben.
 Die Funktionen der Helden-Software können durch verschiedene Plugins erweitert und die Ausdrucke der
 Heldenbögen mit eigenen Hintergründen verschönert werden.
 Dieses Produkt wurde unter Lizenz erstellt. Das Schwarze Auge und seine Logos sind eingetragene Marken
 sowie Aventuria, Dere, Myranor, Riesland, Tharun, Uthuria, The Dark Eye und ihre Logos sind eingetragene
 Marken von Ulisses Medien und Spiele Distribution GmbH in Deutschland, den U.S.A. und anderen Ländern.
 Ulisses Spiele und seine Logos sind eingetragene Marken der Ulisses Medien und Spiel Distribution GmbH.

fedora-packages:blosc2/blosc2.name: blosc2
fedora-packages:blosc2/blosc2.summary: High performance compressor optimized for binary data
fedora-packages:blosc2/blosc2.description: Blosc is a high performance compressor optimized for binary data (i.e. floating-point numbers, integers, and booleans, although it can handle string data too). It has been designed to transmit data to the processor cache faster than the traditional, non-compressed, direct memory fetch approach via a memcpy() OS call. Blosc main goal is not just to reduce the size of large datasets on-disk or in-memory, but also to accelerate memory-bound computations. C-Blosc2 is the new major version of C-Blosc, and is backward compatible with both the C-Blosc1 API and its in-memory format. However, the reverse thing is generally not true for the format; buffers generated with C-Blosc2 are not format-compatible with C-Blosc1.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension for turning plain URLs and email addresses into links.

blockmaxxing removes ads from Twitch — including the stream-level (server-side inserted) ads that ordinary blockers can't touch — entirely on your device.
Twitch stitches ads directly into the video stream, so simply hiding an element or blocking a URL doesn't work. blockmaxxing runs inside the player, detects the ad-stitched segments in the stream playlist, and swaps in an ad-free stream.
FEATURES
• Stream-level (SSAI) ad removal — the approach that actually works on Twitch
• Toolbar badge showing how many ads were blocked on the current tab
• Per-channel whitelist — support your favorite streamers by letting their ads play
• Optional "mute during ad swap" to avoid any ad audio
• Optional on-device diagnostics you can inspect and export
• Works on Chrome and Edge
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No backend, no analytics, no accounts
• No data ever leaves your device
• Talks only to Twitch's own APIs
• Open source (MIT) — read every line
HONEST NOTE
No Twitch ad blocker is perfect. Twitch changes how it serves ads frequently, so occasional ads may appear until the extension is updated. blockmaxxing blocks the large majority of ads and is designed to update quickly.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Twitch Interactive, Inc.

firefox-addons:583040.name: masterpassword for Firefox
firefox-addons:583040.summary:
Keep different passwords for every site you log into without having to remember anything but a single master password. And without the risk of your getting your password list stolen. 
MasterPassword is available for all your devices!
firefox-addons:583040.description:
One of todays main security challenges on the web is passwords. You typically have to login at many different sites, and remembering a different password for every site is hard. Unfortunately one of the sites you use will sooner or later be hacked, and passwords leaked. If that password is reused on other sites, the hackers will have access to all your accounts.
MasterPassword can help. With one master password, a unique one can be generated for each site. When you need to login, this addon will complete the site password for you. And it is impossible to guess the master password from a site password. Read more at 
 masterpasswordapp.com 
The MasterPassword algorithm is standardized. You can find app's for Ios, Android, Windows, Mac and Linux.
One of MasterPasswords strong points is that neither the master or site password is stored anywhere. The site password is rather generated mathematically every time. This is in clear contrast to many other password managers, like Firefox' built in password manager. If your computer or browser is hacked, solutions where the password is stored can give away all your passwords! Similar dangers exists with cloud based solutions .
The MasterPassword addon can of course co exist with other password managers and will stay out of your way until you click the MasterPassword button. If you chose to uninstall the addon, you'll just have to remember the passwords you've generated, or import them into another password manager.
Since passwords in MasterPassword are mathematically generated, it is impossible to import other custom passwords into master password. They would have to be stored on your computer, which defeats MasterPassword's working principle. As such, it is convenient to use the Firefox password manager for such passwords, until you find a time to switch a site to MasterPassword.
Also note that when MasterPassword enters a password for you, Firefox will behave like you typed it on the keyboard, and prompt you if you want to save it. You can of course accept this, but your passwords will then be stored and risk being stolen. I'd therefore suggest to reject that offer.
Protect your accounts on the web - Use MasterPassword

firefox-addons:2979704.name: Password Autofill Defocus
firefox-addons:2979704.summary: Defocuses password fields after auto-fill on HTTP pages, preventing Firefox's insecure login warning from blocking the login button.
firefox-addons:2979704.description:
When password managers like Bitwarden auto-fill credentials on HTTP pages, Firefox shows an "This connection is not secure" warning popup over the password field. This warning often covers the login button, causing you to accidentally open a help page instead of logging in.
This extension detects when a password field receives focus from auto-fill (rather than a user click) and moves focus to the form's submit button. This dismisses the warning and lets you press Enter to log in immediately.
Features:
- Works automatically on all HTTP pages by default
- Distinguishes between auto-fill focus and manual user interaction
- Optional whitelist mode to restrict to specific sites
- Wildcard pattern matching for site URLs

firefox-addons:899849.name: Save Tab URLs
firefox-addons:899849.summary: Show, save and restore the page URLs along with page Titles of all opened tabs of current browser window. Show as copyable plaintext. Save and restore from text file.
firefox-addons:899849.description:
Usage 
The new [ST] toolbar button will appear after installation
Click on that [ST] button.
Ensure all required tabs are loaded - newest Firefox versions do not load them automatically on the start.
Reload absent tabs manually if they are absent and required.
There will appear window with the text of URLs and page Titles listed there.
Then you can edit text there, save, copy the list text into clipboard, etc.
 Reopen: 
You can paste there URLs list saved earlier and click [Open...] 
Saved titles and other non-URLs will be ignored and not opened.
 Features: 
 Show URLs with Titles of all tabs of current browser window as plain text.
 Save this text into a text file.
 Copy this text into clipboard.
 Edit the text in place and copy edited version.
 Paste new URLs into the text field and open all new URLs at once.
URLs currently opened in tabs will be skipped.
Write me in reviews if there will be problems.
Please leave positive feedback if you like this Extension, thanks!
 Later added Note about loading and saving all tabs :
"Save Tab URLs" addon saves all loaded tab URLs and Titles, and if you close and open Firefox, the Firefox starting with version 47 [2], will not load all tabs automatically on the start.
This is declared Firefox behavior, which done by intention of browser developers to not slow down the whole browser starting process.
So the required tabs are need to be manually loaded in case you want to save their 
URL+Titles. This is browser limitation.
This utility addon does not interfere into user relations with his/her browser, allowing 
that freedom of interaction.
In case you need to save all present tabs in any case - Solution exists for that too. 
This way is to force the browser to load all tabs on the startup[1]. Be informed that this will slow down the overall browser start process.
[1] https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/allow-firefox-load-multiple-tabs-background 
Allow Firefox to load multiple tabs in the background
[2] https://superuser.com/questions/1086541/how-do-i-make-firefox-47-load-all-my-tabs-on-startup

Simply add this add-on to your browser and click on the - Reload All Tabs - toolbar icon. All open tabs will be reloaded upon clicking on the toolbar button.

+ Add music to your video

bluejetty:00161904:ios.description:
Ever wished for a streaming platform that screened EVERY single video to make sure it lines up with Islam? So did we. That's exactly why Durioo+ exists, built by the same team behind Omar & Hana, for every Muslim family who wants a screen they can actually trust.
Durioo+ has a free tier, so no Muslim child misses out on safe content because of their family's budget. And when you subscribe, every cent goes straight back into creating more halal, Islamic content designed to nurture an Ummah rooted in Iman, Akhlaq, and Ilm. That's why we count every subscription as Sadaqah Jariyah, a reward that keeps growing long after you've paid. Omar & Hana was the start. Muslim children everywhere deserve more, and your subscription helps us build it.
WHY PARENTS CHOOSE DURIOO+
Every Video Vetted: Reviewed by our content team and a Shariah consultant, so nothing on screen goes against our values. No misinformation, ever.
Learn Or Just Relax: STEM, ABCs, 123s, cooking, Islamic studies, the Sunnah, Quran, Duas, Arabic and more. Perfect for unwinding or learning something new.
Watch On Your TV: Durioo+ is now on Samsung, LG, Android TV, Apple TV, Roku, Xiaomi, Google TV, and other Google-certified devices, plus your phone, tablet, and computer.
Multiple Languages: Content in English, Bahasa Melayu, and Bahasa Indonesia, with a growing library in Arabic too.
DuDeen: Turn memorizing Surahs and Duas into something kids actually look forward to.
DuMinis: Short episodes between videos that teach a lesson and give your child's brain a break from the screen, built to help prevent screen addiction, not feed it.
Fast-Paced Content Switch: Turn off overstimulating, fast-cut videos with one tap. Keep only calm, steady content on screen.
Vocal-Only Filter: Strip out music and keep only vocal content, for families who prefer it that way.
Screen Time Limits: Set daily limits that fit your family's routine.
Channel Blocking: Don't like a channel? Block it in seconds.
Age-Restricted Profiles: Give each child a profile built for their age.
Locked Parent Profile: Keep grown-up settings out of little hands.
Watch Offline: Download shows for flights and car rides, and stream on several screens at once.
Parents tell us Durioo+ has calmed tantrums, especially in younger kids, and that their children now remind them to do dhikr. That's the impact we built this for.
To access all features and content, subscribe to Durioo+: Muslim Family Content on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and is confirmed before purchase in the app.
Terms of Service: https://my.duriooplus.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://my.duriooplus.com/privacy
*Payments are charged through your Apple ID account and can be managed in Account Settings after your initial payment. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited once a paid subscription begins. Cancel anytime by turning off auto-renewal.

bluejetty:00145621:ios.description:
Tired of waiting in the cold and wondering when your bus will arrive? LTC Live puts real-time bus schedules for the London Transit Commission (LTC) right in your pocket.
Using live data from LTC's WebWatch system, you get up-to-the-minute arrival times for the buses you care about most. Our app uses your location to show you nearby stops and your saved favorites, so you have the information you need, right when you need it.
Key Features
• Real-Time Bus Tracking: Get live arrival times directly from the LTC WebWatch system.
• Location-Aware Favorites: See arrival times for your closest favorite bus stops with a single tap.
• Comprehensive Search: Easily search all LTC WebWatch schedules to find any stop or route.
• Simple & Intuitive: A clean interface designed for quick and easy use.
Help Us Improve
We're constantly working to make LTC Live better. Please rate the app and leave a comment with your feedback. You can also email us directly with any suggestions or issues.
LTC Live is an independent application and is not affiliated with the London Transit Commission.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00120115:ios.description:
Kids, are you ready to become the bravest firefighters? Our Fire Truck Games for Kids are calling you to embark on an exciting adventure! Specially designed for little heroes under 5 years old, this game turns the fantasy of firefighting into an immersive reality.
Imagine racing to a fire scene with one of six unique fire trucks at your disposal! You'll traverse through a variety of dynamic game scenes, spraying water to extinguish the raging flames. This fire truck game for kids is packed with thrills, and it just might become your new favorite game.
When the fire bell rings, the action begins! The sirens blare, firefighters rush to the station, and Dinosaur Island's inhabitants are counting on you. Don't hesitate - jump on your fire truck and speed towards the rescue!
In this game, you're not just playing; you're the brave dinosaur firefighter! Navigate your fire truck through challenging obstacles to reach your destination. Use your water gun to douse the fire, rescue trapped dinosaurs and their little friends! With our Fire Truck Games for Kids, every game session becomes an epic rescue mission!
Easy game controls, quick downloads, and an accessible pass mode ensure a smooth gaming experience. As they play and succeed, your kids will experience the pride of becoming a hero!
Our Fire Truck Games for Kids provide:
• Six distinct fire trucks to choose from
• Interactive episodes, beautifully designed
• Perfect for preschool children, aged 0-5 years
• Completely free from third-party advertising
Answer the call to be a hero! Join us at Yateland, creators of engaging and educational apps that inspire preschoolers across the globe to learn through play. Together, let's experience the joy of becoming firefighters! Discover more about Yateland and our delightful apps at https://yateland.com. Remember, with Yateland, you're choosing apps that children love and parents trust.

bluejetty:00026617:ios.summary:

Create a free account and get an extra $3 off your next eligible ref
bluejetty:00026617:ios.description:
Paying for prescriptions shouldn’t be painful. Join the millions saving billions with SingleCare, the prescription savings card that saves you up to 80% at the pharmacy! 
Create a free account and get an extra $3 off your next eligible refill, plus earn additional bonus savings throughout the year.
Prescription drug prices are rising. Life-saving medications can cost thousands of dollars. If you can’t afford your medications (or simply want to save big on prescriptions), use the SingleCare app to get free coupons that work at all major pharmacies. Whether it’s insulin for diabetes or an asthma inhaler, you can find a free coupon using the SingleCare mobile app or on SingleCare.com.
SingleCare is a prescription savings card (aka a “coupon card”) that provides discounts on 10,000+ prescribed drugs for a sign-up price of $0. It’s always 100% free to use the card. Whether you’re insured, underinsured, or uninsured, you qualify for a reduced rate on prescriptions with SingleCare and our accurate drug pricing tool helps you find low prices on thousands of FDA-approved medications.
Stop overpaying for your prescriptions and start using our free Rx coupons at your local drugstore. 
Try SingleCare in 3 simple steps:
1. Search for your prescriptions on the free SingleCare app
2. Compare discounts at nearby pharmacies and get a free coupon card
3. Show your coupon card at the pharmacy counter to save up to 80% on your medication
Remember, you can always use the card again for your next refill!
SingleCare Features: 
$0 User Fee:
• With a prescription from a medical professional, you can get SingleCare prescription savings cards for free.
• All customers at participating pharmacies can use our prescription drug coupons
• It doesn’t matter if you’re a doctor, nurse, patient, pharmacist—if you take medication, we have coupons for you.
• There are no strict eligibility requirements or limited-time offers.
Loyalty Program:
• Sign up for our free loyalty program providing access to lower cost medication.
• Receive an extra $3 off your next eligible prescription fill when you join!
Easy Refills:
• Reuse coupon cards on every refill.
Prescription Discount Finder:
Enter your zip code on the app to find a participating pharmacy near you. We partner directly with thousands of major pharmacies nationwide, including:
• CVS
• CVS Pharmacy at Target
• Walmart
• Walgreens
• Kroger
• Albertsons
• Rite Aid
• Longs Drugs
• Sav-On Pharmacy
• Fry’s
• Harris Teeter
• Wegmans
• H-E-B
• Meijer
More ways to save:
1. Ask for a prescription - To use our coupons, a medical care professional must prescribe the medication. You can still save money on vitamins, natural health supplements, and over-the-counter medicine as long as you have a script for it!
2. Go generic - Generic meds are cheaper than brand names. Ask your healthcare provider if a generic version of your prescription is available.
3. Buy in bulk - Fewer refills = fewer copays. Fill a 90-day supply instead of a 30-day supply to save more in the long run.
4. Shop around - Enter the drug name and dosage on our app, and enter your zip code to compare costs at local pharmacies. If you don’t see your exact med on the app, you can still take our prescription drug discount card to the pharmacy and they can look up if there is a SingleCare offer available.
SingleCare has been featured on CNN, Wall Street Journal, Business Insider, Healthline, Yahoo! Finance and Bustle. Start saving on your prescriptions today!
By downloading SingleCare, you agree to be bound by our Terms and Conditions found at https://www.singlecare.com/terms-and-conditions.

bluejetty:00069803:ios.description:
● 다양한 이체 기능을 담았어요.
 - 자주사용하는 계좌에서의 이체는 화면이동을 최소화 했어요.
 - 연락처이체, 더치페이, 사진찍어이체하기 등 보다 편하게 
 이체 할 수 있는 다양한 기능을 담았어요.
 - 보다 안전하게 이체할 수 있도록 사기계좌조회 기능을 넣었어요.
● 내가 보유한 금융자산과, 나의 소비 현황을 한눈에 볼 수 있어요.
 - "나" 중심으로 서비스를 개편하여, 내가 보유한 계좌 목록, 
 나의 자산 현황, 나의 소비현황을 편리하게 확인할 수 있어요.
 - 중요한 금융일정은 알림으로, 자산은 다양한 분석정보로, 
 소비는 매일 쉽게 관리할 수 있도록 서비스를 개편했어요.
● 우리금융그룹 상품, 서비스를 한눈에 한번에 사용할 수 있어요.
 - 카드/캐피탈/증권/저축은행의 다양한 상품과 서비스를 조회부터 가입까지 우리WON뱅킹으로 편하게 사용해보세요.
● 기업뱅킹을 설치하지 않아도, 개인사업자용 상품/서비스도 제공해 드려요.
 - 사장님 전용 통장, 대출 상품 가입도 우리WON뱅킹에서 한번에 처리 가능해요.
 - 다양한 정책지원 서비스도 함께 준비했어요.
● 복잡한 금융상품 가입절차, 여러 번에 나눠서 진행 가능해요.
 - 상품가입 중 다른 일이 생겨 로그아웃 되더라도 걱정하지 마세요.
 앞서 입력했던 단계를 다시 진행하지 않아도, 이어서 진행할 수 있어요.
● 맞춤형 생활금융 서비스를 받아보세요.
 - 자녀분의 금융생활시작 위한 우리아이, 
 10대 전용 우리틴틴, 20대 전용 스무살 우리, 
 직장인을 위한 우리직장인셀럽, 시니어를 위한 시니어W클래스 등
● 고객센터 운영 시간 안내
 - 업무상담시간 : 평일 09:00 ~ 18:00
 - 텔레뱅킹 ARS 업무 및 사고신고 : 24시간
● 고객센터 번호 안내
 - 대표번호 : 1588-5000 / 1599-5000 / 1533-5000
 - 해외 : 82-2-2006-5000
 - 외국인 전용 : 1599-2288
● 접근 권한 안내
우리WON뱅킹 접근 권한에 대하여 아래와 같이 안내드립니다. 허용에 동의하지 않으셔도 앱 사용이 가능합니다.
- 카메라 : 카메라 촬영 기능에 대한 접근 권한으로 신분증 촬영 및 얼굴인증, 편의서비스(공과금 스캔납부, QR코드 인식, 사진찍어 이체하기, 서류제출), 영상상담 시 사용합니다.
- 마이크 : 오디오를 녹음하기 위한 접근 권한으로 영상상담 시 음성인식을 위해 사용합니다.
- 위치 : 기기 위치정보에 대한 접근 권한으로 가까운 영업점 및 ATM 찾기 서비스 이용 시 사용합니다.
- 연락처 : 기기 내 연락처에 대한 접근 권한으로 연락처 이체 시 받는 분 선택 및 더치페이 등의 서비스 이용 시 사용합니다.
- 캘린더 : 휴대폰에 탑재된 캘린더에 대한 접근 권한으로 마이플래너의 일정을 휴대폰 캘린더로 내보내기 위해 사용합니다.
- 사진 : 통장사본 등 이미지 저장, 모임통장 서비스의 프로필 설정하는데 사용합니다.
- Face ID : Face ID를 지원하는 폰에서 우리WON인증서 생체인증을 위해 사용합니다.
● 이용안내
- 우리WON뱅킹은 IOS 15.0 이상의 기기를 사용하셔야 이용이 가능해요.
- 탈옥 등 운영체제가 변조된 단말기에서는 서비스를 이용할 수 없어요.
- 3G/LTE/5G 정액 요금제에서 용량 초과 시 데이터 요금이 부과될 수 있어요.
- 우리은행에서는 고객님의 개인정보나 보안카드 번호 전체를 요구하지 않아요.
● 인증수단 사용 유의사항
- 금융인증서의 패턴 / 생체는 새로워진 우리WON뱅킹에서 사용이 어려워요. PIN을 재등록하여 로그인해주세요.
- 금융회원 고객님께서는 더 이상 간편비밀번호를 통한 로그인이 어려워요. 다른 인증수단으로 로그인해주세요.
고객님의 안전한 자산 보호를 위하여 주의 부탁드립니다.

bluejetty:00037285:ios.description:
Louder Music is an innovative music app designed to create incredible audio experiences using advanced AI technology. Our app combines powerful features like high-definition bass boosting, custom equalizer (EQ) presets, and stunning audio visualizations, all aimed at enhancing the way you listen to music.
Key Features Powered by AI:
AI-Enhanced Equalizer: Our intelligent EQ allows for precise sound customization. AI analyzes your music and automatically suggests optimal frequency adjustments, delivering a richer, more immersive listening experience.
Bass Booster: Using AI-driven algorithms, Louder Music amplifies bass frequencies to their fullest potential without distorting the sound. Feel the depth of your music like never before.
Custom EQ Preset Design: Personalize your audio setup with AI-generated EQ presets tailored to your unique preferences. Whether you prefer deep bass or crisp treble, the app learns your taste and recommends the best settings.
Audio Effects: Add AI-powered effects to your music, from reverb to dynamic sound enhancements, for a truly unique auditory experience.
Louder Music isn't just about listening to music—it's about transforming your music experience using AI technology, giving you full control over how you hear and feel your favorite tracks.
UNLIMITED ACCESS MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTION
–You can subscribe to get unlimited access to all features.
–Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate based on the subscription plan.
–Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
–Subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
–Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan.
–Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
–Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

bluejetty:00120422:ios.description:
An Official US Navy mobile application, produced by MyNavy HR IT Solutions.
The Official Navy PFA (Physical Fitness Assessment) app provides Sailors with all the Physical Readiness Program information they need to maintain optimal health, fitness, and readiness according to Navy standards. The app offers current guidance regarding all aspects of the Navy’s Physical Readiness Program, including information on appropriate nutrition, health, fitness, aerobic capacity, muscular strength, muscular endurance, body fat composition, and the new plank and rower modalities.
The app provides a one-stop shop for all Physical Readiness Program information. Among other features, this app includes the following:
• Program Application Resources, such as a “How to” video library (3-step body composition assessment measurement videos, physical readiness test event videos, and other products), as well as instructions and operating guides based on the OPNAVINST 6110.1 series and associated NAVADMINS.
• Nutrition Resources, including the Naval Operational Fitness and Fueling System (NOFFS) Virtual Meal Builder.
• Command Physical Training (PT) and Fitness Enhancement Program (FEP) Source Information, including an instructor-directed Navy Operational Fitness and Fueling Series (NOFFS) library of 75+ approved Command PT- and FEP-specific workouts. 
• Navy mobile PFA Calculator, which combines the capabilities of all calculators found in the Official Navy PRIMS (Physical Readiness Information Management System) Program
The Navy’s Physical Readiness Program policy establishes requirements to ensure both Active and Reserve personnel maintain the level of physical fitness required to support overall mission readiness. The Official Navy PFA app enables Sailors to confidently prepare to meet these standards as they strive to achieve consistent physical fitness. 
The app is comprehensive, easy to use, and offers public content only -- no authentication/authorization required. Download yours today!

bluejetty:00179166:ios.description:
SecureX is password manager and secure storage of your notes, payment cards, photos and documents. Use our password generator, autofill, sync with cloud storage and other functions for a safe and convenient experience with our password manager. The application interface is simple, friendly and intuitive.
Why are we a secure password manager?
We do not store your master password. Any access to your data is carried out using a unique personal secret key generated based on your master password and stored in iOS keychains. No one else will be able to receive or read this data either during its transmission or in the storage.
We are not responsible for the loss of your data in the event of a device flashing, using jailbreak and similar systems, as well as when restoring a device from a backup without the keychain synchronization option enabled with iCloud.
We guarantee that your personal data is not sent to the network, is not stored or processed on our servers, therefore we provide the ability to use your personal cloud storage for synchronization, thereby eliminating the possibility of access to your data by third parties, while maintaining privacy, simplicity use and the ability to quickly recover. To ensure the safety of your data, we strongly recommend that you always use synchronization with your cloud storage.
Important: when a PIN code or master password is lost, its recovery is impossible, and data recovery is also impossible (this is due both to the security policy of our application and the limited capabilities of encryption algorithms).
Our advantages:
• Do not collect your personal data: just download and use it without registration.
• Do not need internet to work with Secure. Data is always with you: abroad, in the forest or on a plane.
• Protect your data from prying people: access via Face ID, Touch ID and/or PIN code.
• Start to protect your data as soon as you add your first password, note or bankcard.
• Use your data on multiple devices by connecting your Dropbox, Google Drive or iCloud Drive. We do not have access to your data, and we cannot see it.
• Autofill your passwords quickly and save you time. (Available on iOS 12)
• Generate strong and unique passwords with our Password Generator.
• Add credit cards with credit card scan using the camera on your device.
• Share your passwords, notes, bankcards as the text message anywhere you need.
• We cannot get your data, even if you really want. The key is stored only with you and we cannot pick it up, even if you ask us about it. Or not you. Especially if not you.
• SecureX is also available on iPad and Apple Watch. Use Sync to keep your info updated from any device!
• Additional security: Erase Data, Emergency PIN Code and Facedown Lock!
• Add your personal photos, documents, passports, IDs and other photos that you don't want others to see! Photos will be kept encrypted and secure!
The app contains the following subscription options (Premium access for data backup, cloud synch and no limits for passwords, notes, and bankcards):
- Monthly and annual subscriptions;
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase;
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable;
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period;
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal;
- Subscriptions might be managed by the user and auto-renewal might be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase;
- Price may vary depending on the currency and region.

bluejetty:00024491:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00024491:ios.description:
Join millions of fanatical Euchre players. Get the best card game ever: Euchre! It is simple, fast to learn and offers you guaranteed fun!
Euchre is played with a deck of 24 standard playing cards. There are two teams of 2 players each.
When naming a suit (ordering up trump), a player states that their team intends to win the majority of tricks of the hand. A single point is scored when the bid is successful, and two points are scored if the team that declared trump (the bidding team) takes all five tricks. A failure of the bidding team to win three tricks is referred to as being "euchred", and that team is penalized by giving the opposing team two points.
A caller with very good cards can "go alone" (order up alone), in which case the caller tries to win the march without a partner. The partner of a caller in a lone hand does not play, and if the caller achieves the march (winning all 5 tricks), the winning partners score 4 points. If only three or four of the tricks are taken while going alone, then only one point is scored. If euchred while playing alone, the opposing team still only receives 2 points.
The primary rule to remember when playing Euchre is that one is never required to play the trump suit (unless that is the one that is led), but one is required to follow suit if possible.
Enjoy the essence of the classic Euchre game, specially conceived for your iPhone and iPad. This will be your best ever experience on an Euchre game!
With big and beautiful cards, a clear interface, hand picked sounds and an amazing Artificial Intelligence, Euchre, the Classic Card Game, offers you an experience like no other before.

eNetViet là phiên
bluejetty:00014924:ios.description:
eNetViet là ứng dụng trực tuyến kết nối Gia đình và Nhà trường, hỗ trợ công tác truyền thông, điều hành của Sở GD&ĐT, Phòng GD&ĐT, Ban giám hiệu nhà trường và công tác chuyên môn của Cán bộ giáo viên trong các trường học
eNetViet là phiên bản mobile của phần mềm Quản lý trường học - đáp ứng cho các đối tượng: Cán bộ quản lý, Giáo viên, Phụ huynh mở các cấp học: từ Mầm non đến Phổ thông.
Để sử dụng được sản phẩm này, giáo viên, phụ huynh của nhà trường phải đang sử dụng phần mềm quản lý trường học của Công ty cung cấp. Khi đó Nhà trường sẽ cấp cho mỗi giáo viên, phụ huynh một tài khoản để theo dõi thông tin của con mình.
Ứng dụng eNetViet cung cấp các thông tin:
1. Dành cho Cán bộ quản lý:
- Tra cứu Danh bạ trực tuyến.
- Gửi / Nhận thông báo, thông tin điều hành.
- Gửi / Nhận, Tra cứu theo thời gian thực các báo cáo, số liệu thống kê phục vụ công tác quản lý.
- Điểm danh trực tuyến tại các cuộc họp, hội nghị bằng mã QR code.
2. Dành cho Giáo viên nhà trường:
- Nhập liệu, nhận xét hàng ngày và các dữ liệu khác từ phần mềm quản lý trường học.
- Kết nối với Phụ huynh học sinh thông qua viêc gửi/ nhận thông báo, phản hồi bằng tin nhắn, tin nhắn đa phương tiện, trò chuyện trực tuyến trên ứng dụng.
- Đăng tải và chia sẻ các hình ảnh, hoạt động ý nghĩa của trường, của lớp và các học sinh thân yêu để tạo ra một cộng đồng gắn kết.
- Đăng thông báo lịch học, kế hoạch ôn tập, lịch thi của lớp; chia sẻ kinh nghiệm giáo dục tri thức, giáo dục kỹ năng cho học sinh với các bậc Phụ huynh.
- Gửi tài liệu kế hoạch học tập cho PHHS.
- Tiến hành điểm danh, duyệt đơn xin nghỉ học trực tuyến và thống kê chuyên cần cho học sinh.
3. Dành cho Phụ huynh học sinh:
- Kết nối, trò chuyện với Giáo viên trong trường/ lớp.
- Xin nghỉ học trực tuyến cho con.
- Theo dõi điểm danh trực tuyến của con ở lớp theo từng ngày, từng tiết học.
- Nắm bắt thời khóa biểu, kế hoạch học tập, thực đơn bữa ăn hàng ngày… của con.
- Nhận các thông báo, tin tức trực tuyến từ Nhà trường.
- Gửi/ nhận file, bài tập về nhà của học sinh.
- Tra cứu trực tuyến kết quả học tập, rèn luyện của con.
- Cùng cảm nhận và lưu giữ những hình ảnh, những khoảnh khắc tuyệt vời của con ở trường.

bluejetty:00033660:ios.name: AMood: AI Mood Monitor
bluejetty:00033660:ios.summary: Welcome to AMood, your healthy living companion on Apple Watch. Effortlessly track your mental state and physical stress, quickly check sleep, basal metabolism, hydration, caffeine intake, and more — helping you stay in tune with your body
bluejetty:00033660:ios.description:
Welcome to AMood, your healthy living companion on Apple Watch. Effortlessly track your mental state and physical stress, quickly check sleep, basal metabolism, hydration, caffeine intake, and more — helping you stay in tune with your body and live a healthier life.
◎ How AMood Can Help You
In this fast-paced world, we often keep spinning without stopping to listen to ourselves. Fatigue and anxiety creep in quietly, yet we struggle to pinpoint why. We believe understanding your mind and body is the key to finding your ideal life rhythm. AMood was built on this belief — through precise analysis, it helps you take better care of yourself. For example:
- Busy rushing a project for hours? The app reminds you via your watch that energy is dropping — time for a tea break and a stretch;
- After a full day of meetings feeling anxious? It alerts you that your mood index is low — step outside for some sunshine and a walk; 
- Wake up feeling down? Open the app and discover poor sleep quality was the cause. A little more sunshine or a midday nap can help recharge;
- Check weekly trends and notice your mood rises after exercising with friends. Life's hint: happiness hides in simple things;
- Under high pressure? Check your mind-body calendar to find your golden hours. Do the right things at the right time — let productivity and health go hand in hand.
◎ Core Features
Stress used to be measured by a single HRV metric, but life is far more complex. AMood pioneered dual-dimension analysis, independently monitoring physical stress and mental state for more accurate insights.
- Dual-Dimension Monitoring: Independently tracks physical energy and emotional fluctuations for precise analysis
- Comprehensive Data: Integrates sleep, heart rate, body temperature, sunlight, gait, and more for a full health picture
- Smart Reminders: Real-time mind-body monitoring with timely reminders to rest and adjust
- Trend Insights: Discover your optimal routines and work rhythms
- Habit Building: Log exercise, hydration, caffeine intake, and more to support health management
- Licensed Themes: Multiple officially licensed IP collaborations, adding fun to health management
AMood goes beyond single moments — it uncovers patterns in your life. By analyzing sleep, heart rate, temperature, and more, it paints your unique life rhythm. Behind every data point lies the secret to a better life. We believe taking care of yourself should be filled with warmth and joy.
◎ Apple Health Integration
AMood integrates with Apple Health and requires read and write permissions.
◎ Subscription Pricing and Terms
We offer three options: one-time purchase, monthly auto-renewal, and annual auto-renewal. Subscriptions auto-renew through your Apple iTunes account after confirmation and payment. To unsubscribe, turn off auto-renewal in iTunes / Apple ID settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. If not cancelled during the trial, the subscription activates and charges automatically at trial's end.
◎ Privacy Protection
User health data is stored only locally and in the user's own iCloud.
◎ Disclaimer
AMood is not a medical device and cannot diagnose, treat, or prevent diseases. All information provided should not be considered medical advice. Please consult a doctor if you have concerns about your health.
◎ User Agreement and Privacy Policy
User Agreement https://docs.amood.app/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy https://docs.amood.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00141402:ios.description:
Bank: The Ultimate Dice Game - Fun, Fast, and Addictive!
Bank is an exciting and fast-paced dice game where strategy, risk, and luck collide! Roll the dice to accumulate points and try to outsmart your opponents in a thrilling series of rounds. Can you bank your points before disaster strikes?
Gameplay: Each player takes turns rolling a pair of dice to rack up as many points as possible in each round. The game has two action-packed phases:
Phase 1:
Start with three risk-free rolls to build your score! Rolling a 7 grants 70 points, while other rolls earn points equal to their sum. Strategize wisely and prepare for the next phase!
Phase 2:
This is where the tension rises! Keep rolling to rack up more points, but be careful—if you roll a 7, the round ends. Doubles double the points, adding even more excitement. Bank your points to secure your winnings before it's too late!
Features:
Perfect for Groups: Fun for 2 or more players. Easy to learn, but hard to master!
Single Player Mode: Practice your strategy and perfect your dice-rolling skills.
Leaderboards & Achievements: Compete with friends and players around the world to see who’s the best!
Casual & Competitive: Play at your own pace, whether you're relaxing solo or battling friends.
Tons of Options: Play a game of 5, 10, 15, or 20 rounds. Bring your own dice or use in-game dice, and much more!
Why You'll Love Bank:
Simple, fast, and fun gameplay.
Great for parties or family game nights.
Exciting dice action with the perfect blend of luck and strategy.
Stunning visuals and smooth animations.
Download Bank today and start rolling your way to victory! Perfect for all ages—how many points can you bank?

bluejetty:00042333:ios.summary:
The Inner Reef is in ruin...
Once full of life, it's fallen apart, piece by piece, because the emotions trying to reach you never got answered. Beliefs meant to protect you grew overprotective instead, and now they hold you back. Legend say
bluejetty:00042333:ios.description:
The Inner Reef is in ruin...
Once full of life, it's fallen apart, piece by piece, because the emotions trying to reach you never got answered. Beliefs meant to protect you grew overprotective instead, and now they hold you back. Legend says the Reef is bound to one soul: the Hero of the Reef. Only they hold the power to restore it.
Could that Hero be you?
WHAT IS INNER REEF? The Self-Connection Game built entirely around one idea: your emotions are trying to tell you something.
Your Inner Reef is a reflection of your inner self. Connecting with it is self-connection, and it starts with your emotions. Inner Reef is where you learn to listen: building the self-knowledge to hear the message behind an emotion, and the self-regulation to soothe it and steer your life, on purpose.
Here, your emotions aren't the problem. They're the clues.
HOW IT WORKS Self-knowledge: Notice a Wave of Emotion rise, and break it into its two parts: the meaning behind it, and the urge in your body. Then design your ideal self and life: uncover the beliefs and deep needs behind your emotions, and define your values, boundaries, and ideal life.
Self-regulation: Settle the wave. Drop anchor and calm your mind and body in the moment. Then rewrite the beliefs driving it, through self-talk and action, and build new mental habits in their place.
The result: a clearer, calmer way of living with yourself, and a fresh look at the patterns that keep showing up. The relationships that keep going wrong. The opportunities you talk yourself out of. The habits you can't break.
THE TURTLE WAY The slow and steady, no-pressure way to deal with the hard parts of life, splashed with a sparkle of fun. You'll answer a completely ridiculous question, and somehow it'll tell you something true about yourself. That's how Inner Reef works: through play, not analysis.
Every day is different, and designed to deliver serious topics in a fun way.
THE BEST OF ALL WORLDS Inner Reef is a fun, low-pressure way to build the emotional skills that therapy-inspired approaches teach, through adventures instead of sessions.
Sitting across from someone, paying by the minute, wondering if they're judging you, can be scary. Here, there's no pressure to perform and no guilt if you miss a day. Everything you share stays 100% private, and we never share or sell your data.
Every step gets saved into reports you can revisit anytime. And you're never alone: 40+ Inner Reefsiders are here to support you.
WHAT WE'RE NOT Inner Reef is not therapy, a medical device, or a substitute for professional care, and it doesn't diagnose or treat any condition. It's a self-development game inspired by neuroscience and psychology research, to help you understand who you are, what you want, and why you do the things you do.
If you need clinical support, please get the care you deserve. Inner Reef can still be a steady companion alongside it. If you're in crisis, contact your local emergency services or a crisis line.
A MENTAL WELLBEING GAME BUILT FOR REAL LIFE No long to-do lists. No overwhelming plans. No pressure to be perfect. Every day is a different quest, and none of them feel like homework. Unlock:
* Story-driven self-discovery adventures
* Daily happiness workouts for memory, creativity, and gratitude
* Adventures to master your emotions
* Guided journaling and self-reflection
* AI coaching conversations with characters who know your story
* Cringe Court, where your inner critic gets cross-examined
* Conversation Corner, to practice what you want to say before you say it
* The Shellphone, your pocket calm for anxiety and overwhelm
* A weekly magazine written about you, by the Reef, behind your back
Begin restoring the Reef straight away. Subscribe for unlimited access to all adventures and challenges.
Terms of Use: https://www.innerreefapp.com/terms-mobile 
Privacy: https://www.innerreefapp.com/privacy-policy

HOW IT WORKS Self-knowledge: Notice a Wave of Emotion rise, and break it into its two parts: the meaning behind it, and the urge in your body. Then design your ideal self and life: uncover the beliefs and deep needs behind your emotions, and define your values, boundaries, and ideal life.
Self-regulation: Settle the wave. Drop anchor and calm your mind and body in the moment. Then rewrite the beliefs driving it, through self-talk and action, and build new mental habits in their place.
The result: a clearer, calmer way of living with yourself, and a fresh look at the patterns that keep showing up. The relationships that keep going wrong. The opportunities you talk yourself out of. The habits you can't break.

THE TURTLE WAY The slow and steady, no-pressure way to deal with the hard parts of life, splashed with a sparkle of fun. You'll answer a completely ridiculous question, and somehow it'll tell you something true about yourself. That's how Inner Reef works: through play, not analysis.
Every day is different, and designed to deliver serious topics in a fun way.

THE BEST OF ALL WORLDS Inner Reef is a fun, low-pressure way to build the emotional skills that therapy-inspired approaches teach, through adventures instead of sessions.
Sitting across from someone, paying by the minute, wondering if they're judging you, can be scary. Here, there's no pressure to perform and no guilt if you miss a day. Everything you share stays 100% private, and we never share or sell your data.
Every step gets saved into reports you can revisit anytime. And you're never alone: 40+ Inner Reefsiders are here to support you.

WHAT WE'RE NOT Inner Reef is not therapy, a medical device, or a substitute for professional care, and it doesn't diagnose or treat any condition. It's a self-development game inspired by neuroscience and psychology research, to help you understand who you are, what you want, and why you do the things you do.
If you need clinical support, please get the care you deserve. Inner Reef can still be a steady companion alongside it. If you're in crisis, contact your local emergency services or a crisis line.

A MENTAL WELLBEING GAME BUILT FOR REAL LIFE No long to-do lists. No overwhelming plans. No pressure to be perfect. Every day is a different quest, and none of them feel like homework. Unlock:
* Story-driven self-discovery adventures
* Daily happiness workouts for memory, creativity, and gratitude
* Adventures to master your emotions

* AI coaching conversations with characters who know your story
* Cringe Court, where your inner critic gets cross-examined
* Conversation Corner, to practice what you want to say before you say it
* The Shellphone, your pocket calm for anxiety and overwhelm
* A weekly magazine written about you, by the Reef, behind your back

Begin restoring the Reef straight away. Subscribe for unlimited access to all adventures and challenges.

Trouble sleeping? Rain Rain® helps you fall asleep fast! Let over 100 high-quality endless sounds lull you to sleep in no time, with more sounds added all the time. Mix and match any combination of sounds and save your favorite combinations. Download the app that over eight million people have used to fall asleep today!
Works great for: Insomnia - Anxiety - Tinnitus - Working from Home - Studying - AND MUCH MORE
Instead of keeping you awake, your phone can help you sleep!
Here are the top sounds being listened to this week:
Rain Rain Original, Thunderstorm, Rain on a Tent, Rain Rain 3D, Ocean Waves, Summer Rain, Forest Rain, City Rain, Thunder Cracks, Rain Downpour, Crackling Fire, Slow Stream, Desert Wind, Blizzard Wind, Pink Noise, Airliner, Car in the Rain, Windy Storm, Rain Dripping, Gentle Stream, Chill Beats, Cat Purring and Shih Tzu Snoring.
Rain Rain includes for FREE:
• 50+ HD sounds
• No limit on playback time
• Every fade-out timer option
• Mixer - combine multiple sounds with individual volume
• Oscillator - vary sound volume with customizable speed
• Soften - muffle higher frequencies with adjustable dampening
• No audio or video ads; there is a small image banner ad at the bottom
• Use for as long as you like; Rain Rain is not a trial!
• Full support for background audio, AirPlay, and Bluetooth devices
Subscribing to Rain Rain Premium gives you 60+ additional sounds as well as an ad-free experience. Rain Rain Premium includes a free 7-day trial which only begins if you select it within the application and confirm with your Apple ID, Touch ID or Face ID, so you don't have to worry about being charged accidentally. 
MIXER: Combine sounds control the volume of each. Want to hear a campfire in the rain? How about a washing machine and a dryer? It's all possible with the Mixer. Save your favorite sound combinations. Your custom mixes are synchronized between all of your iOS devices with iCloud.
FADE-OUT TIMER: Set Rain Rain to gently fade out and then turn off after a specified duration so that you can get to sleep without leaving your phone or tablet on all night. The Fade-out Timer learns your preferences and automatically starts the next time you use Rain Rain.
BEDTIME REMINDER: The first step to a better night's sleep is a healthy sleep schedule. Get to bed on-time with Rain Rain's Bedtime Reminder by setting the time and days you want a reminder. Rain Rain sends you a gentle, encouraging message when it is time to go to bed so that you can get the rest you deserve.
OSCILLATOR: Customize your experience with the Oscillator, which slowly fades a sound in and out, allowing you to create dynamic, varying soundscapes in concert with the Mixer. You can even adjust how fast the Oscillator changes the volume. When you save a Mix to your Favorites, your Oscillator settings are saved as well, allowing you to save and recall any number of custom soundscapes.
SOFTEN: Adjust the tone of each sound to suit your needs with Soften, which reduces the high frequencies of any sound by an amount you choose. This makes the sound seem as if it is coming from another room or outside, as sometimes you want to sleep with rain outside, not pouring on your head. Soften takes care of any worries about the sound being harsh, tinny, or hissy when played on small speakers or even the built-in iPhone or iPad speakers. Your chosen levels for Soften are stored when you save a Mix to your Favorites to help you create the perfect scenes.

- Report your lost item to the network to increase your chances of finding it
Have a good trip on the CTS lines!

bluejetty:00046044:ios.description:
Scavvy — Interactive Experiences for Any Group
Turn any gathering into something people actually participate in. Build it in minutes, share a code, and watch it happen live.
Scavvy is an app for creating interactive group experiences — scavenger hunts, team-building challenges, onboarding games, conference activations, wedding weekends, classroom quests, city tours, and whatever else you can design. You write the missions. Your people complete them with photos, videos, text answers, and GPS check-ins. Everyone follows along in a live feed as it unfolds.
BUILD THE EXPERIENCE YOU WANT
Scavvy gives you the pieces, not a template:
• Missions — photo, video, text, and GPS location, in any combination
• Reference Photos — add photos to your missions and clues to give players a visual reference for each challenge
• Structure — open exploration where players pick their own path, or a locked sequence where each answer unlocks the next
• Format — solo play, teams, or a whole company split into squads
• Timing — schedule a start and end and let it run without you
• Scoring — set point values, award bonuses for great submissions, reject the ones that miss
WHAT PEOPLE USE IT FOR
Corporate team building and offsites. Conference and trade show activations. Wedding weekends and bachelorette parties. School field trips and campus orientation. Birthday parties. Family reunions. Neighborhood fundraisers. Holiday events.
THE LIVE PART
The feed is where it comes together. Submissions appear the moment they're posted — no refreshing, no waiting for someone to compile a recap afterward. Filter by mission or by player, comment on submissions, and download the photos when it's over.
MADE TO RUN ITSELF
• Guided onboarding so players know exactly what to do with no briefing from you
• Invite by link or private game code
• Live leaderboards
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What kind of experience can I build?
Anything made of tasks. A classic scavenger hunt, a photo challenge, a trivia trail, an onboarding checklist, a guided tour, a team competition. If you can write it as a list of missions, Scavvy runs it.
How many people can join?
Plans cover 10, 50, or 100 players, or unlimited — pick the size
that fits, solo or in teams. Player capacity is set by your plan,
available as a one-time purchase or a monthly subscription.
Do players need training?
No. Scavvy walks them through everything after they enter your code.
Can I run it without being there?
Yes. Schedule the start and end times and it runs on its own. You can drop in to award bonus points whenever you want.

Privacy Policy: https://scavvy.com/privacy/

listings.name: Scavvy: Epic Scavenger Hunts
listings.description:
Scavvy — Interactive Experiences for Any Group

Turn any gathering into something people actually participate in. Build it in minutes, share a code, and watch it happen live.

Scavvy is an app for creating interactive group experiences — scavenger hunts, team-building challenges, onboarding games, conference activations, wedding weekends, classroom quests, city tours, and whatever else you can design. You write the missions. Your people complete them with photos, videos, text answers, and GPS check-ins. Everyone follows along in a live feed as it unfolds.

BUILD THE EXPERIENCE YOU WANT

Scavvy gives you the pieces, not a template:

• Missions — photo, video, text, and GPS location, in any combination
• Reference Photos — add photos to your missions and clues to give players a visual reference for each challenge
• Structure — open exploration where players pick their own path, or a locked sequence where each answer unlocks the next
• Format — solo play, teams, or a whole company split into squads
• Timing — schedule a start and end and let it run without you
• Scoring — set point values, award bonuses for great submissions, reject the ones that miss

WHAT PEOPLE USE IT FOR

Corporate team building and offsites. Conference and trade show activations. Wedding weekends and bachelorette parties. School field trips and campus orientation. Birthday parties. Family reunions. Neighborhood fundraisers. Holiday events.

THE LIVE PART

The feed is where it comes together. Submissions appear the moment they're posted — no refreshing, no waiting for someone to compile a recap afterward. Filter by mission or by player, comment on submissions, and download the photos when it's over.

MADE TO RUN ITSELF

• Guided onboarding so players know exactly what to do with no briefing from you
• Invite by link or private game code
• Live leaderboards

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What kind of experience can I build?
Anything made of tasks. A classic scavenger hunt, a photo challenge, a trivia trail, an onboarding checklist, a guided tour, a team competition. If you can write it as a list of missions, Scavvy runs it.

How many people can join?
Plans cover 10, 50, or 100 players, or unlimited — pick the size
that fits, solo or in teams. Player capacity is set by your plan,
available as a one-time purchase or a monthly subscription.

Do players need training?
No. Scavvy walks them through everything after they enter your code.

Can I run it without being there?
Yes. Schedule the start and end times and it runs on its own. You can drop in to award bonus points whenever you want.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://scavvy.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00061878:ios.description:
Zimperium MTD is an AI-empowered mobile security solution. Purpose-built for mobile, Zimperium provides advanced protection for mobile applications and devices, leveraging on-device AI to detect and protect against evolving threats including mobile phishing (mishing), risky networks, device compromise, app risks, and even zero-day attacks. Cybercriminals have adopted a mobile-first attack strategy, targeting one of your organization's most vulnerable attack surfaces: the mobile apps and devices that your organization and customers depend upon.
Zimperium’s on-device, AI-empowered detection scales with the needs of the modern workforce, securing devices against the most advanced threats. Zimperium enables enterprises to support and secure BYOD and corporate-owned devices without sacrificing employee privacy or personal data.
NOTE: Zimperium MTD requires a valid business license to protect users from mobile threats. Please contact your security administrator before installing this application. 
Zimperium MTD protects your privacy. Your organization: 
- Cannot read your texts, emails, or other communication
- Cannot see your browsing history
- Cannot listen to your calls or see who you talk to
- Cannot listen to you via your phone’s microphone
- Cannot monitor you via your camera
- Cannot read your files or documents
- Cannot capture your screen
- Cannot view your contacts
Zimperium MTD collects security events, threat information, and system telemetry to help your security team detect malicious activities or attacks that may compromise your personal and/or corporate information. Any information collected on your device will never be shared or sold to a third party.

bluejetty:00024875:ios.description:
Have phone addiction? Want to improve self-control? Want to remove distraction? Let Focus Quest help! 
Focus Quest is a study timer and RPG mashup. Save Focusland by turning your focus time into resources to train the hero and upgrade the equipment. Begin your focus adventure, and let us help you manage time and stay focused on the most important things in life.
A gamified focus app helps you better improve productivity, self-control, and concentration on study and work. Sometimes self-discipline is just not enough to keep us away from phones. This is when gamification comes in. The in-game achievements encourage users to stick with the app, better manage their time and get things done.
FEATURES:
* Beat phone addictions and stay in control, help you with study, uni, and work
* Stay focused - Collect hero resources when you put down the phone and focus
* Train hero - Use resources to train your hero
* Forge gears - Collect gear materials to forge powerful gears
* Save the world - Fight off monsters and bring time order back to Focusland
* Records - Stay on track of the time you focused so that you can better plan your tasks
* Rewards - gamified tasks and rewards help you stay on track of your focus goals
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS:
Focus Pass offers USD $3.99 monthly subscription for accessing exclusive resources and premium features.
End of trial and subscription renewal:
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

According to prestige bonus given in each round; the player should decide optimizations, different strategies and various adjustments unlike other Idle Games.

 * Speed upgrades start to affect earns after maxing out the color speed

Our mission
bluejetty:00119820:ios.description:
izif is the fast, fun way to learn, play and master the Guitar, Piano, Oud, and Violin. Our learning path, designed by expert music teachers, will help musicians of all levels improve, from complete beginners to professionals.
Our mission is to help music lovers achieve their goals of learning music and musical instruments by providing a platform with rich educational resources using our high quality videos and sheet music library.
Izif online video tutorials are available for absolute beginners with no prior knowledge to music, as well as lessons and music courses for intermediate and advanced level.
On izif you will find, Oud lessons, Guitar Lessons, Darbouka Lessons, Ney Lessons and Qanun Lessons and more to come as our team adds more levels and new instruments along the way.
You’ll simply be amazed how fast your skills can advance. So grab your guitar, Oud, Piano, Violin, or warm up your voice, and start making music!
WHO IS IZIF FOR?
• Piano, Oud, Guitar, Violin, and musical instruments Lovers.
• Music Lovers
• Self-learners
• Complete Beginners
• Advanced & Professional Musicians
• Music Teachers
The izif videos are divided into multiple screens that make it easier to see how the fingers move on the instrument , on top of that there are always musical notes that light up every time the note is played by the teacher to help people interested in learning how to read music achieve higher goals.
WHAT’S INCLUDED?
• 2000+ lessons, exercises and songs by famous artists you love.
• Tons of music theory and trainers for every playing technique
• Thousands of videos covering all the skills you need to learn Oud, Learn Piano, Learn Guitar, Viloin, and more.
• High quality video tutorials, including instrument tutorials that teach you how to play a certain musical instrument as a beginner , or song tutorials that teach how to play Popular songs and musical pieces.
• Sheet music library with musical notes for many popular, old and new, Arabic songs and musical pieces.
izif is a music education app that allows you to learn music theory in a fun and orderly manner. Download now!
TOP MUSIC COURSES:
• Oud Courses - Learn how to Play Oud with our course for absolute beginners given by a well known composer and teacher, Tareq Al Jundi using one of the recognized Oud curricula in Arabic Music Institutes that uses popular Palestinian, Jordanian,Syrian, Egyptian and Iraqi folk music and popular Arabic songs.
• Piano Courses - Learn how to Play Piano with this piano course that willhelp you all the way from zero knowledge to the point where you are sitting with your hands at the keyboard with all the understanding and resources you need.
• Guitar Courses - The best way to learn Guitar is by using the izif app. In these guitar lessons you’ll learn everything you need to get off to a perfect start. We teach both acoustic and electric guitar lessons. All levels of players from total beginners to advanced are welcome to join this course.
• Violin Courses - Learn how to play the violin or improve your skills with hands-on exercises, video tutorials, and lessons by the top music experts in the region. Learning the violin or fiddle has never been so fun and effective! Check the online course now!
• Vocals Courses - Have you always dreamed about singing, but don't know where to start? If you'd love to improve your vocal skills, we're here for you!
So what are you waiting for? Download the izif app and start learning music right away!

bluejetty:00168968:ios.description:
Welcome to "Crime City: Bank Robbery" the ultimate shooting game that will immerse you in the thrilling world of criminal gangs and daring heistsan. An adrenaline-pumping shooter where you play as an FBI agent tasked with taking down a notorious gang of bank robbers in armed heist. Dive into the dangerous underworld of crime and test your skills as a sharpshooter and member of the police SWAT team.
In this action-packed game, you will face intense challenges and thrilling missions as you go head-to-head with the mafia gangsters and their powerful criminal organizations. Your objective is to prevent successful bank heists and restore law and order to Crime City.
Equipped with state-of-the-art weapon, including sniper rifles, guns, pistols and advanced tactical gear, you'll engage in exhilarating shootouts and strategic battles against the gangs. Use your sharpshooting skills to take out enemies from a distance or go in guns blazing for close-quarter combat. The choice is yours.
To ensure your success in each mission - plan meticulously and strike swiftly.
As you progress through the game, you will uncover the dark secrets of the criminal underworld, infiltrate gang hideouts, and gather vital intel to bring down their sprawling network. Immersive visuals, realistic sound effects, and gripping storyline will keep you engaged in this thrilling crime-fighting journey and bank heists.
Prepare yourself for heart-racing action as you navigate through the treacherous city streets, encountering various challenges, and uncovering the truth behind each bank robbery. Gripping PvP battles for ultimate supremacy in Crime City. 
"Crime City: Bank Robbery" offers a gripping gameplay experience for all shooting enthusiasts and fans of action-packed games. Become the ultimate crimefighter, save innocent lives, and restore peace to the city by taking down ruthless gangsters. Are you ready to accept the challenge? Download now and prove your skills as the most skilled sniper in town!
