bluejetty:00144481:ios.description:
Online Radio Box is a free application for listening to the internet radio online. Take worldwide live broadcast FM radio wherever you go — without any registration or hidden fees.
What Online Radio Box Does:
Our global radio app aggregates thousands of live AM/FM stations into one fast, lightweight interface. 
Key features include:
- Smart Sleep Timer: Fall asleep to your favorite music or talk shows without draining your battery.
- Global Genre Directory: Easily explore pop, jazz, rock, hip-hop, electronic, country, and local news.
- Favorites & Synchronization: Save stations to your favorites and instantly sync preferences between your smartphone and the web version.
- No Registration Required: One-click access to international live streams without creating an account.
Who Online Radio Box Is For
This app is specifically designed for:
- Daily radio listeners looking for an easy, one-click way to stream local AM/FM stations and global internet broadcasts.
- Music fans and audio enthusiasts who want to discover live music genres (like jazz, rock, oldies, or pop) from real DJs instead of repetitive computer playlists.
- News and talk-show followers who want real-time access to global talk radio, live sports commentary, and breaking local news.
- Background audio users who need a stable, lightweight app to play music seamlessly while working, driving, cooking, or relaxing.
Which Problems It Solves
- Discover radio from around the world: Access thousands of AM/FM and online radio stations across different countries, genres, and languages from a single app.
- Simple listening experience: Quickly find stations, save favorites, and enjoy live radio through a lightweight interface designed for everyday use.
- A free alternative to streaming services: Listen to music, news, sports, and talk radio without needing a separate paid music streaming subscription.
FAQ — Internet Radio & Streaming
Is Online Radio Box completely free?
Yes. It is a completely free application for internet radio listening. You can access thousands of worldwide radio stations immediately after installation without any subscription.
Can I find specific radio genres like jazz or rock?
Yes. The app features a comprehensive catalogue arranged by radio stations genres. You can filter streams by country, city, or styles including jazz, hard rock, dance music, oldies, and popular modern music.
Does the app support background streaming?
Yes, Online Radio Box is optimized to be fast, stable, and lightweight, allowing you to listen to the radio online while using other apps or with your screen turned off.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://onlineradiobox.com/privacy

SPOTR COACH: YOUR 24/7 PERSONAL TRAINER
Spotr Coach is a powerful AI chat feature that can directly create and update training program for you. Deeply connected to your data, Spotr can analyze your workout history, wearable data, and training plans to deliver insights that drive progress. Spotr users chat with Spotr Coach to identify progress plateaus, tweak training schedules, import new programs, and more. Whether you're chasing muscle growth, fat loss, strength, or just trying to form a gym habit, Spotr keeps you on track.
VOICE WORKOUT TRACKING
Advanced gym-goers know tracking workouts is the key to making steady progress. With features like set autofilling and voice workout tracking, Spotr makes it easy to track. Just say “Incline bench, two plates and a ten,” or “225 for 8 at 9 RPE” and Spotr instantly captures weight, reps, and effort (RPE) values. It’s fast, flexible, and built for lifters who want minimal distractions during their workouts.

Get clear, muscle-specific recovery insights so you know what to hit and when. Visualize your training volume by body part, follow weekly progress trends, and see how your workload evolves over time. Spotr helps you find the sweet spot between hitting the gym hard and recovering fully.
WORKOUT SHARING
Turn your workouts into shareable art. Spotr’s creative canvas transforms your workouts into sleek visuals you can post to Instagram or any social platform.
Download Spotr to unlock personal training that learns from you, evolves with your body, and keeps you in control.

bluejetty:00144509:ios.description:
Go to survive in the Air! Build a sand Airship and start journey with mobile Desert Skies - Sandbox Survival! Land and collect loot anywhere in the Wild Desert, but be careful, the desert is full of dangerous monsters.
The game will take you to the distant 1890s of young America.
During the period of the Wild West, a catastrophe happened - terrible sand monsters began to attack the villages and destroy everything that they encountered in their way - people, animals.. Rumor has it that they were released during excavations at the mines, none of the workers survived at that moment.
People saving their lives fled, taking away only the necessities, throwing all their belongings, and also hiding valuables and gold in hiding places. Many western states are empty.
A former criminal named David Green had nowhere to run, he had no one left. All his loved ones died from the teeth of terrible monsters.
The young man decided to atone for the sins of the past - he intends to save humanity from disaster, to catch and destroy monsters that keep half the planet in fear. Become a monster hunter.
You have to help him in this difficult task. You will have to master the skill of creating objects from improvised materials, study maps and terrain, look for hidden treasures, fight off terrible enemies, discover new interesting places and settlements.
UNUSUAL CRAFT
* For movement, create and use a huge air.
* Craft a variety of items and weapons to survive in a predatory deadly empty.
* Remember - your ship is your fortress, improve and strengthen it.
RESEARCHES
* Fly and seek out treasure and dangers.
* In abandoned villages, people left many hiding places with treasures and weapons.
BATTLES
* As soon as you descend to earth, terrible monsters will feel you and rush straight to you, do not hesitate!
* Do everything quickly but quietly. They all feel and are looking for you. Fly faster and fly to another place of desert sands!
SEARCH AND COLLECTION OF RESOURCES
* Remember, the desert send is not only a red dead, but many more resources for survival. Collect them to survive and win. This is element games.
You will find a grand battle in a huge, beautiful open world, you have to fight for survival, to save villages and people from mortal danger. You are the only survivor, it depends on you whether humanity will survive!
Desert Skies is a completely new float on air game - the all-new terrifying single player story in the popular flying games RPG genre. Playing float survival base building games has become much more interesting!
Remember, beings sense your fear and hear your steps.
Game premium access gives valuable game bonuses:
- noise attracts the Seeker with a 20% less chance
- 2 unique weapons every day
- full extended diary available
- inventory expanded with 5 free slots
- weapons don't break
- 50 coins every day
- hunger speed decreased by 50%
- thirst speed decreased by 50%
- free sandbox mode
- no ADs

bluejetty:00045237:ios.description:
The Alzheimer’s caregiving journey can feel like a solo one. Elevmi™ is here to walk it with you.
Caring for a loved one with Alzheimer’s can be full of questions, uncertainty, and emotional weight. Elevmi is a free app designed to help caregivers find support through every stage, helping you track changes, prepare for appointments, look after your own wellbeing, and feel more confident day to day.
Whether you're just starting your caregiving journey or have been supporting a loved one for years, Elevmi provides a sense of structure, clarity, and support when things feel uncertain.
Understand what’s changing
When you’re noticing new behaviors in a loved one, like confusion at certain times of day or changes in sleep or appetite, it can be hard to know what’s significant.
With Elevmi, you can quickly log these changes, spot patterns over time, and bring helpful context to doctors’ visits. No more trying to remember everything on the spot.
Stay prepared for doctor appointments
Short appointments can be more productive.
Elevmi helps you generate a clear summary of recent behaviors and symptoms to send to healthcare professionals ahead of time. That way, your loved one’s care can be based on the full picture, not just what’s remembered in the moment.
With Care Log, all your logged information is kept in one organized place, making it easy to access, retrieve, and manage your observations, notes, check-ins, and summaries.
Find answers when you need them
Not sure if a new behavior is typical? Wondering how to manage a certain symptom?
Elevmi offers quick access to trusted information about Alzheimer’s, no endless Googling, no unreliable forums. Just concise, tailored content written for real caregivers.
Support yourself, too
You’re not just a caregiver. You’re a person with your own needs, emotions, and energy limits.
Elevmi includes gentle prompts and self-care strategies to help you look after your own wellbeing, because sustainable care starts with you being supported, too.
Learn from others who’ve been there
You’re not alone, even if it feels like it.
Discover resources created with input from real caregivers. See what’s worked for others, what to expect in different stages, and how to navigate the complex moments that come with caring for someone with Alzheimer’s.
A simple, private space for caregiving clarity
There are no complicated forms or signups. No public sharing.
Just a private, easy-to-use space to track, reflect, and access support, built by people who understand the caregiving experience.
Caregivers can choose Elevmi because it:
• Could reduce stress before doctor visits
• May help bring structure to the day-to-day
• Has tools to improve communication with healthcare teams
• Could help to make it easier to notice meaningful changes
• Offers emotional support along the way
• 100% free, always
Like the elephant caring for its herd, we’re here to support your journey.
--- 
Elevmi does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. It is not a substitute for consultation with a qualified healthcare professional. Always seek medical guidance regarding conditions or medication for yourself or your loved one.
Elevmi is not affiliated with or specific to any prescription treatment.
Elevmi is a registered trademark of Otsuka Precision Health, Inc.

Learn to Play Ukulele and Discover its Joy, Right on Your Device!
Ever dreamed of strumming a ukulele's beautiful melody? With Ukulele Simulator, learning and playing become one. Whether to learn a new tune or play a familiar song, you're a tap away from a musical moment. • Real Ukulele Sounds: Dive into genuine ukulele atmosphere with every note you play, sampled directly from real ukuleles.
• Chord Library: Learn, play, and perfect new chords with an extensive chord library. As you learn more, you can play more songs with confidence.

• Built-in Metronome: As you practice and learn, ensure you play in rhythm with the integrated metronome.

• Learning for Beginners: If you're eager to learn, the intuitive interface offers an easy play and learning curve. Either tap or hold on the screen to play notes and swipe to strum.

bluejetty:00074093:ios.description:
This application is designed to provide up to date information about bush fire data in Western Australia, for iPhone and iPad users.
It utilises data from the Department of Fire and Emergency Services (WA) data feeds on fires, wind data from the Bureau of Meteorology with your current location provided by the iPhone GPS.
Using this information the application is able to provide a list of fires showing the nearest ones first, helping you to understand your current situation.
The information is reliant on both the accuracy of the iPhone GPS and the data recorded on the DFES website. 
This application does not cache any fire data, so Internet access (either Wireless. 3G or GPRS) is required to access the data. 
Be aware that while P4G has utilised "best efforts" to provide this information to you, it is not intended to replace other sources of information on the fire situation near you. Also remember that fire and weather can change quickly.
© Government of Western Australia (Department of Fire and Emergency Services). For current information go to www.emergency.wa.gov.au
Follow P4G on twitter at P4G_Apps

Maximize your efficiency and automate repetitive tasks with Self Clicker, the ultimate tool for automatic screen tapping! Whether you’re gaming, filling out forms, or managing any tap-intensive activity, Self Clicker provides a reliable and customizable solution that works effortlessly.

Automated Clicking: Facilitates the automation of routine tasks by simulating user taps, reducing manual effort

Auto-Refresh: Enables automatic page refreshing, aiding users in monitoring time-sensitive content such as discounts or available slots.

Auto-Scroll: Allows for hands-free reading by automatically scrolling through web pages, beneficial for reading articles or books online.

Key Features:

1. Intelligent Self Tapping
- Automate taps with customizable speed and intervals.
- Set precise tap points anywhere on the screen.
- Supports single-tap, multi-tap, and swipe gestures.

2. Advanced Customization
- Create and save multiple tap configurations for different tasks.
- Fine-tune tap intervals to suit your needs, from milliseconds to seconds.
- Adjust swipe speed and direction for more complex actions.

3. Multi-Tasking Ready
- Run taps in the background while using other apps.
- Compatible with games, social media platforms, and productivity tools.

4. Simple and Intuitive Interface
- Easily set up tap locations using an overlay controller.
- Drag-and-drop tap markers for quick configuration.
- One-tap start and stop for ease of use.

5. Scripting Support
- Create custom scripts to execute advanced tap sequences.
- Program loops, delays, and conditional taps for more complex automation.

6. Secure and Reliable
- Works without requiring a jailbreak or rooting your device.
- No data collection—your privacy is our priority.

7. Compatibility
- Supports all screen sizes and orientations (landscape and portrait modes).
- Works seamlessly with popular games, productivity apps, and more.

Perfect For:
- Automating repetitive game tasks (e.g., farming resources, clicking rewards).
- Speeding up workflows for apps that require frequent tapping.
- Accessibility support for users with motor impairments.

Why Self Clicker?
Slef Clicker simplifies your life by saving time and effort, letting you focus on what truly matters. Designed for gamers, productivity enthusiasts, and accessibility users, this app delivers unparalleled flexibility and performance.

bluejetty:00128082:ios.description:
Welcome to Solitaire Stories, home of the world’s greatest card game! Solitaire Stories offers all of the classic gameplay that fans of the card game have come to know and love, from classic Klondike Quick Play games, to Draw 3, thrilling features like online Multiplayer, as well as the beloved Spider and Tri Peaks game modes! 
But why stop there? Solitaire Stories also offers a totally unique way to play with stories. Each story is a progressive journey through increasingly difficult levels, with a new narrative, unique deck designs, gameplay environments, and a new soundtrack!
When you play through a story, you’ll earn coins and unlock new upgrades and customization options! You can always spend your earnings in the Prize Pod, then create the ultimate gameplay setting in Your Deck.
Daily challenges and contests keeps things fresh by offering players new tasks every day and an exciting way to stretch your skills.
Climb to the top of the global leaderboard and flaunt your skills to your friends! With dozens of different modes and features, regular content updates, and you’ve got the ultimate Solitaire experience!
KEY FEATURES
• Game hints when you feel stuck
• Frequently added new content
• Online Multiplayer
• Prize Pod rewards
• Your Deck (custom gameplay environment design)
• Gameplay Statistics
• Progressive difficulty deals
• Replay any level
• Right hand mode
• Left hand mode
• Portrait mode
• Landscape mode
• Themed decks with stories
• Game Center global leaderboards
• Klondike: Draw 1 and Draw 3 modes
• Spider: 1, 2, and 4 Suit modes
• Tri Peaks game mode
• Achievements and player “level” ranks
• Modern deck art and designs
• Unlimited undo
• Autocomplete game functionality
• Frequent (monthly) updates and features
• Fun, artistic environments, characters, and animations

bluejetty:00079788:ios.description:
Boring Report is an app that aims to remove sensationalism from the news and makes it boring to read. In today's world, catchy headlines and articles often distract readers from the actual facts and relevant information.
By utilizing the power of advanced AI language models capable of generating human-like text, Boring Report processes exciting news articles and transforms them into the content that you see. This helps readers focus on the essential details and minimizes the impact of sensationalism.
With Boring Report, you can:
- Access a daily list of news headlines made boring with the power of AI
- Experience a clutter-free reading environment designed for focus and comprehension
- Easily access the source links of the transformed articles for reference and comparison
The boring summaries provided are not a substitute for the original article. We encourage users to refer to the original for a complete understanding of the articles.

bluejetty:00075697:ios.name: Wild Horse Family Life Game
bluejetty:00075697:ios.summary: Embark on an unforgettable journey in the vast and immersive world of "Wild Horse Life Care," where every hoofbeat tells a story of adventure, companionship, and the boundless spirit of these majestic creatures. Dive into a richly detailed
bluejetty:00075697:ios.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey in the vast and immersive world of "Wild Horse Life Care," where every hoofbeat tells a story of adventure, companionship, and the boundless spirit of these majestic creatures. Dive into a richly detailed open world where the beauty of nature meets the thrill of exploration, all within an engaging MMO experience that celebrates the art of horsemanship.
Explore a Living World:
Step into a sprawling open world brimming with lush landscapes, from serene meadows to dense forests and rugged mountains. Every corner of this expansive realm invites exploration, promising hidden treasures, breathtaking vistas, and encounters with diverse wildlife. Roam freely with your trusted companion, forging a deep bond as you navigate through dynamically changing environments that reflect the seasons and weather patterns.
Forge Unbreakable Bonds:
In "Horse Life Care," every horse is unique, with its own personality, preferences, and needs. Tame and nurture a variety of beautiful horses, from spirited Mustangs to elegant Thoroughbreds, and develop a profound connection through gentle care and dedicated training. Witness their growth and development as they evolve from untamed spirits into loyal partners, ready to conquer challenges alongside you.
Master the Art of Horsemanship:
Immerse yourself in the artistry of equestrian disciplines such as show jumping and dressage. Refine your skills through intuitive gameplay mechanics that capture the essence of real-world horsemanship. Compete in thrilling show jumping events where precision and timing are key, or showcase your horse's grace and poise in elegant dressage performances that highlight your bond and training achievements.
Create Your Horse Sanctuary:
Build and customize your dream ranch, a sanctuary where horses thrive and relationships flourish. Design and expand your facilities to accommodate different breeds and their specific needs, from spacious pastures for grazing to state-of-the-art stables equipped with modern comforts. Personalize every aspect of your ranch with decorative elements and functional upgrades, transforming it into a haven that reflects your dedication and style.
Immerse Yourself in Role-Playing Adventures:
Delve into rich narrative quests and engaging storylines that unfold across the expansive landscape of "Horse Life Care." Embark on epic journeys to uncover mysteries, assist local communities, and forge lasting friendships with NPCs and fellow players alike. Whether you're solving mysteries of the past or participating in lively ranch parties, every interaction deepens your connection to the world and its inhabitants.
Experience True Freedom and Community:
Enjoy the freedom to play your way in a vibrant online community of fellow horse enthusiasts. Collaborate with friends in cooperative tasks, organize thrilling cross-country expeditions, or simply relax and socialize during leisurely rides through picturesque scenery. "Horse Life Care" fosters a supportive environment where players can share their passion for horses, exchange tips on care and training, and celebrate each other's achievements.
Conclusion:
Discover the unparalleled joy of caring for and bonding with horses in "Horse Life Care," where every gallop brings new discoveries and every interaction deepens the bond between horse and rider. With its captivating blend of exploration, simulation, and community-driven gameplay, this MMO adventure invites you to embrace the essence of a horse lover's dream. Saddle up, explore the open world, and embark on an unforgettable journey into the heart of equine companionship.

bluejetty:00016531:ios.summary:
You woke up in a town that seems to remember you… even though you don't remember it. 
Search for hidden objects, discover clues, solve puzzles, battle sinister creatures, and restore a haunted mansion as you investigate the mystery surroun
bluejetty:00016531:ios.description:
You woke up in a town that seems to remember you… even though you don't remember it. 
Search for hidden objects, discover clues, solve puzzles, battle sinister creatures, and restore a haunted mansion as you investigate the mystery surrounding Coastal Hill. Every discovery brings you closer to the truth—and deeper into the town's secrets.
IMMERSE YOURSELF IN A MYSTERIOUS STORY
Every resident seems to know more than they're willing to share. Search and find hidden objects, spot the clues, solve brain teasers, and meet intriguing characters as you uncover what lies beneath the city's peaceful facade.
EXPLORE 60+ DETAILED SCENES
 Seek and find objects across more than 60 stunning locations. Complete over 5,000 quests, collect more than 1,600 unique items, and master 18 search modes, including Spot the Difference, Silhouettes, Find Pairs, and more.
DECORATE AN OLD MANSION
 Bring a haunted mansion back to life and uncover the secrets hidden within its walls. Renovate rooms, choose decorations, and create a home that reflects your style.
CREATE YOUR AVATAR 
 Customize your character with unique hairstyles, outfits, boots, and accessories that provide useful power-ups and bonuses.
TEAM UP WITH FRIENDS
 Start your own guild, invite your friends and compete with players from around the world. Find hidden objects, fight monsters in card-matching battles, build Wonders of the World, complete mystery adventure quests, and enjoy a wide variety of mini-games, including Three Tiles, Puzzles, Mahjong, Flasks, Bingo, Words, and more.
Coastal Hill is a free game, but some in-game items may be purchased for real money.
The mystery continues every month with new hidden object scenes, investigation quests, seasonal events, collectibles, and generous rewards.
Join our official communities and stay tuned on the latest news, interesting facts, and more cool stuff: 
Facebook https://www.facebook.com/coastalhillmystery
Instagram https://www.instagram.com/coastalhillmystery
If you have any questions or comments, feel free to contact us at info@adoregames.com or use in-game chat.
Privacy Policy: http://o.adoregames.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: http://o.adoregames.com/terms-of-service

Search for hidden objects, discover clues, solve puzzles, battle sinister creatures, and restore a haunted mansion as you investigate the mystery surrounding Coastal Hill. Every discovery brings you closer to the truth—and deeper into the town's secrets.

IMMERSE YOURSELF IN A MYSTERIOUS STORY
Every resident seems to know more than they're willing to share. Search and find hidden objects, spot the clues, solve brain teasers, and meet intriguing characters as you uncover what lies beneath the city's peaceful facade.

EXPLORE 60+ DETAILED SCENES
 Seek and find objects across more than 60 stunning locations. Complete over 5,000 quests, collect more than 1,600 unique items, and master 18 search modes, including Spot the Difference, Silhouettes, Find Pairs, and more.

DECORATE AN OLD MANSION
 Bring a haunted mansion back to life and uncover the secrets hidden within its walls. Renovate rooms, choose decorations, and create a home that reflects your style.

CREATE YOUR AVATAR 
 Customize your character with unique hairstyles, outfits, boots, and accessories that provide useful power-ups and bonuses.

TEAM UP WITH FRIENDS
 Start your own guild, invite your friends and compete with players from around the world. Find hidden objects, fight monsters in card-matching battles, build Wonders of the World, complete mystery adventure quests, and enjoy a wide variety of mini-games, including Three Tiles, Puzzles, Mahjong, Flasks, Bingo, Words, and more.

Coastal Hill is a free game, but some in-game items may be purchased for real money.

The mystery continues every month with new hidden object scenes, investigation quests, seasonal events, collectibles, and generous rewards.

Join our official communities and stay tuned on the latest news, interesting facts, and more cool stuff: 
Facebook https://www.facebook.com/coastalhillmystery
Instagram https://www.instagram.com/coastalhillmystery

If you have any questions or comments, feel free to contact us at info@adoregames.com or use in-game chat.

Privacy Policy: http://o.adoregames.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: http://o.adoregames.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00038131:ios.description:
This application is for Quebec residents.
Do you know how and where to get rid of products you don’t use?
Ça va où? quickly answers your questions and helps you sort your products and materials, whether they belong in an ecocentre, a drop-off site, the recycling bin, the organic waste bin, a special collection or even the trash bin.
The application lets you :
● Easily find where and how to get rid of different products and materials you do not want or need according to your municipality and geolocalized position, like : batteries, light bulbs, metals, plastics, clothing, organic matter, bulky items, electronic products, etc.
● Quickly display ecocentres and drop-off sites in Quebec with an interactive geolocalized map.
● Display the contact information for ecocentres and drop-off sites closest to you.
● Get sorting advice for different products.
You can find information about the reuse and recycling of over 1000 types of products sold in Quebec.
Recycling in Quebec
Almost ¾ of Quebecers sort their waste, though more than half admit not always being sure if they put the right product in the right bin. We want to help people who want to better recycle but don’t always have the right information. Municipalities offer many ecocentres and drop-off sites and with the Ça va où? app, it’ll be easier for you to find them.
Notes about access requests :
The application uses geolocalization technology.
This access is necessary in order to find the closest drop-off points for each user.
When you open the app, it will ask you your default municipality in order to display the correct municipal service information (ecocentres, different collections, etc.) for your area of residence.
The Ça va où? app now offers a game to practice your sorting instincts! Play and try to win all the badges!
### THE ÇA VA OÙ? APP DOES NOT COLLECT ANY PERSONAL DATA ###

bluejetty:00182669:ios.description:
Can you stop the Insurgency? From the creator of Plague Inc. comes a unique and deeply engaging political/military strategic simulation. 
The war is ‘over’ - but we all know that doesn’t mean anything. To stabilise the country, you need to balance military and civilian priorities to win the hearts and minds of the people, whilst also stopping insurgents from seizing power!
Rebel Inc. is the brand new game from the creator of ‘Plague Inc.’ - one of the most popular paid games ever with over 200 million players. Brilliantly executed with beautiful graphics and critically acclaimed gameplay - Rebel Inc. offers a deeply engaging, strategic challenge inspired by the complexities and consequences of modern counter insurgency.
◈◈◈ #1 top paid game globally ◈◈◈
▶ “Rebel Inc. lets everyone wrestle with the messy challenges of post-conflict recovery and better understand the complex realities of building peace.” - World Bank Global Lead for Stability, Peace and Security
▶ "Highly rewarding spiritual sequel to one of the App Store's biggest hits." - Pocket Tactics
▶ "Surprisingly sophisticated... even better than some of the stabilization training software I have seen in government use" - PAXsims
▶ "Rebel Inc. is fascinating and fun" - 148Apps.com
▶ "Another great game and a worthy successor to Plague Inc" - App Store review
▶ "If you love strategy games then this is the game for you" - App Store review
▶ "Brilliant game, the gameplay is interesting and the strategy is intuitive!" - App Store review
▶ "Unlike anything I’ve played on here before" - App Store review
◈◈◈
Features:
● Stabilise 10 richly modeled regions
● Innovative representation of counter insurgency tactics 
● Fund realistic initiatives to empower the local government
● Highly detailed, hyper-realistic world based on extensive research
● Intelligent strategic and tactical AI
● Sophisticated narrative algorithms shaped by your decisions
● 9 unique governors with radically different abilities
● Conduct large-scale Operations in Campaign mode
● Play new generated Challenges every week
● 23 Official Scenarios including disease outbreaks, helicopters and advanced insurgents
● Comprehensive in-game help and tutorial system
● Full Save/Load functionality
● Internet connectivity not required
An important note:
Although a fictional game, Rebel Inc. looks at important real world issues and we have made every effort to deal with them sensitively. The game has been extensively researched and has been developed in cooperation with leading regional politicians, business people and journalists as well as international charities, experts and governments.
Special sale price to celebrate the launch of the game!
◈◈◈
I’ve got lots of plans for updates! Get in touch and let me know what you want to see.
James (the designer)
Contact me here:
www.ndemiccreations.com/en/1-support

bluejetty:00016802:ios.description:
"Best music app ever" 
Music TV™ is the only app in the iTunes App Store that automatically scans your iPhone, iPad or iPod touch music library songs and displays the corresponding YouTube video. It’s perfect for parties, or simply for adding fun and flair to a personal entertainment experience. 
With Music TV you can also add YouTube music videos and playlists to your playlist, so in effect, you have unlimited, access to music video and audio!! 
Music TV offers a range of special features, including: 
- The ability to create custom playlists with songs from your music library or directly from YouTube!
- Access to playlists on caramba-apps.com and the YouTube Music Chart TOP-100
- Access your YouTube account and import your playlists directly in Music TV!
- The possibility to store and share your playlists on Facebook and Twitter and have other Music TV users play it 
- Full screen video mode 
- The option to manually select music videos 
- The freedom to mirror music videos to Apple TV and Chromecast
- Several options to customize your player, including hiding the status bar
- Option to filter explicit content: let your kids use Music TV safely!
Plus, Music TV features an incredible self-learning algorithm that actually retrieves music videos faster and more accurate as more users enjoy the app. 
DOWNLOAD MUSIC TV TODAY...and enjoy the feeling of the good old music television channels!
MORE INFORMATION: https://www.caramba-apps.com/musictv
NOTE: This app contains an auto-renewable subscription. The payment for the subscription will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription provides you unlimited playlists, a sleep timer, and removes all ads.
The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Perfect Posture helps you improve posture, strengthen your back and neck, increase mobility, and stay active with guided workouts you can do at home.

- One-time workouts
- Popular Hot Plans

POSTURE, BACK & NECK EXERCISES
Find targeted workouts and stretches for:
- Posture correction and improvement
- Forward head posture and text neck
- Rounded shoulders
- Upper, middle, and lower back
- Neck and shoulder mobility
- Back and neck flexibility
- Core strength and stability
- Everyday stiffness and tension
- Scoliosis support
200+ GUIDED EXERCISES
Explore posture exercises, stretching, yoga, Pilates, mobility work, core exercises, bodyweight training, warm-ups, and cooldown routines.
Clear demonstrations and Voice Coach make each workout easy to follow.
30-DAY PROGRAMS
Follow structured plans for posture correction, back and neck workouts, rounded shoulders, forward head posture, scoliosis support, yoga, Pilates, plank challenges, stretching, office workouts, and relaxation.
MADE FOR EVERYDAY LIFE
Perfect Posture is ideal if you spend a lot of time sitting, working at a desk, studying, or using your phone.
Most exercises require no equipment, so you can train at home, at work, or while traveling.
MAKE WORKOUTS YOUR OWN

- Adjust rest time
- Edit workout plans
- Create your own workouts

- Achievements

- Daily reminders
MORE FEATURES
- Offline workouts

- Cloud synchronization
- Multiple languages
- Health and fitness articles
- Diet plans
- Exercise demonstrations

bluejetty:00179386:ios.summary: Can't sleep? Try Away, a high-quality sleep ambience app by award-winning audio technology innovator Franz Bruckhoff. Away simulates a rich forest full of nature sounds to explore and discover, day and night, from morning til evening. Adjus
bluejetty:00179386:ios.description:
Can't sleep? Try Away, a high-quality sleep ambience app by award-winning audio technology innovator Franz Bruckhoff. Away simulates a rich forest full of nature sounds to explore and discover, day and night, from morning til evening. Adjust the daytime and move the virtual microphone around to find your favorite spot to unwind and sleep. Away features one of the most advanced nature sound field engines in the world, delivering an unprecedented nature audio listening experience. Hear the forest come to life around you. Get Away today, sleep great tonight!
Taptanium™ certified nature audio means that you hear only crystal clear nature sounds with absolutely zero human made noise intrusions. No people, no airplanes, no cars. Just nature. Infinite playback. Taptanium™ certified nature audio comes from the best sources such as Hawaii and has been mastered to perfection with the highest attainable level of attention to detail, utilizing artificial intelligence to detect even the most distant human-made noise intrusions that humans are almost incapable of recognizing under normal conditions. Only the highest quality nature sounds in the world are able to receive this certification.
Away features Taptanium™ neural 3D audio™. If you put on headphones, Away can create an incredible sense of immersion. The nature and water plays all around you, not just on your ears. This is called externalization, and it's encoded in a way that your brain naturally decodes as if you were there.
You will sleep, relax, meditate and focus better with Away because Away masks unwanted noise. Your ears will love Away because Away plays soothing high-quality nature sounds recorded in 3D. Your eyes will love Away because the forest comes as a motion-controlled 3D parallax illustration with daytime transitions. Get the great sleep and productivity you deserve.
Hear the wind and leaves swirling all around you, birds singing during the day, Hawaiian Coqui frogs singing at night and distant American Bull Frogs resonating through the valley. Get closer to the river or waterfall or retreat to the calm pond in the back with ducks during certain times of the day. In the morning, listen to the funny sounds of wild Hawaiian chickens recorded on the beautiful Garden Island of Kauai in 3D. Hear birds waking up and birds singing happily. Away is a treasure chest of sounds. And if you like, blend in music specifically composed and conducted for Away in Hollywood.
Away includes so many things:
• The Great Away Forest with a great variety of nature sounds to discover
• Find your favorite spot to listen or sleep within the forest
• Change the time of day and hear the soundscape adapt
• Unlimited playback time, infinitely looped (very long loops)
• Taptanium™ neural 3D audio™ (incredibly immersive)
• Taptanium™ certified quality nature audio
• Mixer: Mix and match some extra nature sounds and music
• Adjustable fade-out and sleep timer
• Full background audio support
• Universal app for iPhone and iPad
• No in-app purchases
• No subscription
• Beautiful audiovisual experience
• Music composed for Away in Hollywood
• NEW: Optimized for iPhone X, XR, XS & XS Max, 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro Max & iPad Pro!
Get Away today, sleep great tonight!
≈ Questions? ≈ 
Tweet @taptanium, email franz taptanium com or send an email through the in-app contact support page. Happy to hear from you! Made with lots of love in Germany.

Away features one of the most advanced nature sound field engines in the world, delivering an unprecedented nature audio listening experience. Hear the forest come to life around you. Get Away today, sleep great tonight!

Taptanium™ certified nature audio means that you hear only crystal clear nature sounds with absolutely zero human made noise intrusions. No people, no airplanes, no cars. Just nature. Infinite playback. Taptanium™ certified nature audio comes from the best sources such as Hawaii and has been mastered to perfection with the highest attainable level of attention to detail, utilizing artificial intelligence to detect even the most distant human-made noise intrusions that humans are almost incapable of recognizing under normal conditions. Only the highest quality nature sounds in the world are able to receive this certification.

Away features Taptanium™ neural 3D audio™. If you put on headphones, Away can create an incredible sense of immersion. The nature and water plays all around you, not just on your ears. This is called externalization, and it's encoded in a way that your brain naturally decodes as if you were there.

You will sleep, relax, meditate and focus better with Away because Away masks unwanted noise. Your ears will love Away because Away plays soothing high-quality nature sounds recorded in 3D. Your eyes will love Away because the forest comes as a motion-controlled 3D parallax illustration with daytime transitions. Get the great sleep and productivity you deserve.

Hear the wind and leaves swirling all around you, birds singing during the day, Hawaiian Coqui frogs singing at night and distant American Bull Frogs resonating through the valley. Get closer to the river or waterfall or retreat to the calm pond in the back with ducks during certain times of the day. In the morning, listen to the funny sounds of wild Hawaiian chickens recorded on the beautiful Garden Island of Kauai in 3D. Hear birds waking up and birds singing happily. Away is a treasure chest of sounds. And if you like, blend in music specifically composed and conducted for Away in Hollywood.

1,000여 가지 생활 영역에서 활동하는 250만 고수 중

bluejetty:00039485:ios.description:
Tawakkalna Emergency app is the official app in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia for managing emergency cases and community protection. It has played a significant role in containing the spread of COVID-19 and was developed by the Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA).
At the beginning of Tawakkalna launch, it aimed to contribute to the management of relief efforts by electronically granting permits during the “Curfew Period” for both government & private-sector workers as well as individuals. This in turn helped in limiting the spread of Covid-19 virus in the Kingdom.
During the “Return with Caution” period, Tawakkalna App launched several important new services that contribute to achieving a safe return, most notably clarifying the health status of its users through colored codes with the highest levels of security and privacy.

bluejetty:00184670:ios.description:
The Best Seat in Tennis just got better!
Newly upgraded for 2026, Tennis TV is the official live and on-demand online video streaming app of the ATP Tour. Stream live tennis from every ATP Tour tournament, as well as full match replays, classic matches, highlights, draws and live scores as they update in real time. Watch 2,500+ ATP singles and doubles matches each year from every ATP Masters 1000, ATP 500 and ATP 250 tournament, plus the Nitto ATP Finals and Next Gen ATP Finals presented by PIF.
For the first time, enjoy tennis 24/7 on-the-go with our always-on channel, plus all the latest and greatest clips from the Tour with new vertical video Moments and Stories so you never miss a shot.
Get a Premium subscription today and enjoy unlimited access to Tennis TV, including spoiler mode which hides scores and timelines at the tap of a button, or register a free account and enjoy a personalised selection of highlights, hot shots and more.
Features (*new for 2026):
- Live streams from over 55 ATP Tournaments a year, giving uninterrupted access to top-tier tennis throughout the season
- 2,500+ live matches a year, each one available on demand within minutes
- Draws* and order of play featuring scores that update in real-time
- Non-stop action available around the clock with Tennis TV 24/7*
- Improved look and feel, with personalised content tailored for you*
- Scroll through thousands of the best vertical video Moments and Stories from on and off the court*
- Hide timelines and scores with spoiler mode – never have a match ruined again
- Watch how you want with quick highlights, daily compilations, 10-minute match highlights, full-length replays and more
- Dive into over 40,000 hours of full match replays with the Tennis TV library. Enjoy classic matches dating back to 1990 featuring Roger Federer, Rafael Nadal, Novak Djokovic, Andy Murray, Andre Agassi, Pete Sampras and more
- Follow your favourite players and never miss a match
- All ATP Masters 1000s including the BNP Paribas Open (Indian Wells), Miami Open presented by Itau, Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters, Mutua Madrid Open, Internazionali BNL d'Italia (Rome Open), National Bank Open Presented By Rogers, Cincinnati Open, Rolex Shanghai Masters and the Rolex Paris Masters.
- All ATP 500s, ATP 250s plus the prestigious Nitto ATP Finals, Next Gen ATP Finals presented by PIF and the United Cup.
Tennis TV Premium requires a paid subscription. All subscriptions auto-renew, but you can cancel anytime. If you purchase your subscription with in-app payment, you can manage this via your device settings.
Please note that Grand Slams, Davis Cup, Billie Jean King Cup, Laver Cup, WTA matches, ATP 250 outside courts, Challenger Tour matches and qualifiers are not available on Tennis TV. 
Enjoying Tennis TV? Please leave us a review on the App Store.
Terms and Conditions: https://www.tennistv.com/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Notice: https://www.tennistv.com/privacy-notice
Help Centre: https://support.tennistv.com/hc

bluejetty:00186124:ios.developer: Kids Academy Co apps: Preschool & Kindergarten Learning Kids Games, Educational Books, Free Songs
bluejetty:00186124:ios.summary:
** Fun EDUCATIONAL game for toddlers of AGE 2 and up
** Developed with certified child psychologists
**12 beautiful mini-game boards
** 4 difficulty levels
About the game:
This game is the third and latest game in our Pairs matching series
bluejetty:00186124:ios.description:
** Fun EDUCATIONAL game for toddlers of AGE 2 and up
** Developed with certified child psychologists
**12 beautiful mini-game boards
** 4 difficulty levels
About the game:
This game is the third and latest game in our Pairs matching series. Like previous games in this series, it is based on pairs matching but also introduces more challenging concepts such as logical groups, counting, numbers, and associations. In most cases this game requires the child to understand WHAT he sees and PROCESS the screen concept in order to make the correct match as opposed to visual similarity.
The game is designed to enhance the following:
– Logical thinking
- Quantitative perception (counting and numbers)
- Problem solving
- Logical thinking
- Visual perception
Game Boards:
The game consists of 12 boards ordered in an ascending level of difficulty. The boards were carefully chosen in order to represent basic concepts from the child's world.
Whose tail is it: Match each animal with its tail.
Combinations: Match by color AND shape.
Logical: Match each object with its typical color.
Where is my hat: Match each character with the hat that fits its profession.
Household items: Match objects that serve similar functionality.
Geometric shapes: Match similar shapes with differing size and color.
Flowers: Count and match flowers by color and shape combinations.
It’s my party: Match birthday party items by number.
Association: Match items that usually go together.
The cookie jar: Count and place cookies in the jar by number.
Food: Match different foods by their main ingredient.
Party time: Match each child with the right props by color and shape.
TinyHands Games:
TinyHands Sorting Series
A set of sorting games designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as shape, color, size seasons and animals. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level starting from basic sorting followed by more complex context based sorting and classification environments.
TinyHands Towers Series
A set of stacking games. The game is designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as: big VS. small, before VS. after, and bottom VS. top. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level.
TinyHands What's My Pair Series
A series of three pair matching games. The game challenges the child to match pairs, initially based on visual aspects alone and in more advanced screens based on logic and understanding of card content.
TinyHands First Words Series
A set of vocabulary games for children of age 1.5 and up.
The game consists of 10 boards, each focused on a different theme from the child's world such as shapes, colors, clothes, animals and vehicles.
TinyHands Raccoon TreeHouse
This game is intended for toddlers aged 3+. The game presents 12 boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.
TinyHands Town Center
Educational game recommended for age 3+. This game includes 10 beautiful boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.
TinyHands Connect The Dots
The game consists of 12 mini game boards each presents a beautiful and magical scene. Each board contains several parts. The parts can be completed by connecting the numbered dots in a specific order. Upon completion, each part is dragged to gradually build an object. When all parts are drawn the scene is magically created and revealed. Designed for children aged 3+.
Note for parents:
Like all our games, this game is designed to provide quality playtime for parents and children together. Playing along with your children is highly recommended and will surely make them benefit the most from this app and help them expand their vocabulary.

Logical: Match each object with its typical color.
Where is my hat: Match each character with the hat that fits its profession.
Household items: Match objects that serve similar functionality.
Geometric shapes: Match similar shapes with differing size and color.
Flowers: Count and match flowers by color and shape combinations.
It’s my party: Match birthday party items by number.
Association: Match items that usually go together.
The cookie jar: Count and place cookies in the jar by number.
Food: Match different foods by their main ingredient.
Party time: Match each child with the right props by color and shape.

TinyHands Games:
 
TinyHands Sorting Series
A set of sorting games designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as shape, color, size seasons and animals. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level starting from basic sorting followed by more complex context based sorting and classification environments.

TinyHands Towers Series
A set of stacking games. The game is designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as: big VS. small, before VS. after, and bottom VS. top. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level.

TinyHands What's My Pair Series
A series of three pair matching games. The game challenges the child to match pairs, initially based on visual aspects alone and in more advanced screens based on logic and understanding of card content.

TinyHands First Words Series
A set of vocabulary games for children of age 1.5 and up.
The game consists of 10 boards, each focused on a different theme from the child's world such as shapes, colors, clothes, animals and vehicles.

TinyHands Raccoon TreeHouse
This game is intended for toddlers aged 3+. The game presents 12 boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.

TinyHands Town Center
Educational game recommended for age 3+. This game includes 10 beautiful boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.

TinyHands Connect The Dots
The game consists of 12 mini game boards each presents a beautiful and magical scene. Each board contains several parts. The parts can be completed by connecting the numbered dots in a specific order. Upon completion, each part is dragged to gradually build an object. When all parts are drawn the scene is magically created and revealed. Designed for children aged 3+.

Note for parents:
Like all our games, this game is designed to provide quality playtime for parents and children together. Playing along with your children is highly recommended and will surely make them benefit the most from this app and help them expand their vocabulary.

bluejetty:00023263:ios.description:
The sequel to the epic Shadow of Death with over 10 million downloads worldwide.
Shadow of Death 2 continues the story of Maximus - a warrior with an erased memory. He wanders in the dark, fights with the demons to bring back light to Aurora, the land he once lived, and to rescue the ones he once loved. And now, warriors, are you ready to join Maximus in the next chapter of Aurora? Challenge the enemies, and show them what you've got!

Experience brand new combat styles in the tale of Shadow of Death 2: Awakening! Upgrade your weapons, level up your skill, then beat the enemies off with sassy combos. Attack the dark force with your stylish actions. Show off your skills and let them have the taste of your blades.
▶ BEAUTIFUL RUINED WORLDS
Explore the dark fantasy world of Aurora with 6 spanking new maps. More challenges and epic fights are waiting for you in the dark, where you might have the chance to meet Leviathan - the mythical dragon with a deadly and destructive breath!
▶ THE HUGEST BOSSES EVER
Confront enormous monsters during your adventure. Get ready to challenge mysterious creatures that seem to exist only in the legends! Fight off giant jellyfishes, dragons, and more. It's gonna be an epic 1 vs 100 battle and it's gonna be fun!
▶ KEY FEATURES
- Exciting RPG world in your pocket
- 5 different characters with unique combat styles
- Customize your heroes with various skins and weapons
- Play anytime, anywhere in the offline challenging mode
- Level up the game with online PvP battles

bluejetty:00169893:ios.description:
Welcome to "Alphabet for Kids" - the learning game, designed especially for curious kids like yours! Are you ready to explore the exciting world of letters and words? Join our friendly character, Fluffy, as your trusted guide on a magical game journey to master the ABCs.
How to Play:
In "Alphabet for Kids," you get to dive headfirst into the fascinating realm of the alphabet.
Learn Your ABCs: Discover the letters of the alphabet in a fun and interactive way. With your finger as your magic wand, you'll learn how to write each letter with a simple stroke. It's like drawing your favorite characters on screen!
Collect Words: As you become a letter pro, start collecting your very first words! Watch how these letters come together to create words, and see your vocabulary grow right before your eyes. The more you learn, the more words you'll have in your collection.
Mini-Games Galore: Learning doesn't have to be boring! Enjoy a variety of mini-games that turn education into a thrilling adventure. From letter matching challenges to word puzzles, there's no shortage of fun and learning in these games.
What You'll Gain:
"Alphabet for Kids" is not just a game - it's a fantastic learning experience that's perfect for kids like you:
Super Finger Skills: Get ready to impress everyone with your amazing finger skills! Learning to write letters with your finger helps you develop precise control and coordination. It's like finger painting on your screen!
Stay Super Focused: Sharpen your attention as you explore letters, create words, and conquer mini-games. "Alphabet for Kids" will help you become a master of concentration, all while having tons of fun.
Unlock Your Creativity: Learning can be a creative adventure! Use your imagination as you discover new letters and words. Who knows, you might even come up with your own fantastic stories!
With "Alphabet for Kids," you'll embark on an educational journey that's filled with excitement and wonder. It's time to explore, create, and learn while having the most amazing time!

bluejetty:00044729:ios.name: LogiNext Driver App
bluejetty:00044729:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00044729:ios.description:
Enable the delivery personnel to perform their tasks with precision, expertise, and aplomb through this
versatile and intuitive application which helps delivery personnel to plan their day as they streamline
their schedule, optimize delivery routes, deliver on-time, optimize service time, electronic validate
authenticity of deliveries, capture feedback, and decrease the overall turnaround time for all the
deliveries performed.
Now, share the power of optimization with the delivery personnel for effective execution of strategic
decisions. Ensure the delivery movement follows all service level protocols directed to enhance end-
customer delight.
Retail, e-commerce, FMCG, courier, manufacturing, logistics & transport, pharmaceutical, and food &
beverage are a few industries that have benefited from LogiNext Driver App and its resource engagement and
management capabilities.
LogiNext’s flagship product Mile helps enterprises schedule deliveries, plan delivery sequence, allocate
trips, track resources, optimize delivery routes, and ensure quality delivery fulfillment with suitable
feedback capture, electronic proof of delivery, and subsequent analytics generated post successful
completion of tasks. The operations manager can utilize ‘Mile’ to streamline the entire last mile logistics
of the company. LogiNext Driver App, working with Mile, helps cover all tracking and optimizing scenarios to
create a consolidated planning and management system for the enterprise.
With LogiNext Driver App, the delivery personnel can:
- Systematically follow the optimized delivery schedule
- Locate addresses with the exact directional and traffic-avoiding suggestions
- Optimize their routes as they pursue their order deliveries
- Receive instant messages from the managers (or from LogiNext Mile’s delivery management
system) in case of order updates
- Interact and chat amongst other delivery personnel to avail ground-level information about the
destination
- Reach delivery destinations on time
- Validate all fulfilled deliveries by clicking a photo of the delivered product and taking a signature
of the receiver
- Record valuable customer feedback
- Mark the current delivery as successful and move on to the next delivery, and then the next, as
they fulfill all deliveries and save on overall turnaround time.
With LogiNext Driver App, the operations and logistics managers can:
- Enhance tracking visibility for all moving resources
- Utilize the quick reaction time enabled through the application to handle service disruptions or
potential customer satisfaction opportunities
- Record accurate service and delivery time for better planning and forecasting
- Track the availability and activity of delivery personnel for better compliance of strategic plans
- Record all delivery validations and customer feedback in real-time
- Easily communicate with on-field delivery personnel by sending them direct messages
Some striking features within LogiNext Driver App include:
- Delivery Route Optimization
- Customer Location Mapping
- Digital Pick-up/Delivery Run Sheets
- Centralized Reporting Module
- ePOD/e-sign (Electronic proof of deliveries/Electronic signatures)
- COD (Cash on Delivery)
- Barcode Scanning
- Field Force Attendance Management
- Fleet Management
- Fleet Tracking
- Field Service Automation
About LogiNext:
LogiNext leads the field workforce and logistics optimization solutions market with its industry
benchmarked products for last mile, field force, on-demand delivery, and linehaul express management.
With more than 250 enterprise clients across North America, Middle-East, South and Southeast Asia,
LogiNext have been accepted as the fastest growing SaaS enterprise in its solution space.

bluejetty:00065859:ios.description:
The classic Carrom disc pool board game - now online with live voice chat at every table.
Flick the striker, pot your pucks, sink the queen, and prove you are the sharpest board game player in the room. Easy to learn in a single match. Hard to master in a thousand.
PLAY IT YOUR WAY
- Online multiplayer: fast 1v1 carrom matches against real players
- Play with friends: invite a friend and open a private carrom board
- Offline single player: practise against smart bots with no internet
- 2 players, one device: pass-and-play carrom with a friend beside you
- Arabic carrom rules and classic carrom rules, both fully supported
TALK WHILE YOU PLAY
- Crystal-clear live voice chat, built right into the table
- Meet new people, make friends, and keep the conversation going between shots
- Text chat with premium name colours and chat frames
MASTER THE BOARD
- Realistic 3D physics: every flick, rebound and cut angle behaves like the real thing
- Add powder to the board for a faster, smoother slide
- Aim guides that help beginners and stay out of the way of pros
- Climb the leaderboards and move up to higher-stakes tables
COLLECT AND SHOW OFF
- Unlock rare strikers, pucks, boards, themes and characters
- Build a personal album so other players know exactly who you are
- Show your rank, your style and your best shots
VIP MEMBERSHIP
- Bigger challenges with doubled rewards
- Exclusive name colours, chat frames and profile items
- Early access to new rooms and features
If you enjoy billiards, disc pool, carom, novuss, crokinole or classic tabletop board games, Carrom will feel like home from your very first shot.
Free to download and free to play. Take your first shot and start talking.
Follow us
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Carrom.mobile/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/carrom.mobile/
Questions, bugs or ideas? Message us on Facebook or Instagram - a real person on our team replies.

bluejetty:00128962:ios.name: Animal Shelter Simulator
bluejetty:00128962:ios.summary:
Save our four-legged friends!
Animal Shelter game grants you the opportunity to tackle the challenging but also highly rewarding task of running an Animal Shelter for dogs, cats, rabbits, strays and other rescued animals. Witness firsthand
bluejetty:00128962:ios.description:
Save our four-legged friends!
Animal Shelter game grants you the opportunity to tackle the challenging but also highly rewarding task of running an Animal Shelter for dogs, cats, rabbits, strays and other rescued animals. Witness firsthand how much effort goes into helping abandoned and injured animals as you handle a number of tasks necessary for your shelter to operate smoothly.
Clean Them
Your rescues will need to take a lot of steps on the path to improved health, and good hygiene is the very first one. Get your hands a little dirty so that their paws stay clean and their spirits soar high.
Take them for a walk
What better way to burn off all that excess energy than a good, old-fashioned trot out in the fresh air? Keep your animals stimulated and entertained. You can be sure they'll be starved for attention!
Extend 
As you succeed in your efforts, you will be faced with additional challenges. Make sure to turn them into opportunities as you invest in your facilities and expand according to your growing needs.
Convince them
The ultimate purpose of your initiative and the most rewarding conclusion to all of its efforts – when an animal makes its way to a brand new, loving home. Look after your rescues and ensure they are adopted by your shelter's visitors.

SpeedyMind Academy is a fun and exciting game to practice the basics of math (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division), logic and attention for K, 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th graders.
Our math game for kids is a great way to train the br
bluejetty:00133525:ios.description:
SpeedyMind Academy is a fun and exciting game to practice the basics of math (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division), logic and attention for K, 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th graders.
Our math game for kids is a great way to train the brain, develop intelligence, improve memory and attention. A funny Unicorn invites you to go on an exciting journey in the world of math and logic. The game allows you to select the level of difficulty of all tasks (math operations and logic riddles) you would like to master, so each grade in the elementary school (K-5) can play it:
• Kindergarten: simple logic and attention games, addition and subtraction up to 10
• 1st, 2nd Grade: develop logical thinking, practice addition and subtraction, multiplication tables and division
• 3rd, 4th Grade: train logical skills, master mental math
By completing tasks, kids receive motivating rewards, which makes the process of solving problems even more interesting and entertaining. Bright and unique design, funny characters and creative tasks will definitely please your kids, and math practice will turn into an exciting adventure.
Our game contains more than 500 interesting tasks in three sections:
Math games: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division;
Logic games: sequences, analogies, scales and others;
Attention games: find the correct shadow, find the same or different and others.
Are you ready? Then go ahead! Play and master your skills! 
We would love to hear your feedback. In case you have any questions or comments about the game, please write to us at academy@speedymind.net.
Terms of service: https://speedymind.net/terms
Privacy policy: https://speedymind.net/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00131243:ios.description:
Meet Tappy, a self-care pet who levels up as you destress, stay focused, and build a routine that's all yours.
Create your own Daily Adventure from self-care quests, like fidgeting, breathing, journaling, gratitude, or stepping outside, then complete it each day. Tappy tags along on every quest, and you collect Sparks for everything you finish to level Tappy up and unlock outfits, scenes, stickers, and surprises. And it's all in one app: 25+ haptic fidgets, 9 breathing exercises, 40+ calming soundscapes, a mood journal, daily gratitude, a habit tracker, goal tracking, and 15 arcade games.
YOUR DAILY ADVENTURE, YOUR WAY
• Choose from 25+ quests: breathe, fidget, journal, drink water, step outside, move your body, practice gratitude, reach out to a friend, brush your teeth, wind down, or write your own
• Arrange them in any order and set a daily reminder to build a routine that sticks
• Finish your adventure to open a treasure chest of Sparks. The bigger the adventure, the bigger the reward
TAKE CARE OF TAPPY
• Give Tappy a name, then pet, feed, hug, play, and tuck Tappy in
• Do all five plus a quest to fill the Care Bar for a daily surprise gift
• Earn badges as you hit new milestones together
• Set a bedtime and get Tappy ready for bed in a cozy bedtime outfit
• Spend Sparks on dozens of hats, glasses, outfits, and props, with new items added regularly
• Unlock scenes like the beach, a farm, a castle, and outer space, where visitors like a crab or a dragon wander by. Tap one for bonus Sparks
SENSORY FIDGETS YOU CAN FEEL
Stimming at your desk, waiting in line, or riding out a stressful moment? Tappy gives your hands something to do and your mind a place to settle. Each of the 25+ fidgets uses your iPhone's haptic vibrations to mimic the real thing, so you can feel every click, pop, and zip.
• Pop & click: pop Bubble Wrap, flip a light switch, and tap a grid of clicky buttons
• Zip & rip: drag a zipper open and shut, and tear Velcro apart
• Spin & stretch: flick a Fidget Spinner, stretch a slinky, and spin a crackling vinyl record
• Swirl & glow: smear colorful fluid, pluck neon strings, and pull a galaxy into orbit in the Cosmic Vortex
• Haptic Calming Strip: pin a strip that floats over the app, always within reach
• Sound on for satisfying audio, or off for a silent, discreet stim anywhere
DESTRESS & UNWIND
• 9 breathing exercises to calm down, refocus, or fall asleep, guided by vibrations you can follow with eyes closed
• Guided meditations and a 5 senses exercise to ground you in the present
• 40+ Feelscapes: soothing vibration patterns paired with a soundscape, like rain, a campfire, ocean waves, and footsteps in the snow, with a sleep timer
STAY FOCUSED & ON TRACK
• Mood Journal: reflect on how you feel, tag your feelings and what's behind them, and spot trends in Insights
• Planner & To-Dos: take your day one step at a time with a timeline of timed and anytime tasks, priorities, and reminders
• Habit Tracker: build healthy routines with custom icons, colors, schedules, reminders, streaks, and stats, then create your own challenges
• Goals: set short and long-term goals, break them into steps, and celebrate your progress
• Focus Timer: beat procrastination and collect Sparks as you focus
QUICK GAMES
• 15 arcade games for a quick brain break, including Mini Golf, Tappy Stack, Snake, Zen Pond, Color Swipe, Runner, and Pop It!
• Challenge a friend on one phone in Fastest Tapper, Four In A Row, and Tappy Battle
• Climb Game Center leaderboards
BUILT FOR IPHONE AND APPLE WATCH
• Apple Health: save mindful minutes, and sync your mood as State of Mind with Tappy Plus
• Widgets: check off habits and see your Daily Adventure from your Home Screen
• Live Activities: follow timed quests from your Lock Screen
• Apple Watch: a quick, discreet fidget on your wrist
Rated 4.8 stars by 20,000+ ratings.

Privacy: https://tappy.net/privacy

Our free application offers you readings and predictions based on the movements of the planets and the signs of the zodiac. With our professional astrologers, you will have a better understanding of your love situation, work, health, finances, relationships and choices. 
Whether you are Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius or Pisces, we will give you a complete and detailed reading of your astrological sky for the coming years, months, weeks and days.

Quality daily astrological guide
Our clairvoyance application offers you an accurate and reliable horoscope, created by astrology experts. With us:
- Discover your personality guided by the movements of the planets, the moon and the sun;
- Follow the course of the stars and live according to your zodiac sign and ascendant;
- Discover how you are connected to the immense cosmic clock that governs our universe. 
Our application will give you accurate predictions about your love life, your day, your money and anything else you need to help you make the right decisions at the right time. So go ahead and find out what the weather has in store for you today!

bluejetty:00022851:ios.description:
1Contact – Smart Contact Manager
Overview
1Contact is a comprehensive contact management application that helps you organize, clean, back up, and maintain your contacts efficiently. With powerful AI-driven features and intuitive tools, 1Contact transforms how you manage your address book.
Main Features
Contact Management
 • Add, edit, delete, and search contacts with ease
 • Smart organization and categorization
 • Quick access to frequently contacted people
 • Advanced search with multiple criteria
Contact Cleaning & Optimization
 • Remove contacts with missing or incomplete information
 • Delete outdated or unused contacts
 • Clean up duplicate phone numbers and email addresses
 • Optimize your contact list for better performance
Duplicate Detection & Merging
 • AI-powered detection by name, phone number, or email
 • Smart merging with conflict resolution
 • Batch merge multiple duplicates
 • Preview changes before applying
Backup & Restore
 • Secure local backups
 • Cloud backup integration (iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox)
 • Automatic scheduled backups
 • One-click restore functionality
 • Export contacts in multiple formats (vCard, CSV)
Sharing & Communication
 • Share multiple contacts via Email, SMS, or messaging apps
 • Bulk sharing with custom groups
 • QR code generation for easy sharing
 • Export contact lists for professional use
Additional Smart Features
 • Business card scanner with OCR technology
 • International phone number formatting
 • Contact analytics and insights
 • Custom contact groups and labels
 • Birthday and anniversary reminders
 • Import contacts from various sources
Privacy & Security
 • Local data processing for enhanced privacy
 • Encryption for sensitive information
 • No unnecessary permissions required
 • GDPR-compliant data handling
Performance & Usability
 • Fast and responsive interface
 • Offline functionality
 • Cross-device synchronization
 • Dark mode support
 • Accessibility features
Why Choose 1Contact?
1Contact combines powerful tools with an intuitive design, making it ideal for both personal and business use. Our AI-powered features help keep your contact list clean and organized while ensuring important data is always safe and accessible.
Perfect for:
 • Business professionals managing large contact lists
 • Individuals wanting to declutter their address book
 • Anyone needing secure backup and restore options
 • Users who frequently share contact information
If you enjoy using 1Contact, please share it with your friends and leave a review on the App Store. Your feedback helps us improve and supports our continued development.
Thank you for choosing 1Contact.

bluejetty:00172765:ios.description:
A powerful metronome, intuitive practice tracker, and precise tuner — all in one app. Soundbrenner makes music practice addictive. Here’s how:
The Metronome by Soundbrenner is a professional tool designed for musicians of all instruments and skill levels. 
Whether you’re practicing daily, performing live, or recording in the studio, this app offers everything you need to reach your musical goals.
Trusted by over 10 million musicians and featured in NAMM, Rolling Stone, MusicRadar, and more, it’s the ultimate companion for your musical journey.
METRONOME
• Easy to use, yet incredibly powerful metronome
• Metronome clock with rock-solid precision
• Customize the metronome's time signature and subdivision, and emphasize beats with accents
• Choose from more than 20 unique metronome sounds, switch between dark and light themes, and more powerful customizations
• Save your rhythms and load them instantly in the metronome with world-class setlist management
PRACTICE TRACKER
• Track your progress, fuel your motivation, and reach your musical goals
• Set daily or weekly goals, maintain your streak, and challenge yourself to keep it going
• Monitor your progress with home and lock screen widgets
• Join the 10,000-hour challenge and level up as you practice more
• Track your practice hours separately for each instrument you play
• Set one-time or recurring practice reminders
TUNER
• Tune with precision and always sound great
• Choose between chromatic tuning and over 100 tuning profiles
• Adjust the tuning reference from 440 Hz to your preference
• Automatically recognizes and selects the string you’re tuning
WHAT THE PRESS SAYS:
• “Best in Show” ― The NAMM Show 
• “Revolutionize the way you practice” ― FutureMusic
• “Keeps you on the beat” ― TechCrunch
• “One of the best drum innovations” ― MusicRadar
• “The best metronome app” ― WIRED
WHAT MUSICIANS SAY:
• “It’s sleek and easily understood in seconds. And the controls are great. Fast and intuitive. The Metronome by Soundbrenner is what all musicians need to practice their tempo.” ― Pete Korpela (Drummer, Grammy-nominated, played with Robbie Williams, Disturbed, Hans Zimmer, and many more)
• ”You get it. You can figure it out. You lock into the metronome. It doesn't get any better than that.” ― Robert Sarzo (Guitarist of Hurricane and Queensrÿche, worked with Jimmy Iovine and legendary metal producers Bob Ezrin and Mike Clink)
• “I walk on stage. The Metronome by Soundbrenner is right there and ready to go.” ― Randy Waldman (Pianist, composer, Grammy winner, played with Frank Sinatra, Michael Jackson, Whitney Houston, Beyoncé, Stevie Wonder, and many more)
• “Make the metronome what you want it to be.” ― Robert “Bubby” Lewis (Bassist, composer, played with Snoop Dogg, Dr. Dre, Lupe Fiasco)

bluejetty:00128207:ios.description:
MÁV – a hivatalos vasúti belföldi utazástervező!
A MÁV-START alkalmazása hasznos segítséget nyújt utazása megtervezéséhez, amihez az alkalmazásból a jegyét is megvásárolhatja. A MÁV applikáció mindent tud a vonatokról: az utazás időpontja, az indulási és érkezési hely, valamint az igénybe vehető kedvezmények kiválasztását követően segít az optimális útvonal kiválasztásában. Emellett a menetrend alapján információt ad az esetleges átszállásokról és az állomásokról, megjeleníti a menetjegy árát, jelzi a pótjegyváltási kötelezettséget. A jegyeket egy gombnyomással a kosárba teheti, majd bankkártyával kifizetheti. A vásárlási beállítások, adatok elmenthetők, így a következő alkalommal még egyszerűbb lesz a vásárlás. A MÁV applikáció használatával a vonatok aktuális helyzetét is könnyedén nyomon követheti a valós idejű adatokat használó térképen. Továbbá teljesen egyedi funkcióként valós idejű csevegés folytatható a vonaton utazó utastársakkal.
MÁV applikáció – official journey planner for train travels within Hungary.
The application of the MAV-START Co. is useful for planning train travel, and the tickets can also be purchased within the application. MÁV app knows everything about the trains: after setting the date of travel, departure and destination station and available discounts it helps you choosing the best journey. It also provides information about the stations, changing trains; displays price of the set journey; indicates trains with obligatory surcharge. Tickets can be placed in the basket with one tap, and can be paid with credit card. Purchase settings and data can be saved that makes future purchases even smoother. MÁV app enables tracing the trains real-time on the map easily. Unique function of the app is the real-time chat with fellow passengers on the same train.
Újdonságok:
Jegyvásárlás:
- az utazási beállítások és az utasok adatai elmenthetők, így nem kell minden alkalommal újra megadni az utas adatait.
- a beépített SimplePay fizetési alkalmazásban kívánság szerint a fizetésre használt bankkártya adatok elmenthetők (ezeket a MÁV-START nem kezeli)
- teljesen átdolgozott felhasználói felület, a sztenderd gesztusok használata

Take control of your habits and level up your life with Seed, the gamified, science-backed app designed to help you build self-control, improve focus, and maintain your streaks of personal growth.

Track Your Progress – Watch your daily streaks and achievements evolve with interactive 3D orbs.
Gamified Motivation – Earn rewards, unlock levels, and stay engaged while improving self-discipline.
Hypnosis & Guided Exercises – Rewire your mindset with immersive hypnosis and breathing exercises for moments of temptation.

Combines latest research in habit formation and behavior change
Uses interactive gamification and progress tracking to keep you motivated
