bluejetty:00091485:ios.summary: Someone needs it as a PDF, but you only have a photo, scan, or file? Turn it into a PDF from your camera, gallery, or imported files, then fix the order, rename the document, and share the final version. Get the file ready before the next t
bluejetty:00091485:ios.description:
Someone needs it as a PDF, but you only have a photo, scan, or file? Turn it into a PDF from your camera, gallery, or imported files, then fix the order, rename the document, and share the final version. Get the file ready before the next thing interrupts you!
Most PDF jobs are not big projects. It is usually one form, a few pages from class, a receipt, a signed paper, or several pictures that would look better as a single file. Most of the time, it is easier to use a simple PDF creator than open a larger editor just to handle one quick file.
Create PDFs from everyday files
The app is built around simple PDF creation from everyday phone content. Use photos, images, camera scans, or imported files, then make a PDF you can rename, reorder, and export when the document looks right.
Scan paper documents
For pages you still have in front of you, the camera scanner keeps things simple. Capture printed documents, school notes, forms, receipts, letters, or office papers, then save them as PDF files instead of sending plain photos.
Convert photos and images
A lot of documents start as pictures now. Use the image converter to take photos from your gallery, place them in the right order, and make a PDF that looks cleaner when you need to send, upload, print, or store it.
Import saved files
For saved files, you do not need to scan anything again or turn the file into images first. Import the supported file, make it into a PDF, rename it if the name is too vague, and keep the finished document ready for sharing or later use.
What you can do:
- Create PDF files from photos, images, scans, and files
- Scan paper documents with your camera
- Convert pictures from your gallery into PDF files
- Import supported files and save them as PDFs
- Start a PDF from a blank canvas
- Rename files so they are easier to recognize
- Reorder pages before exporting
- Manage pages inside your PDF documents
- Keep a history of created PDFs
- Share or export files quickly
Everyday PDF tasks
The app works well for everyday situations, not only office work. You might use it for class notes, homework, signed papers, forms, invoices, receipts, personal records, travel documents, confirmations, or quick camera scans. It is also useful when someone asks you to “send it as a PDF” and you only have the original as a photo or file.
Photo to PDF, scan to PDF, file to PDF
Photo to PDF is simple: choose images, check the page order, and create the document. Scan to PDF is just as direct: use the camera, capture the paper, and save it as a PDF. File to PDF is there when you want to import a supported file and turn it into something easier to share.
Organize pages before sharing
The page tools are useful when the first version is not quite right. Move pages around, give the PDF a clearer name, keep track of recent files, and send the final version without digging through a confusing workflow.
Simple PDF creation
This is more of a practical PDF creator than a complicated document workspace. You can scan, import, create, rename, reorder, and share, without getting pulled into a long editing process. For everyday PDFs from photos, images, files, and paper scans, that is usually what matters most.
Use it to:
- Turn photos into one PDF
- Scan a paper document
- Save images as a PDF file
- Create a PDF from imported files
- Reorder pages before sending
- Rename a document for easier tracking
- Share a clean PDF instead of loose images
- Keep recent PDF files in one place
A good PDF tool should save time, not add more steps. This app gives you the basic workflow most people need: choose the source, create the PDF, fix the order, rename it, and share or export the result.
Download our app when you need a PDF from photos, scans, images, or files without opening a complicated editor. Create documents from your camera, gallery, blank canvas, or imported files, then organize pages and share the finished PDF. Turn the thing you have into the file they need!

bluejetty:00080093:ios.summary: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of driving games with the Bus Simulator, a groundbreaking addition to the realm of vehicle games and driving simulators. This meticulously crafted bus simulation game offers a realistic and thrillin
bluejetty:00080093:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of driving games with the Bus Simulator, a groundbreaking addition to the realm of vehicle games and driving simulators. This meticulously crafted bus simulation game offers a realistic and thrilling experience for enthusiasts of bus games and driving games alike.
As you step into the shoes of a virtual bus games, prepare yourself for an unparalleled driving game adventure. The attention to detail in this bus simulator is second to none, ensuring an authentic and immersive vehicle simulation that will satisfy even the most discerning fans of bus driving games.
Diverse Routes and Environments:
The heart of the game lies in the meticulous recreation of a bustling city environment, complete with intricately designed streets, intersections, and, of course, bus stops. Navigate through the urban landscape, encountering a myriad of challenges that will test your skills as a bus driver. From tight corners to congested traffic, this driving simulator captures the essence of navigating a city bus through its busy streets.
Multiple Bus Models:
The coach bus simulator aspect of the game adds another layer of complexity and excitement. Manage the intricate controls of a variety of coach buses, each with its unique characteristics, ensuring a diverse and engaging experience for players who relish the nuances of vehicle simulators. The attention to realism extends to the physics of the buses, offering a driving game experience that mirrors the weight and handling of real-life counterparts.
Every aspect of the bus simulation game is designed to make you feel like a true professional bus driver. Whether it is adhering to a tight schedule, mastering the art of smooth stops at various bus stops, or dealing with unexpected challenges on the road, this driving game demands precision and skill, making it a standout among bus driving games.
Day-Night Cycle and Weather:
The city bus routes are carefully planned, offering a dynamic and evolving experience in this driving simulator. Encounter changing weather conditions, day and night cycles, and diverse traffic patterns, providing a level of realism rarely seen in other vehicle games. The bus simulator game's AI is designed to simulate the unpredictability of urban life, ensuring that each journey is a unique and challenging adventure.
Passenger management:
The bus simulator is not just about driving; it is about the immersive world that unfolds around you as a bus driver. Interact with passengers, manage ticket sales, and experience the rewarding feeling of safely delivering people to their destinations. The diligence extends to the interiors of the buses, allowing players to enjoy a fully realized cockpit environment, enhancing the overall bus simulation experience.
In conclusion, the Bus Simulator stands out as a pinnacle in the world of driving games, bus games, and vehicle simulators. With its unparalleled realism, diligence, and challenging gameplay, this driving game guarantees hours of enjoyment for anyone seeking an authentic bus driving experience. Step into the driver's seat, navigate the urban jungle, and become the expert in the road in this extraordinary bus simulator game.
Features:
- Enjoy realistic handling and weather effects.
- Choose from a variety of buses, each with unique characteristics.
- Navigate busy streets, intersections, and bus stops for a challenging bus simulation.
- Pick up passengers, follow schedules, and ensure their safety and comfort.
- Enjoy authentic bus handling and interactions with various road conditions.

bluejetty:00148368:ios.description:
PlantSeek — Your All-in-One Identification Tool, A Powerful Assistant for Exploring the World
PlantSeek is a robust, all-purpose identification app. With just a simple snap, you can unlock the mysteries of countless things around you.
Core Features:
Plant Identification: AI intelligently recognizes over 10,000 plant species. Whether it’s street greenery, wildflowers, or rare herbs, snap or upload a photo to instantly get accurate names and encyclopedia explanations.
Animal & Insect Identification: Covers pets, insects, wildlife, and more. Unlock the secrets of diverse creatures and gain a thorough understanding of the animal world around you.
Currency Identification: Quickly identify currencies from around the world. Easily distinguish currency types and denominations during international trips or coin collecting.
Calorie Identification: Snap a photo of food to quickly get its calorie information. Help yourself plan a balanced diet and maintain a healthy lifestyle.
Skincare Ingredient Interpretation: Scan skincare ingredient lists for professional analysis of ingredient efficacy and safety. Assist you in choosing skincare products that suit you.
Food Ingredient List Analysis: Easily analyze food ingredient lists. Let you clearly understand the composition of food and eat with peace of mind and health.
Identify Everything: Whether it’s landmarks, car models, red wine, or trademarks — if you want to know about it, PlantSeek provides detailed identification results and relevant information.
App Highlights:
Instant Identification: Adopts advanced image recognition technology and AI algorithms for second-level response, delivering fast and accurate identification results.
Professional Analysis: Identification results come with detailed encyclopedia introductions, combining pictures and text. Let you not only know the name but also understand the "why".
Easy Operation: With a simple interface and intuitive controls, just snap or upload a photo to get answers. Suitable for users of all age groups.
Knowledge Repository: Support one-click saving of identification content for easy access anytime. Satisfy your curiosity and make life and learning more interesting.
Download PlantSeek now to start your journey of identifying everything and explore the infinite possibilities of the world!

bluejetty:00133205:ios.name: Thrive Hearing Control
bluejetty:00133205:ios.summary: The Thrive Hearing Control app works seamlessly with sensor-enabled hearing aids to give you complete control of your hearing. Change settings easily, adjust volume quickly, create customized memories, and stream music or phone calls with t
bluejetty:00133205:ios.description:
The Thrive Hearing Control app works seamlessly with sensor-enabled hearing aids to give you complete control of your hearing. Change settings easily, adjust volume quickly, create customized memories, and stream music or phone calls with the touch of a button.
The Thrive app also gives you access to Healthable features like social engagement and activity tracking. You can set goals and your Engagement Score and Activity Score will track how close you are to meeting them daily. The Thrive app also offers information services like Thrive Assistant, Translate, Transcribe, and Self Check, which lets you check your hearing aid performance without an office visit.
And that’s just the beginning. Thrive also offers:
EDGE MODE
Industry-leading sound performance provides you with instantaneous adjustments for the most challenging listening situations.
REMOTE CONTROL
Easily adjust your hearing aid volume and change between memories created by you or your hearing professional.
PERSONALIZED MEMORIES
Create custom memories using manual and customizable sound adjustments. And geotag these memories so your hearing aids automatically adjust when returning to that location.
FALL DETECTION AND ALERTS
Designed to help you stay independent, falls can be detected, and alert messages sent to selected contacts.
ACTIVITY TRACKING
Track steps and other movements and set daily goals to inspire a healthy lifestyle. Thrive integrates directly with the Apple Health app.
ENGAGEMENT TRACKING
Monitor hearing aid use and social engagement and set daily goals to positively impact brain health. 
THRIVE ASSISTANT
Ask questions about your hearing aids like, “how do I adjust volume?” or general questions like, “what’s the weather today?” and get quick answers.
TRANSLATE
This first-to-world feature helps you easily communicate with people who speak other languages.
THRIVE CARE COMPATIBLE
You can use the Thrive app to share helpful information like physical activity, hearing aid usage and social engagement with people you select and who have the new Thrive Care app. This helps you maintain independence and provides peace of mind for the Thrive Care users you share with.
SELF CHECK
Allows you to perform a diagnostic test of your hearing aid components without having to make an office visit.
TRANSCRIBE
It’s like closed captioning for real life. Conversations are transcribed so you can read what's being said.
TELEHEAR™
Get help anywhere. Connect with your hearing professional by video call and obtain minor hearing aid adjustments directly to your hearing aids and smartphone.
FIND MY HEARING AIDS
Easily locate lost hearing aids. A signal detector sends a stronger or weaker signal based on how close you are to the location of the hearing aids.
AUDIO
Enables carefree communication using your iPhone®. Delivers superior sound and pristine audio streaming of any music or media played through your iOS device. You can also have Siri® read emails and texts directly to your hearing aids.
ACCESSORY CONTROL
Gives you easy control of hearing aid accessories.
The Thrive app works with sensor-enabled and MFi-certified hearing aids from Starkey, Audibel, NuEar, MicroTech and AGX® Hearing. These hearing aids must be purchased from a hearing professional. Fall Alert and Activity and Engagement tracking are only available with sensor-enabled hearing aids.
All features are not available on all hearing aid styles. Check with your hearing professional for details.

bluejetty:00122871:ios.description:
For those who’ve outgrown traditional DIY tax filing software, there’s Keeper. 
Keeper combines AI and human accountants to handle the most complex tax situations -- from self-employment and freelance income, S-Corps, rental properties, K-1s, investments, stock options, and more. Our smart tax platform ensures your tax return is optimized with 100% accuracy, so you capture every deduction, credit, and tax-saving opportunity possible.
Intelligent tax prep: Identify deductions, credits, and other tax-saving opportunities that traditional tax filing software misses.
- Upload a prior year return to uncover missed opportunities
- Connect your banks or credit cards securely to track tax deductible expenses year-round
- Get a real-time estimate of your tax liability
Expert-led guidance & support: Our in-house tax pros are here to advise, review, and sign off on every tax return.
- Book a video call with your dedicated tax expert
- Get instant answers 24/7 with our AI tax assistant trained on tax law
File your taxes with confidence: Our powerful tax software does the heavy lifting to prep your return and uncover maximum tax savings. Then, human accountants review every detail before filing. 
- File from your phone or computer
- File with the IRS and all 50 states
- 300+ checks to make sure you get every credit & deduction
- Smart audit protection included
Keeper is secured using SSL 256-bit encryption— the same security protocol banks use — to ensure that your sensitive personal information is fully protected and securely stored. Keeper does not store your online banking credentials, or sell your information to anyone.

PRIVACY POLICY: https://www.keepertax.com/privacy

bluejetty:00024601:ios.name: Pedometer - Run & Step Counter
bluejetty:00024601:ios.summary: Stay active and keep your daily movement under control with a simple and reliable pedometer. Whether you are walking outdoors, running, or just trying to stay consistent throughout the day, the app helps you track your steps, monitor your p
bluejetty:00024601:ios.description:
Stay active and keep your daily movement under control with a simple and reliable pedometer. Whether you are walking outdoors, running, or just trying to stay consistent throughout the day, the app helps you track your steps, monitor your progress, and build better habits.
Our step counter uses a built-in sensor to deliver accurate tracking without complicated setup or extra battery drain. You get clear statistics, helpful insights, and all essential data in one place, making it easier to understand your walking and running activity and stay motivated every day.
KEY FEATURES
- Accurate step counter with automatic tracking
- Calories, distance, and walking & running insights
- Goals, achievements, and detailed statistics
- Home screen widget with your activity data
ACCURATE STEP COUNTER
Track your steps with precision using your device’s built-in motion sensor. The pedometer works in the background and automatically records your activity. You don’t need to hold your phone or start tracking manually — just carry your device during walks or runs and let the app count your steps throughout the day.
ACTIVITY INSIGHTS
Go beyond step counting. The app shows calories burned, distance traveled, and your walking and running performance, helping you better understand your daily activity. All key metrics are displayed clearly, so you can quickly check your progress and stay on track.
GOALS, ACHIEVEMENTS & STATISTICS
Set daily step goals and stay motivated as you reach new milestones. Track your walking and running activity with hourly, daily, and weekly statistics, and see how your performance improves over time. Your progress is also available in notifications, so you can stay updated without opening the app.
WIDGET & QUICK ACCESS
Add a convenient widget to your home screen and view your steps, progress, and key stats at a glance. Keep your walking and running progress visible and stay focused on your daily activity goals.
IMPORTANT: For the most accurate results, use the pedometer while you are actively walking or running.
The app integrates with HealthKit to access data such as steps, active energy, distance, height, weight, and more. Please allow access to this data to ensure accurate tracking.
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe now to get:
1. Advanced fitness metrics
2. Custom goal options
3. Personal activity widget
4. Ad-free experience
Premium subscription details:
- Start with a free three-day trial. When the trial ends, a paid weekly subscription will begin automatically.
- Subscriptions are available in weekly, monthly, and annual plans.
- A weekly subscription costs $9.99, a monthly subscription costs $19.99, and an annual subscription costs $49.99.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel your subscription or free trial at any time. To prevent automatic renewal, cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
- Read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://appenvisions.com/privacy.html
https://appenvisions.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00124418:ios.description:
Discover original reporting and understand the events shaping the world in The New York Times app. Follow breaking news and get live updates. Watch news videos that provide context on top stories. Listen to news podcasts, culture podcasts, narrated articles and more. Stay updated on the latest headlines in politics, health, business and this year’s elections. Access a range of news coverage including investigations, cultural commentary and analysis.
Not a subscriber yet? Download the app to explore The Times with a month of free news access, including live news updates and in-depth reporting. Plus, enjoy free access to recipes, audio journalism, product reviews, sports coverage and more for your first month in the app. No paywalls. No credit card required.
BREAKING NEWS AND LIVE UPDATES
• Your daily news app to help you stay informed as news breaks.
• Push notifications deliver the latest headlines and developing stories.
• Add widgets and custom alerts to keep up with the latest world news.
ORIGINAL REPORTING AND IN-DEPTH ANALYSIS
• Read, watch and listen to investigative reporting and insights.
• Access global news from 1,700 Times journalists reporting from 150 countries.
• Explore complex stories brought to life through data and visual journalism.
NEWS VIDEOS
• Watch videos for free featuring news reporters, critics and other experts.
• Get closer to the story with videos across news, politics and the midterm elections.
• Understand breaking news, top stories, culture reporting and more, in video.
INFORMED AUDIO NEWS
• Listen to articles, or tune in to daily podcasts like “The Daily” and “The Headlines.”
ARTS, SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY AND LIFESTYLE COVERAGE
• Discover reporting across arts, culture, fashion, travel and more.
• Stay informed on topics like technology, science and health.
• Explore culture with podcasts like “Modern Love” and “The Interview.”
WORD, VISUAL AND NUMBER GAMES
• Unwind with daily games like the Crossword, Wordle, Connections, the Mini, Spelling Bee and Sudoku.
COMMUNITY CONVERSATIONS
• Engage with Times news reporters and readers in our moderated comments section. 
• Subscribers can share free-to-read gift articles with anyone.
DIGITAL SUBSCRIPTIONS
Enjoy everything we offer with a New York Times All Access subscription, which includes unlimited access to:
• Investigations, politics, culture and analysis from News.
• Word, visual and number puzzles from Games.
• Recipes, videos, advice and inspiration from Cooking.
• Independent product reviews from Wirecutter.
• In-depth, personalized sports coverage from The Athletic.
BY DOWNLOADING THE NEW YORK TIMES APP, you agree to:
• The New York Times Privacy Policy: https://www.nytimes.com/privacy/privacy-policy
• The New York Times Cookie Policy: https://www.nytimes.com/privacy/cookie-policy
• The New York Times California Privacy Notices: https://www.nytimes.com/privacy/california-notice
• The New York Times Terms of Service: https://www.nytimes.com/content/help/rights/terms/terms-of-service.html
*Promotional offers for new subscribers only. Prices shown are in U.S. dollars. Other restrictions apply.
Offer valid for a 30-day period of free access to The New York Times in its app. Current subscribers and individuals who have previously redeemed an offer for a 30-day period of free access to The New York Times are ineligible. Free access includes News, Cooking, Wirecutter and The Athletic; subscriber-only Games are excluded. At the expiration of the 30-day period, the free access will terminate automatically. No payment details are required to redeem this offer. Purchasing a recurring subscription to The New York Times during the free access period will immediately terminate the free access and begin the paid subscription. The only exception is purchasing a Games subscription, which grants immediate access to all Games content, while the 30-day period of free access to the rest of The New York Times continues until its scheduled end date.

bluejetty:00119840:ios.description:
ABC Spanish & English for Kids – Programa de Aprendizaje Divertido para Niños de 2 a 7 Años
ABC Spanish & English for Kids es una aplicación de aprendizaje interactivo diseñada para ayudar a los niños en edad preescolar (de 2 a 7 años) a explorar el español, el inglés, las matemáticas y el pensamiento creativo a través del juego. Con lecciones basadas en 8 áreas principales de aprendizaje —español, inglés, matemáticas, lógica, observación, memoria, creatividad (arte y música) y naturaleza & ciencia— los niños pueden fortalecer sus habilidades y ampliar sus conocimientos de una manera alegre y motivadora.
La aplicación ofrece más de 1.000 lecciones y 200+ juegos educativos, todos adaptados a la edad y el progreso de tu hijo. Con la orientación de profesores de español y docentes nativos, el aprendizaje se convierte en una experiencia efectiva y divertida, fomentando la concentración, la confianza y la curiosidad.
Etapas de Aprendizaje
► Explorar (Edades 2–3):
- Aprender las 29 letras del alfabeto español
- Construir una base de 1.000 palabras en español y 200 en inglés
- Reconocer números (1–20), formas y colores
- Descubrir animales, vehículos y objetos mediante actividades lúdicas
- Desarrollar observación, lógica, memoria y creatividad a nivel inicial
► Comprender (Edades 4–5):
- Practicar escritura y ortografía en español
- Aprender más de 500 palabras y las 27 letras del alfabeto inglés
- Resolver matemáticas básicas (sumas y restas hasta 10)
- Fortalecer lógica, observación, memoria y creatividad a nivel medio
► Dominio (Edades 6–7):
- Leer y deletrear palabras y oraciones en español
- Ampliar el vocabulario a más de 1.000 palabras en inglés con pronunciación
- Mejorar las habilidades matemáticas (sumas y restas hasta 100)
- Potenciar la lógica, observación, memoria y creatividad a nivel avanzado
Características Principales: 
- Práctica del alfabeto español y ortografía
- Juegos de escritura y trazado
- Aprendizaje de números, sumas y restas
- Reconocimiento de formas y colores
- Vocabulario en inglés para niños
- Juegos creativos sobre animales, plantas, transporte y más
- Recompensas con pegatinas para motivar a los niños
- Pruebas semanales e informes de progreso para los padres
- Acceso multiplataforma (teléfonos, tabletas, computadoras)
- Varios perfiles infantiles por dispositivo
- Soporte bilingüe español–inglés
- Entorno seguro de aprendizaje: sin anuncios, disponible sin conexión
- Cada cuenta puede usarse en 2 dispositivos al mismo tiempo
- Términos de uso: https://vkidsapp.com/terms
- Política de privacidad: https://vkidsapp.com/privacy

bluejetty:00113599:ios.name: Epson iProjection
bluejetty:00113599:ios.summary:
Epson iProjection is a wireless projection app for iPhone®, iPad®, or iPod® touch. This app makes it easy to mirror your device's screen, and project documents and photos wirelessly to a supported Epson projector.
[Key Features]
1. Mirror
bluejetty:00113599:ios.description:
Epson iProjection is a wireless projection app for iPhone®, iPad®, or iPod® touch. This app makes it easy to mirror your device's screen, and project documents and photos wirelessly to a supported Epson projector.
[Key Features]
1. Mirror your device’s screen and output your device’s audio from the projector.
2. Project your photos in the "Photos" app, project documents loaded in this app, and project in real-time video from your device's camera.
3. Easily connect your device by scanning a projected QR code.
4. Connect up to 50 devices to the projector, display up to four screens simultaneously, and share your projected image with the other connected devices.
5. Annotate projected images with a pen tool and save the edited images on your device.
6. Control the projector like a remote control.
[Notes]
• For supported projectors, visit https://support.epson.net/projector_appinfo/iprojection/en/. You can also check "Supported Projectors" in the app's support menu.
• While mirroring your device’s screen, video and audio may be delayed depending on the device and network specifications. Only unprotected content can be projected.
• Use the mirroring feature to project videos in the "Photos" app.
[About Projecting Documents]
• The following file types are supported when projecting using "Documents".
- Microsoft® Word
- Microsoft® Excel
- Microsoft® PowerPoint
- Keynote
- PDF
- JPG
- PNG
- The file types mentioned above are also supported when stored in cloud file services
• Depending on the document, the projected image may differ from the image on the computer or at the time of creation, for example, some characters may not be projected correctly. If this occurs, use the mirroring feature ("Mirror device screen") instead.
• Animations and screen transition effects, videos, and audio are not played. Use the mirroring feature to play them.
• We recommend testing the projection in advance when using this app for presentations.
[Using the App]
Make sure that the network settings for the projector have been completed.
1. Switch the input source on the projector to "LAN". Network information is displayed.
2. Connect to the same network as the projector from "Settings" > "Wi-Fi" on your iPhone/iPad/iPod touch.
3. Start Epson iProjection and connect to the projector.
4. Select and project from "Mirror device screen", "Photos", "Documents", "Web Page", or "Camera".
[App permissions]
The app requires the following permissions for specific features.
【Required】 Local Network
- Search for and connect to the projector.
【Optional】] Photo
- Project selected photos from the device to the projector.
* You can use the app without granting the optional permissions, but some features may not work.
All images are examples and may differ from the actual screens.

Do you dream of traveling? With the eSky app, you can organize your entire trip in one place! Choose cheap flights from over 950 airlines and book your hotels. From a spontaneous weekend getaway to your dream vacation – with us, traveling is simple, fast, and affordable.
Cheap Flights
Find cheap flights with the eSky app! We compare offers from Delta, United, American Airlines, Southwest, Spirit, Frontier, and many others to ensure you get the most favorable prices. The intuitive flight search engine allows you to quickly find ideal connections, easier than through a travel agency!
Download the eSky app and start saving on travel today. Use our proven travel tricks to find the best cheap flights:
- Price Alerts – they will help you track price changes and search for the best deals for your dream trip, whether it's a family vacation or a quick getaway.
- Deal Notifications – Cancun, Las Vegas, or maybe something completely new? You will never miss hot offers again, thanks to promotion notifications.
Don't waste time searching separate airline sites or multiple travel agencies – you can do it all in just a few clicks in the eSky app.
Hotels and Accommodation
Find the ideal accommodation for your vacation or weekend trip. Our database contains over 1.5 million properties worldwide, from hotels to apartments. Book separately or use the Flight+Hotel package to save and get the Lowest Price Guarantee!
User Zone is the center for managing your travels. You also have 24/7 expert support – we help in every situation, at any time, wherever you are. Thanks to the eSky app, your vacations and getaways will always be perfectly organized!
Why choose eSky?
- Cheap flights and the best prices! Access to unpublished deals from over 950 airlines at 3,000 airports.
- All airlines: the full offer of carriers (Delta, United, American Airlines, Southwest, Spirit, Frontier, and others).
- Comfort and certainty: consultant care and instant booking confirmation.
- Intuitiveness: you search for flights, vacations, and quick trips in a few clicks.
- Real-time updates: always up-to-date prices and the freshest promotions.
Download the eSky mobile app and join the world of smart travelers! Cheap flights, vacations, and getaways are now within app's reach!
FAQ
How can I find cheap flights?
Use the “Daily Deals” section and our inspirations in the eSky app. This is the fastest way to find cheap flights, vacations, and weekend trips.
When is the best time to buy cheap flight tickets?
Book cheap flights during the week (preferably in the morning). Use the flexible calendar function and don't forget to enable notifications in the eSky app to catch the best price and not miss any deal!
Where to fly cheaply?
Check the daily deals that we prepare for you in the eSky app! You will find cheap flights to popular and exotic destinations, tailored to your price preferences.
Can I make changes to my booking, e.g., refund a ticket?
In the User Zone, you can check the booking status and manage selected elements. To change flight tickets, contact the eSky Customer Service Centre.
The eSky app is available in over 20 languages and works worldwide. Travel wisely, save money, and discover the world with eSky!

Daily tide charts and tidal coefficient. High tides and low tides. Tides height. Monthly tide table. Tides for fishing.

bluejetty:00164990:ios.description:

Почему выбирают это приложение:
• Актуальная база ПДД 2026 — вопросы полностью соответствуют официальным билетам ГИБДД.
• Подробные комментарии — простые объяснения каждого вопроса для быстрого понимания правил.
• Экзамен в формате ГИБДД — тренировка с таймером и условиями, максимально близкими к реальным.
• Удобные учебные режимы: по билетам, по темам, марафон из 800 вопросов.
• Работа над ошибками — повторяйте только те вопросы, которые вызывают сложности.
• Избранное — сохраняйте важные вопросы для быстрого доступа.
• Подробная статистика — отслеживайте прогресс по темам, билетам и точности ответов.
• Полезные функции: увеличение изображений, ночная тема, поддержка виджетов iOS.
Кому подойдет приложение:
Будущим водителям, готовящимся к экзамену в ГИБДД.
Тем, кто хочет быстро освежить знания ПДД 2026 года.
Преподавателям автошкол для работы со студентами.
Подписка:
Доступны варианты на 3 месяца и 1 год. Подписка открывает расширенные возможности и помогает готовиться максимально эффективно.
Внутри приложения:
Все 40 официальных билетов 2026 года с комментариями, иллюстрациями и удобным интерфейсом для ежедневной подготовки.

bluejetty:00016608:ios.description:
Every answer is just 2 words and every puzzle is just plain fun!
This is David L. Hoyt's marvelous, mind-stimulating game. 
* Just 2 Words is utterly simple to play and fun for all ages.
* It is the brain child of America's most popular creator of word puzzles. 
* Hours & hours & hours of fun. More than 2,500 puzzles!
* The game is perfect for those that enjoy thinking creatively and putting together picture clues!
Every puzzle's answer is just 2 words -- a common pairing ("BROWNIE POINTS"), a famous person's name ("ELTON JOHN"), or a fun word combination that is forehead-slapping obvious after you figure out David's picture clues!
Super easy to play. 2,500+ deliciously fun puzzles! Beautiful graphics.
And in case you are wondering . . . David L. Hoyt is the most syndicated daily game creator in the world. His most famous games include Jumble, Word Roundup, Pat Sajak's Lucky Letters, Word Winder, and many more. His games appear in 600+ newspapers, including USA Today, Chicago Tribune and Los Angeles Times.
"Playing this game will result in mental stimulation, increased vocabulary and hours and hours of fun." -- Review by The iPhone Mom
Begin playing Just 2 Words today. You'll love it!

bluejetty:00083996:ios.description:
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to run an entire Empire?
Now with Empire City: Build and Conquer you will be able to:
Build new beautiful cities, develop resource extraction, make your own unique culture, trade with other civilizations and make fantastic discoveries that will help you in the future. You have a chance to bring it all to life and become a real emperor with Empire City! 
Ancient civilizations and their advanced construction technologies will be available to you. It will look like a real rise of empires and civilizations. Create the most unusual buildings and structures that descendants will call “Wonders of the Ancient World”. Dig canals to help your farmers, create intricate and bizarre viaducts, erect epic statues of Gods and Heroes!
You can develop not only construction, but also contact the world. Age of empires is here, make your own one! Become the most powerful kingdom in the world.
Build trade relations, diplomacy, exchange knowledge and technology with others. Become the center of the trade routes.
Expand your influence and territory. Join new lands and develop them, get even more useful resources and gain the respect of your subjects. Be a peaceful leader or a domineering tyrant - the choice is yours.
After all, the main thing is to go down in history and create the most powerful ancient city-empire!
Be the first in everything, be the best at all stages of your city's development.
Only you influence your future, only you decide what your empire will be like!
Features of the game:
- Unique development options
Choose your own way to rise your empire.
- Construction of the most unusual ancient buildings
Build your own powerful kingdom.
- Fantastic atmosphere of the ancient world
Get inspired by the beautiful views of your empire.
- Impressive scope
Feel the greatness of your new kingdom.
- Freedom of any actions and choices
Build your kingdom as you can see it.
- Amazing graphics and addictive gameplay
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the ancient world.

bluejetty:00123191:ios.name: Speedometer 55 Pro. GPS kit.
bluejetty:00123191:ios.summary:
A powerful GPS speedometer, mileage tracker, and trip-cost monitor with dash-cam and action-cam video. See your speed at a glance, receive clear speed-limit alerts, record detailed routes, and understand the real cost of each trip.
Feature
bluejetty:00123191:ios.description:
A powerful GPS speedometer, mileage tracker, and trip-cost monitor with dash-cam and action-cam video. See your speed at a glance, receive clear speed-limit alerts, record detailed routes, and understand the real cost of each trip.
Features:
■ Speed Limits & Alerts
Set speed limits with 4 or 8 one-tap presets. Large digits change from green to red and a sound alerts you when you exceed the selected limit. The app can remember where limits were used and reapply them automatically.
■ Cost, Fuel & EV Monitor
See driving costs in real time for combustion and electric vehicles. For fuel, enter price and efficiency (US/UK MPG or L/100 km). For an EV, enter electricity price per kWh, usable battery capacity, full-charge driving range, and charging efficiency—the app accounts for charging losses. Add optional charges per mile or kilometer, split costs between passengers, and monitor estimated remaining range with configurable alerts.
■ GPS Tracking
Record detailed mileage and routes, review speed, altitude, and statistics, or add a previous track back to the map to retrace it. Import and export GPX, KML, and KMZ files.
■ GPS Dash Cam & Action Cam Video
Record the road or the action with synchronized speed, location, heading, and map data. Choose engaging overlays such as speed, map, Pitch & Roll, and G-Cross for live view, replay, or stamped exports. Keep a clean original, export a full video or selected range, and turn an exact replay frame into a georeferenced photo and waypoint. Loop recording can retain the latest part of a drive without filling storage with one endless recording.
Because of iOS privacy restrictions, video can be recorded only while the camera recording screen is visible. Recording stops if you leave that screen or the app moves to the background. The app does not provide parking surveillance or automatic vehicle-power startup.
■ Mileage Calculator & PDF Reports
Calculate distance, fuel costs, and mileage between addresses. Fill gaps in a mileage log, categorize trips, and create customizable professional reports for reimbursement or tax records.
■ Maps
Choose Apple, Google, blank, or offline road, satellite, and topographic maps. Import MBTiles or SQLiteDB maps, download maps in the app, and create or share KMZ ground overlays.
■ Driving and Navigation Modes
Use a full-screen speed display, mirrored HUD, rally computer, G-Force monitor, taximeter, map, water-sports mode, idle timer, paragliding instruments, or directional navigation for land, air, and marine use.
■ Waypoints & Camera Alerts
Create waypoints with optional photos or audio notes. Receive approach alerts, apply speed limits, and import or export CSV, GPX, KML, and KMZ data. Import red-light and speed-camera data or use the built-in library.
■ Voice Coach & Siri Shortcuts
Hear distance, duration, speed, and altitude at chosen intervals. Start or stop GPS tracking and set speed limits with Siri.
■ Barometric Instruments
View real-time vertical speed and altitude with QFE/QNH support on compatible devices.
■ Background Mileage Tracking
The speedometer and GPS track recorder can run in the background when enabled. Optional auto-recording logs driving without manual start or stop, ideal for tax or reimbursement mileage. It includes 50 free auto-tracks per month, with an upgrade available for unlimited use.
■ Speed & Distance
Displays 0–999 in MPH, km/h, or knots, plus maximum and average speed, distance, altitude, and sunrise/sunset times.
■ Privacy & Compatibility
Location data is used for speed monitoring and trip recording within the app and is not shared with third parties. Requires an iPhone or cellular iPad with GPS; Wi-Fi-only iPads and iPods need an external GPS source. Continued GPS use can reduce battery life.

listings.name: Speedometer 55 Pro. GPS kit.
listings.description:
A powerful GPS speedometer, mileage tracker, and trip-cost monitor with dash-cam and action-cam video. See your speed at a glance, receive clear speed-limit alerts, record detailed routes, and understand the real cost of each trip.

Features:

■ Speed Limits & Alerts
Set speed limits with 4 or 8 one-tap presets. Large digits change from green to red and a sound alerts you when you exceed the selected limit. The app can remember where limits were used and reapply them automatically.

■ Cost, Fuel & EV Monitor
See driving costs in real time for combustion and electric vehicles. For fuel, enter price and efficiency (US/UK MPG or L/100 km). For an EV, enter electricity price per kWh, usable battery capacity, full-charge driving range, and charging efficiency—the app accounts for charging losses. Add optional charges per mile or kilometer, split costs between passengers, and monitor estimated remaining range with configurable alerts.

■ GPS Tracking
Record detailed mileage and routes, review speed, altitude, and statistics, or add a previous track back to the map to retrace it. Import and export GPX, KML, and KMZ files.

■ GPS Dash Cam & Action Cam Video
Record the road or the action with synchronized speed, location, heading, and map data. Choose engaging overlays such as speed, map, Pitch & Roll, and G-Cross for live view, replay, or stamped exports. Keep a clean original, export a full video or selected range, and turn an exact replay frame into a georeferenced photo and waypoint. Loop recording can retain the latest part of a drive without filling storage with one endless recording.

Because of iOS privacy restrictions, video can be recorded only while the camera recording screen is visible. Recording stops if you leave that screen or the app moves to the background. The app does not provide parking surveillance or automatic vehicle-power startup.

■ Mileage Calculator & PDF Reports
Calculate distance, fuel costs, and mileage between addresses. Fill gaps in a mileage log, categorize trips, and create customizable professional reports for reimbursement or tax records.

■ Maps
Choose Apple, Google, blank, or offline road, satellite, and topographic maps. Import MBTiles or SQLiteDB maps, download maps in the app, and create or share KMZ ground overlays.

■ Driving and Navigation Modes
Use a full-screen speed display, mirrored HUD, rally computer, G-Force monitor, taximeter, map, water-sports mode, idle timer, paragliding instruments, or directional navigation for land, air, and marine use.

■ Waypoints & Camera Alerts
Create waypoints with optional photos or audio notes. Receive approach alerts, apply speed limits, and import or export CSV, GPX, KML, and KMZ data. Import red-light and speed-camera data or use the built-in library.

■ Voice Coach & Siri Shortcuts
Hear distance, duration, speed, and altitude at chosen intervals. Start or stop GPS tracking and set speed limits with Siri.

■ Barometric Instruments
View real-time vertical speed and altitude with QFE/QNH support on compatible devices.

■ Background Mileage Tracking
The speedometer and GPS track recorder can run in the background when enabled. Optional auto-recording logs driving without manual start or stop, ideal for tax or reimbursement mileage. It includes 50 free auto-tracks per month, with an upgrade available for unlimited use.

■ Speed & Distance
Displays 0–999 in MPH, km/h, or knots, plus maximum and average speed, distance, altitude, and sunrise/sunset times.

■ Privacy & Compatibility
Location data is used for speed monitoring and trip recording within the app and is not shared with third parties. Requires an iPhone or cellular iPad with GPS; Wi-Fi-only iPads and iPods need an external GPS source. Continued GPS use can reduce battery life.

bluejetty:00186316:ios.description:
PicCollage - the app that lets you create anything to celebrate everything!
With PicCollage, you can turn your photos and videos into memories you want to save and share. Whether you’re looking to flex your creativity with a freestyle collage, stitch together a photo dump of your adventures, or create a quick card for a birthday. PicCollage is the perfect app for the job. Plus, you can even add videos to your collages and create video collages and slideshows that will make your friends and family say, “OMG, where’d you get that?”
It's easy, fun, and completely free. Start right now and create your first collage or card!
PicCollage at a glance
- Create collages, cards and much more
- Edit photos and videos easily - filter, cutout, retouch
- Use ready-to-use layouts, grids & animated templates
- Personalize with fonts, stickers and doodles
- Get VIP access for unlimited creativity
Try PicCollage now! Our free starter pack is full of new stickers to help you edit photos and videos, create collages and design cards instantly.
CREATE COLLAGES, DESIGN CARDS AND MORE
You can let your creativity run wild! Whether you want to make a freestyle collage, create a picture collection, or design a card for a birthday, PicCollage offers you the perfect solution!
EDIT VIDEOS AND PHOTOS - CUT, FILTER, RETOUCH
You can personalize any creations to make your photo and video fit perfectly into your collages with features like cutouts, doodles and animations, and even add videos to your collages to create stunning video collages and slideshows. Enhance your creations by adding pages and save them as a video or slideshow.
USE TEMPLATES OR CREATE FREESTYLE
You can use a grid, or animated template to create unique cards for any occasion. Add frames around your photos and spice up your collage with fun animations. Our new AI-powered highlight detection keeps the focus of the photo front and center. Of course, you can also design in freestyle mode.
REMOVE BACKGROUNDS WITH AI
With our cutout tool, you can easily remove the background from a photo to isolate people and pets! But our cutout tool isn’t just a background eraser, it also has fun designs that let you cut photos into stars, hearts, squares and more. We’re always updating this feature to give you the sharpest finish possible.
CHOOSE FROM A VARIETY OF FONTS
Add more fun to your collage with text! We offer a variety of fonts for you to choose from, from handwritten to formal. If you want something special, explore our curved text editor to effortlessly display your text in a rounded arc, circle, around your photos, or in other creative ways. AI-powered font pairing in our speedy suggested layouts mode will take your designs to the next level.
ADD BACKGROUNDS AND STICKERS
Thanks to our worldwide collaboration with famous artists and illustrators, PicCollage offers you thousands of exclusive backgrounds and stickers. Add a background to your photos and collages and embellish everything with trendy stickers!
PERSONALIZE WITH DOODLES
To add a personal touch to your collage, card or slideshow, you can create your own drawings and doodles. This is the perfect way to add the finishing touch to your creation.
USE TEMPLATES FOR YOUR INSTAGRAM STORY
Whenever you're on Insta and want to create impressive posts, try our templates. Create an Instagram story or reel and share it directly with your followers!
PICCOLLAGE VIP
PicCollage VIP is a subscription that offers advanced features and removes watermarks and ads. With the 7-day trial version, you can test it for free! As a VIP, you get access to thousands of stickers and backgrounds, as well as exclusive fonts and layouts.
Get the PicCollage photo and video editor and let your memories shine!

Habbo – Social Online Game, Avatar Chat & Pixel Art. Hangout with friends, Live-chat, Role-play and Build in an EPIC pixelated virtual world! 
Habbo, the EPIC original social and building MMO game is now available on your mobile device! With stunning pixel art graphics and a community built on over 300 million accounts worldwide, Habbo provides an immersive virtual world where you can chat, role play, make friends, build and participate in challenges and games.
Take your friendships and creations wherever you go, role play on the move and take part in live events wherever you are.
LIVE SOCIAL ROLE PLAYING GAME
Habbo Hotel is the Original Virtual World where you can become who you’ve always wanted to be.
Chat live and meet with other people from around the world. Visit unique locations and explore what the Hotel has to offer. Be the center of attention with stylish clothing items and outrageous room builds. There's new things to see and do in the Hotel every month!
CREATE AND CUSTOMISE YOUR PIXEL ART AVATAR
Customise your avatar and express yourself by choosing from a huge array of clothing items and accessories. Reflect your own personal style and or go overboard with outrageous costumes, the choice is yours and the combinations endless! New exciting items released regularly!
SOCIAL RPG GAMEPLAY
Live-chat with others, meet new people and make friends. Influence others to become the most popular guest! Do you love to chat and hang out with friends? Habbo Groups, forums and Roleplaying communities are a great place to start. Gather your friends and create a role-play group or join one of the many already thriving user created groups like the Army, Mafia, Intelligence Service and Hospital, there really is something for everyone!
BECOME A MASTER BUILDER & DESIGN YOUR OWN ROOMS
Design and customise your own hotel room with a wide selection of furniture items and decorations! Let your imagination fly and let your creativity take the reins! Create a cozy winter chateau, a bustling cyberpunk street or a crazy scientist’s laboratory, the only limit is your creativity! More than 500 million rooms have been built in Habbo, with players using a variety of furniture and pixel items to create their dream spaces. New collections released every month!
MORE THAN JUST A GAME
Creativity and individuality are welcomed in Habbo! Every week we have tons of awesome competitions for you to enter. From room building to Selfies, to pixel art videos and short story comps - there are tons of cool things to get your artistic juices flowing and win awesome achievements + prizes! Feeling creative? bluejetty:00096849:ios.description:
Match colors, smash blocks, and clear the wood board in NO TIMER Block Color Mania!
Each vibrant block has its own shape and matching color gate. Your goal? Drag every piece to its color-coded exit. No filling rows - this is a challenging, precision-driven twist on the classic wood block puzzle, with no time limits and zero pressure. Relax and enjoy the challenge at your own pace!
With silky-smooth controls, bold visuals, and that oh-so-satisfying smash when a block hits its target, this game delivers a tactile, brain-tingling experience from the very first move.
# How to Play #
· Drag & Move the Color Blocks
Slide each uniquely shaped, colorful block across the board and guide it to the matching colored exit gate. 
· Match Colors to Smash
Once a block reaches the gate with the same color, BOOM - it's smashed! Each correct match clears space.
· Avoid Gridlock
Don't let the board get too crowded. Misplaced blocks can block paths for others, so plan your order carefully to prevent a full-blown block jam.
· Discover New Patterns & Obstacles
As you progress, new twists emerge: trickier block shapes, tighter grids, and unpredictable color layouts. Each level offers a fresh puzzle that pushes your reflexes and strategy to the next level.
# Game Features #
1. Wood Puzzle Feel, Fresh Gameplay
Classic wood block charm meets smooth movement and color logic.
2. No Time Limits, Just Relax & Play
There's no timer, so you can take your time and enjoy solving each puzzle without any pressure.
3. Color Match & Smash
Guide each block to its matching gate and smash it!
4. Tough but Fair
Levels get trickier with tighter grids and unique shapes.
5. Offline Gameplay
No Wi-Fi needed. Pure puzzle fun anytime, anywhere.
# What Makes It Different? #
· No Timer, No Stress
Enjoy a completely stress-free experience - without a timer, you can focus on the puzzle and make each move at your own pace.
· Slick, Responsive Controls
Feel every drag and release. With ultra-smooth mechanics, your decisions translate into instant, satisfying action.
· Polished Wood Aesthetic Meets Bold Colors
The perfect mix of calming wood textures and eye-catching color design keeps you visually engaged.
· Satisfying Clean-the-Board Goals
Deliver every block to its destination and leave no pieces behind. That full-clear moment? Unbeatable.
Ready to test your reflexes, logic, and color sense?
Block Color Mania is the fresh, relaxing twist on wood block jam puzzles you've been waiting for. Start playing now and smash your way to mastery!
Privacy Policy: https://blockcolor.gurugame.ai/policy.html
Terms of Service: https://blockcolor.gurugame.ai/termsofservice.html

bluejetty:00144838:ios.summary:
《風起三國之亂世逐鹿》特邀著名作家馬伯庸擔任世界觀構架師，亞洲知名配樂家梅林茂大師和Chad Cannon配樂，年度史詩級三國IP產品！週年慶福利大放送，全新武將限時登場！風起一週年，慶典狂歡開啟！
[無限首抽，卡牌遊戲福利登場]
誠意滿滿，卡牌遊戲玩家的福利。無限首抽，無限重置！ 對抽卡結果不滿意，推倒重新來！（為保障遊戲數值平衡，卡池內不包含所有武將）
[次世代美術畫面，策略元素內核]
真實無縫地圖，策略城戰玩法，即時戰鬥等多元素深度融合，帶來沉浸式三國戰場表現！
bluejetty:00144838:ios.description:
《風起三國之亂世逐鹿》特邀著名作家馬伯庸擔任世界觀構架師，亞洲知名配樂家梅林茂大師和Chad Cannon配樂，年度史詩級三國IP產品！週年慶福利大放送，全新武將限時登場！風起一週年，慶典狂歡開啟！
[無限首抽，卡牌遊戲福利登場]
誠意滿滿，卡牌遊戲玩家的福利。無限首抽，無限重置！ 對抽卡結果不滿意，推倒重新來！（為保障遊戲數值平衡，卡池內不包含所有武將）
[次世代美術畫面，策略元素內核]
真實無縫地圖，策略城戰玩法，即時戰鬥等多元素深度融合，帶來沉浸式三國戰場表現！
特色沙盤戰爭玩法，為你打造金戈鐵馬和博弈策略的次時代三國。
戰鬥場面真實宏大，物理交互極其出色，帶來深度還原古老的三國戰場！
[江山一覽，風高露寒]
還原真實的戰場體驗，我們採用PBR高效渲染技術構建三國時期宏偉3D大地圖。你可以穿越森林迷霧，也可翻越崇山峻嶺，發現暗藏其中的寶藏，當然也會遭遇敵軍險象迭生，是危機還是機遇，一切皆由你發現。
[排兵佈陣，即時戰鬥]
武將麾下精兵百萬，遊戲通過戰前佈陣策略，對不同兵團種類、數量以及站位排布做詳細謀劃，戰中可操作武將釋放各類酷炫大招，可破大陣，亦可突進斬將於亂軍。
各武將之間羈絆組合，戰場技能緊密聯動，戰鬥質變策略升級！ 各類武將處於同一戰場時產生新的機制變化，在特定的環境下可加強武將技能的作用，近千種搭配，給予玩家極高的策略空間！
[無損繼承，靈活搭配]
減少角色養成時間，武將上陣「禦軍臺」便可繼承對應槽位的培養進度，不論等級、技能、品階還是裝備強化、精煉等方面，通通無損繼承，不需要從零開始辛苦養成；真正做到超越一鍵升級，連升階材料的收集都大幅度減少！
[沙盤戰役，運籌帷幄]
為追求沉浸式攻城體驗，我們在城戰中採用了沙盤戰棋推演的方式，使用計謀搭配打破戰役僵局，領略真實三國故事，一場戰役多種計謀搭配，拓寬策略搭配自由度；合理的規劃行軍路線，利用天時地利妙計錦囊，既可一騎當千，更能運籌帷幄！

bluejetty:00184994:ios.description:
Do you love the pink color? Have you ever played Sudoku games? Why don’t you try Pink Sudoku once? The mind game is amazingly simple to learn and fun to play with an alert mind!
About Sudoku:
The popular Japanese puzzle game Sudoku is based on the logical placement of numbers. Sudoku doesn’t require any calculation or special math skills; all that is needed are brains and concentration.
How to play Sudoku?
The goal of Sudoku is to fill in a 9×9 grid with digits so that each column, row, and 3×3 section contains the numbers between 1 to 9. At the beginning of the game, the 9×9 grid will have some of the squares filled in. Your job is to use logic to fill in the missing digits and complete the grid. Don’t forget, a move is incorrect if:
- Any row contains more than one of the same number from 1 to 9
- Any column contains more than one of the same number from 1 to 9
- Any 3×3 grid contains more than one of the same number from 1 to 9
Features:
Before you hit the download button, take a glance at the entertaining features of the puzzle game Pink Sudoku:
1. Simple to understand but the lively user interface,
2. Beautiful PINK color theme.
3. Include 2000 puzzles
4. It is a multi-level pack game: level packs are Easy, Normal, Hard, and Master
5. Support game center, check how other players are playing this Pink Sudoku puzzle game.
6. Play the game unlimited offline unless you want to access the leaderboard.
7. You can customise how you'd like your Sudoku.
8. Click or drag and drop Control.
9. Scanning Feature: Easily scan Sudoku puzzles, start playing instantly.
Download the entertaining Pink Sudoku game app: playing this Pink Sudoku puzzle game will help you manage stress in a more manageable way. The free iOS game will offer iPad optimization.

bluejetty:00115870:ios.description:
Want to spend some time with your Girlfriend? Too bad, your rhythmic skills are being challenged by just about every nasty goon on planet earth. So you'll need to flex your skills and hit notes in time with the music, or the only place you'll be spending your friday is the hospital.
DADDY DON'T PLAY NICE
In this story you play as BOYFRIEND who's trying to spend some time with no other than GIRLFRIEND. Bummer her evil, twisted freak of a father would sooner put you to rest than ever allow it. And it's not just him, go through the story and meet the many disturbed and backwards dopes who'd try to stand in your way. 
BANGIN' SOUNDTRACK
Enjoy the music that's made waves online, and learn it to a T as you put your rhythm to the test hitting notes in time. Largely composed by KawaiSprite and Saruky, with industry talent collaborations like Lotus Juice of 'Persona 3' fame and Kohta Takahashi of 'Ridge Racer 4' fame. With over 60+ original songs currently in the game, there's plenty to master. 
INTERACTIVE CARTOON EXCELLENCE
Hand drawn, lovingly made 2D visuals. Every stage unique, every enemy special, and made right in Adobe Flash. The art and animations of PhantomArcade bring the Newgrounds spirit to phones in full force. And with more levels, cutscenes, and playable characters on the way... the amount of eye candy The Funkin Crew will bring has no end in sight.
The internet classic with 200+ million players is finally here on the App Store, in its best form yet
Other features include
+ Gameplay overseen by Tom Fulp
+ Code by Ninjamuffin99
+ Sky Mod (wait thats not in this)
+ JohnnyUtah voice acting
+ Hot(?) characters!
+ 18 years worth of gameplay

bluejetty:00025967:ios.description:
WELCOME TO THE FORUM.
More than a workout. A place to move, connect, and become stronger together.
At The Forum, we believe strength is built through more than physical movement. It's found in the discipline to show up, the confidence to challenge yourself, and the community that supports you along the way.
Rooted in the Greek philosophy of Arete—the pursuit of excellence—our mission is to help you grow stronger, both physically and mentally, through intentional movement and balanced training.
TWO ROOMS. ONE COMMUNITY.
Our signature two-room concept brings together complementary styles of movement, giving you the freedom to train with purpose and find balance in your routine.
THE HI ROOM
Strength and high-intensity interval training designed to build power, endurance, and confidence. Expect dynamic programming, functional movements, and workouts that challenge you to discover what you're capable of.
THE LO ROOM
A mindful approach to movement through infrared-heated mat Pilates-inspired sculpt, yoga, and low-impact training. Designed to build strength, stability, and mobility while connecting movement, breath, and mind.
Whether you're lifting heavier, moving with intention, or simply showing up for yourself, there's a place for you here.
YOUR MOVEMENT. YOUR COMMUNITY. YOUR FORUM.
Download The Forum app to explore our class schedule, reserve your spot, manage your membership, and stay connected to a community committed to growing stronger together.
Welcome to The Forum. We're glad you're here.

bluejetty:00134178:ios.description:
Learn, Practice and Pass your Driving Exam.
A must have app for all road users that helps you to search for rules you missed and improve your driving skills.
Drivio Alberta offers an advanced test system to your device offering 1000+ practice questions. With this application you will make progress more quickly than with any other traditional method, as you can take the tests wherever and whenever you want: at the bus stop, in the classroom, at work or at the dentist’s waiting room!
APP FEATURES:
- Intelligent learning system
- Keep a track of your driving lessons, save your lessons, add times and dates, traffic conditions, notes and lesson costs
- Road rules theory of Alberta State - Test your knowledge with 1000+ questions 
- We randomize questions and answers each time you start a practice test
- Statistics module to track and monitor your progress
- Flashcards
- Search theory content
- Add pages to bookmark
- No internet connection required once installed
The application is divided into the following sections:
# Feed section which is designed to quickly remember and learn exam questions and other fundamental road rules knowledge.
Try it and you will love it!
# Road rules theory: You can study the official online guides containing Alberta's traffic laws, traffic signs and regulations.
In this section you will learn about:
- Licence types
- Road safety
- Safe driving
- General road rules
- Traffic signs
- Penalties
- and much more.
 # Practice:
Test your knowledge by practicing.
This section have 8 already prepared mock theory tests, all test are created based on 10 categories, these are:
- General Knowledge
- Alcohol and Drugs - Fatigue and Defensive Driving
- Intersections
- Traffic Lights / Lanes - Negligent Driving
- Pedestrians
- Seat Belts / Restraints - Speed Limits - Traffic Signs
# Flashcards:
This section contains 500 questions, that helps your to memorize better all theory questions. If you have doubts about your answer just tap on the card to see the right answer. Swipe left or right to see next question.
# Progress Monitor:
The application saves the result of each test answered and a history of failures and successes. At the end of the test, you can check your answers and learn from your mistakes.
Disclaimer
This handbook is not intended to be used as a legal document. It is intended as a guide only, and its aim is to set out, in simple form, the main legal requirements in Canada that a driver is required to observe in everyday driving, as well as other useful information for drivers.

Learn, Practice and Pass your Driving Exam.

A must have app for all road users that helps you to search for rules you missed and improve your driving skills.
Drivio Alberta offers an advanced test system to your device offering 1000+ practice questions. With this application you will make progress more quickly than with any other traditional method, as you can take the tests wherever and whenever you want: at the bus stop, in the classroom, at work or at the dentist’s waiting room!

APP FEATURES:

- Intelligent learning system
- Keep a track of your driving lessons, save your lessons, add times and dates, traffic conditions, notes and lesson costs
- Road rules theory of Alberta State - Test your knowledge with 1000+ questions 
- We randomize questions and answers each time you start a practice test
- Statistics module to track and monitor your progress
- Flashcards
- Search theory content
- Add pages to bookmark
- No internet connection required once installed


The application is divided into the following sections:
# Feed section which is designed to quickly remember and learn exam questions and other fundamental road rules knowledge.
Try it and you will love it!

# Road rules theory: You can study the official online guides containing Alberta's traffic laws, traffic signs and regulations.

In this section you will learn about:
- Licence types
- Road safety
- Safe driving
- General road rules
- Traffic signs
- Penalties
- and much more.

 # Practice:
Test your knowledge by practicing.
This section have 8 already prepared mock theory tests, all test are created based on 10 categories, these are:
- General Knowledge
- Alcohol and Drugs - Fatigue and Defensive Driving
- Intersections
- Traffic Lights / Lanes - Negligent Driving
- Pedestrians
- Seat Belts / Restraints - Speed Limits - Traffic Signs


# Flashcards:
This section contains 500 questions, that helps your to memorize better all theory questions. If you have doubts about your answer just tap on the card to see the right answer. Swipe left or right to see next question.


# Progress Monitor:
The application saves the result of each test answered and a history of failures and successes. At the end of the test, you can check your answers and learn from your mistakes.


Disclaimer
This handbook is not intended to be used as a legal document. It is intended as a guide only, and its aim is to set out, in simple form, the main legal requirements in Canada that a driver is required to observe in everyday driving, as well as other useful information for drivers.

bluejetty:00114319:ios.description:
The Home Tee Hero interactive golf simulator experience brings the game to you. Practice and play year-round on any of the 43,000+ preloaded courses. To access, you need an active Garmin Golf™ membership and your compatible Garmin launch monitor.
• 43,000+ COURSES
With more than 43,000 courses, you can tee off on your home course, play where the pros play or practice for an upcoming golf trip.
• REALISTIC SIMULATION
Enjoy unique course environments, including desert, grassland and tropical, plus fine-tuned shot physics and green friction.
• ENHANCED COURSES
Enjoy even more realistic play on 15+ courses with high-resolution lidar data for every green and more accurate tree coverage throughout the course.
• ON-COURSE PRACTICE
Hit a shot from anywhere on any course. Then do it again. On-course practice mode was made for dialing in your game and trying to hit that island green.
• MULTIPLAYER MODE
Gather your friends to play a virtual round. In local multiplayer mode, you can golf with up to 4 people.
• WEEKLY TOURNAMENTS
Compete in virtual tournaments against other golfers around the world. Each week, you can play the tournament course as many times as you want to climb higher on the leaderboard.

bluejetty:00164016:ios.description:
Available in Bengaluru, Delhi, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kochi, Mysore & Tumkur
Namma Yatri is a community initiative that provides hassle-free auto & cab booking experience for its customers. Built with feedback from drivers & customers, the app strives to build a sustainable, long-term, and transparent mobility solution. 
Whether it's an easy commute to the office or a quick pick-up for a weekend hangout, Namma Yatri has got you covered with its autos & cabs!
The Namma Yatri Difference
- Namma Yatri charges its driver zero commission! This means you pay less and the driver earns more - it’s magic!
- 100% payment goes directly to the driver without any cuts or any middlemen
- It is already India’s most loved app by drivers and customers alike
- We only assign trips to drivers closeby so you get lightning fast bookings and your assigned driver reaches your location in no time
- Our drivers are super happy and hence there are low cancellations thereby providing you happy rides
- All our data is 100% Open. Check it out at nammayatri.in/open
Booking autos & cabs has never been this easy & hassle-free!
Feature highlights
- Quick and easy booking: Install - Signup - Book- Pay & Repeat, you can book a ride to come at your doorstep.
- Fast, Easy & Safe: Find an auto ride easily with a few taps on your mobile and enjoy a hassle-free ride.
- Save your favourite locations: You no longer need to set the location every time you book a ride; you can pick it up from your marked locations without hassle.
- Repeat Ride: Book your office ride every day without hassle. Click on "Repeat ride" instead of entering your pickup and drop location all over again.
- Navigation and Real-time tracking: Track your Ride in real-time and know exactly when your auto will arrive and where you're commuting with the best-in-class maps technology.
- Affordable fares: Our fares are fair and affordable, so you don't have to worry about overpaying for your Ride. No haggling. No bargaining. No waste of time.
- Direct Payment: Pay directly to the Driver in cash or UPI.
- 100% Transparency: No hidden charges; you can check the rate card to know the breakdown of your Ride. Rate the Ride and give feedback for improvement.
- Multiple languages to choose from – Access Namma Yatri in English, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu & Hindi
How to book an auto/cab through Namma yatri app
- Download Namma Yatri auto/cab booking app
- Signup on the app with your phone number
- Pick your drop location and then confirm your pickup location
- Let us assign the nearest driver
- Start your ride
- Pay the driver directly through cash or UPI, at the end of the trip
Reviews from Customers
“I used the app during peak hours. Not only did I get paired immediately, the fare displayed was very reasonable given the distance. I would highly recommend this over other apps and congrats to the team for solving one of Bengaluru's persistent problems.” - Konchady
“Best app for booking auto in Bangalore. Most of the time drivers will be available in 10 mins at the maximum. Availability has been the best feature in this.” - Vamsi
“Reliable travel partner in Namma metro city Bengaluru. Faster response and tension free booking.. So far, I didn't see any issues with booking or traveling. Loved it!!” - Punithraj

bluejetty:00070390:ios.summary: Namaz sureleri ve dualarını, namaz sureleri dışındaki diğer surelerden bazılarını, müezzinlikte okunan temel duaları vb. ezberlemek için yardımcı bir uygulama sunuyoruz. Ayrıca namazların kılınışını ana hatlarıyla öğrenebileceğiniz, basit b
bluejetty:00070390:ios.description:
Namaz sureleri ve dualarını, namaz sureleri dışındaki diğer surelerden bazılarını, müezzinlikte okunan temel duaları vb. ezberlemek için yardımcı bir uygulama sunuyoruz. Ayrıca namazların kılınışını ana hatlarıyla öğrenebileceğiniz, basit bir simülasyon (benzetim) ile seçeceğiniz bir namazı baştan sona sesli ve görüntülü takip edebileceğiniz Namaz Hocası (Namaz nasıl kılınır?) bölümü bulunmaktadır.
Namaz kılmak isteyenler namaz simülatörü ile beş vakit namazı ve vitir namazını kılmayı öğrenebilirler. Bu bölümde zammı sureler şimdilik sabit olarak verilmektedir. Namazlar ile ilgili bilgilerde verildiği gibi namaz kılarken, farklı ayet ve sureler okunabilir.
Sure ve dua öğretici, ezberletici adını verdiğimiz uygulamamız ile seçeceğiniz bir sureyi ayet ayet, duaları da cümle cümle ve belirli aralıklarla tekrar eden şekilde dinleyebilirsiniz. Sesli olarak okunan ayetler ve dualar Arapça ve Latin harfleriyle (Türkçe) takip edilebilir. O anda okunan ayet veya dua cümlesi renkli olarak gösterilmektedir. Başlat düğmesine her dokunduğunuzda sure birinci ayetten tekrar başlayacaktır. 
Farklı hız seçenekleri ile okuma hızını dilediğiniz şekilde ayarlayabilirsiniz.
Her bir cümlenin kaç kere tekrar etmesini ve tekrarlar arasında kaç saniye beklemesini istiyorsanız, hemen o ekranda bunları ayarlayabilirsiniz. Sureyi veya duayı dinlemeye başladığınız anda bile tekrar sayısı ve bekleme zamanı ayarlarında değişiklik yapabilirsiniz. Dinlediğiniz ayeti (veya cümleyi) tekrar etmeniz için araya uygun bir bekleme zamanı ayarlamanızı tavsiye ederiz.
Sure veya duanın sadece belli bir yerini dinlemek isterseniz, istediğiniz satıra parmağınızın ucuyla dokunmanız yeterli. Hangi satıra dokunursanız uygulamamız o satıra geçecektir. Dilediğiniz cümleyi iyice öğrenene kadar tekrar edebileceksiniz.
Sureleri ve duaları tekrarsız bir şekilde dinlemek isterseniz tekrar sayısını ve bekleme süresini en az değere ayarlamanız yeterli olacaktır.
Metin boyutlarını değiştirmek isterseniz yine aynı ekranda gösterilen bölümde - ve + düğmelerini kullanabilirsiniz.
Ekranının sağ üst köşesindeki seçeceği işaretleyerek dua veya sureyi Ezberlendi olarak işaretleyebilirsiniz.
İnşallah uygulamamızın bir miktar da olsa faydalı olmasını ümit ediyoruz.

Uygulamamız ile ayet ve duaları cümle cümle görüp, okuyup, dinleyip, otomatik tekrarlarla öğrenebileceğinizi umuyoruz. Ezan dinlemek için bile kullanabilirsiniz.
Besmele, ayet olarak sadece Fatiha Suresinde seslendirilmiştir. Ios ortamındaki fontlardan dolayı şeddeli kullanımlarda esre harfin değil şeddenin altında gösterilebilmektedir.

Tek ayetten oluşan bazı uzun bölümler, ezber kolaylığı olması açısından bölümlere ayrılmıştır.
Uygulamamız için sure ve duaları özel olarak okuyup bize gönderen Nuri Akar Hocamıza çok teşekkür ediyoruz. Allah ondan ve sizlerden razı olsun.

bluejetty:00125634:ios.description:
*** Roon ARC requires a valid Roon subscription ***
ARC puts the best possible on-the-go music experience in your pocket and lets you enjoy your Roon library and all of Roon's immersive features wherever you are in the world.
ARC is a custom-built streaming service powered by your Roon system at home. Explore your complete collection of artists, albums, playlists, and personal music files, plus TIDAL, Qobuz, and KKBOX streams. Discover added content from Roon's music experts and smart features, such as staff-curated playlists, Daily Mixes, New Releases for You, personalized recommendations, and Roon Radio. You can add albums to your collection, build playlists, set favorites, create tags, and more, just as you can in Roon. 
Offline listening lets you download your personal music files to keep the music playing wherever your adventures take you – even if you're off the grid entirely. ARC offers remote access to Roon's captivating library of in-depth artist bios and album articles, revealing the stories that take us deep into the heart of our favorite music. And there's more…
Ready to hit the road? Your Roon library is too! Roon's browsing and discovery features fully integrate into your car's controls for safe and convenient playback. With ARC within easy reach of the wheel, every road you take is a journey in sound. ARC makes the driver's seat feel like your listening chair at home.
ARC is designed to look and feel just like Roon. You get the same intuitive, aesthetically rich Roon interface you know and love, fully optimized for your phone. No more switching between streaming apps; ARC compiles all your music in one place for easy access and maximum enjoyment. 
And now, Roon's audio shaping suite and pristine sound quality have arrived in ARC - with bold styling never before seen in a mobile app! MUSE delivers the precision audio control of Roon when you're on the go or running a streamlined mobile setup with ARC. It places radically unique EQ handling, optimized balance control, precision volume leveling, FLAC, DSD & MQA support, crossfeed, headroom management, and sample rate conversion in the palm of your hand.
You can customize sonic qualities to your specific tastes with MUSE, then save or apply them with a few clicks. To top it all off, MUSE even remembers your presets and reapplies them when you reconnect to a known device. The MUSE Signal Path display provides complete audio signal transparency as the music flows through your device - from source media all the way to your speakers.

listings.name: Roon ARC
listings.description:
*** Roon ARC requires a valid Roon subscription ***

ARC puts the best possible on-the-go music experience in your pocket and lets you enjoy your Roon library and all of Roon's immersive features wherever you are in the world.

ARC is a custom-built streaming service powered by your Roon system at home. Explore your complete collection of artists, albums, playlists, and personal music files, plus TIDAL, Qobuz, and KKBOX streams.  Discover added content from Roon's music experts and smart features, such as staff-curated playlists, Daily Mixes, New Releases for You, personalized recommendations, and Roon Radio. You can add albums to your collection, build playlists, set favorites, create tags, and more, just as you can in Roon. 

Offline listening lets you download your personal music files to keep the music playing wherever your adventures take you – even if you're off the grid entirely. ARC offers remote access to Roon's captivating library of in-depth artist bios and album articles, revealing the stories that take us deep into the heart of our favorite music. And there's more…

Ready to hit the road? Your Roon library is too! Roon's browsing and discovery features fully integrate into your car's controls for safe and convenient playback. With ARC within easy reach of the wheel, every road you take is a journey in sound. ARC makes the driver's seat feel like your listening chair at home.

ARC is designed to look and feel just like Roon. You get the same intuitive, aesthetically rich Roon interface you know and love, fully optimized for your phone. No more switching between streaming apps; ARC compiles all your music in one place for easy access and maximum enjoyment. 

And now, Roon's audio shaping suite and pristine sound quality have arrived in ARC - with bold styling never before seen in a mobile app! MUSE delivers the precision audio control of Roon when you're on the go or running a streamlined mobile setup with ARC. It places radically unique EQ handling, optimized balance control, precision volume leveling, FLAC, DSD & MQA support, crossfeed, headroom management, and sample rate conversion in the palm of your hand.
 
You can customize sonic qualities to your specific tastes with MUSE, then save or apply them with a few clicks. To top it all off, MUSE even remembers your presets and reapplies them when you reconnect to a known device. The MUSE Signal Path display provides complete audio signal transparency as the music flows through your device - from source media all the way to your speakers.

ARC offers artful design, sound quality, and a music listening experience unmatched by any other music app. Best of all, it's included free with your Roon subscription.
