bluejetty:00044955:ios.summary:
Our history of innovation can be traced back to our founding in 1876. Today that means giving you convenient and secure access to manage your accounts through our mobile banking app. 
If you don’t have an account with INTRUST Bank, you can
bluejetty:00044955:ios.description:
Our history of innovation can be traced back to our founding in 1876. Today that means giving you convenient and secure access to manage your accounts through our mobile banking app. 
If you don’t have an account with INTRUST Bank, you can open a FREE personal or business checking account. Visit intrustbank.com to learn more about the personal and business banking accounts we offer.
Whether you’re an individual or a business owner, here’s what you can do with the app:
VIEW AND MANAGE YOUR ACCOUNTS AND TRANSACTIONS
View your INTRUST checking, savings, time deposit, and loan accounts in one convenient location. Monitor balances, search through recent transactions, view statements, and create alerts. Add custom tags and upload images to individual transactions to help keep you organized.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR DASHBOARD
Personalize your experience by customizing your dashboard to highlight the accounts and tools you use most often and hide those you don’t.
TRANSFER FUNDS
Easily transfer money between your INTRUST accounts, or between your personal accounts at INTRUST and those you own at other financial institutions. Schedule a one-time transfer when you need it or set up a recurring transfer to help you grow your savings.
PAY BILLS
Schedule one-time or recurring payments to any business in the United States. Manage your payees by adding new or editing existing entries.
SEND MONEY WITH ZELLE® (not available for business accounts)
Send money to family and friends using just a U.S. mobile phone number or email address.
MANAGE YOUR DEBIT CARD
Do more to prevent fraudulent charges with powerful card management tools. Turn your debit card on and off at the tap of a button. Set up notifications for when your card is used. You can even set limits based on geography, transaction amount, or merchant and transaction types.
DEPOSIT CHECKS
Deposit paper checks into your accounts using the camera on your smart phone or tablet. No visit to the bank required.
GET SUPPORT WITH MESSAGES
If you have a question or need help with your accounts, you can start a conversation with customer service at any time online or through the app. A customer service representative will be there to assist you as soon as possible during our support hours. You can even quickly reference specific accounts, transactions, or payments in your message to keep the conversation running smoothly.
LOCATE BANKING CENTERS AND ATMS
Locate nearby INTRUST banking centers and ATMS, including 55,000+ surcharge-free ATMs through the Allpoint® network.
When you enroll through the INTRUST Bank app, you also have access to online banking, available at intrustbank.com.
If you have questions about the app or need assistance, contact Customer Service at 800-895-2265 and we’ll be happy to help.
Zelle and the Zelle related marks are wholly owned by Early Warning Services, LLC and are used herein under license.

Fully voiced by top-tier voice actors, each scene draws you deeper into the story.

bluejetty:00114421:ios.summary: Immerse yourself in the delightful world of Rubber Bridge, featuring finely tuned AI opponents, support for the SAYC bidding system, and automatic scoring with detailed score breakdowns. Whether you're a seasoned player or a newcomer, enjoy
bluejetty:00114421:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the delightful world of Rubber Bridge, featuring finely tuned AI opponents, support for the SAYC bidding system, and automatic scoring with detailed score breakdowns. Whether you're a seasoned player or a newcomer, enjoy the game's guidance system for helpful tips and a learning experience that adapts to your skill level.
On Bridge, you play as South, while North, East, and West are skillfully managed by the same AI across all tables, providing a seamless and instant gaming experience. Players engage in two critical phases: the bidding, determining the contract, and the play, where the declarer team strives to secure the tricks needed for contract. When either team scores 100 points twice through contracts, the team with the highest total score wins the final victory.
Features:
- Learn the Classic Bridge in a low-pressure, easy-to-learn, simple environment
- Play offline - bots are available to play whenever and wherever
- Customization - Choose the deck backs, color theme, and even AI level.
- Detail statistics - providing insights into your gameplay strategies and progress.
- Need help? Use unlimited hints and undo features
Uncover the engaging world of Bridge – also known as Rubber or Contract Bridge. Its gameplay, reminiscent of Spades but with a heightened level of strategic excitement, appeals to enthusiasts of Spades, Hearts, Whist, and more. If you enjoy those classics, Bridge offers a delightful blend of familiarity and thrilling competition.
Elevate your skills and challenge your mind with Bridge. More than just a game, it's a tool for strategic thinking. Dive in and discover the enduring charm of this captivating card game!

bluejetty:00161183:ios.description:
Buff Gym Workout: Dynamic Tracker, Log & Planner
Level-Up Your Fitness Goals.
Simplify and supercharge your fitness journey with Buff. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced lifter, our dynamic workout tracker gives you everything you need to log your sessions, master your form, connect with friends, and push for new personal bests.
WHAT USERS ARE SAYING
- "Buff is an absolute game-changer... From the moment you open the app, you’re greeted with an intuitive interface that makes navigating through its features effortless." - elm84$
- "The Buff app was key in helping me to prepare for my first bodybuilding competition. With its help, I placed 1st in two categories!" - H. White
- "I really enjoy the achievement system—it adds a nice motivational boost and keeps me engaged. One of the best parts is the workout videos; every exercise has a clear demonstration..." - Mythoriir
WHAT MAKES BUFF YOUR BEST LIFTING PARTNER?
1. Dynamic Workout & Progress Tracking
- Detailed Gym Log: Easily track every set, rep, and weight. Log total volume, total reps, and monitor your PRs (Personal Records) instantly.
- Bodyweight Trends: Track your bodyweight evolution and key performance metrics (average reps, sets, and weight) with colorful, detailed graphs.
- Visualize Muscle Usage: Our unique Anatomy Highlights show you exactly which muscles you've worked and provide an intensity percentage breakdown to ensure balanced training.
2. Master Your Form & Plan Your Training
- Extensive Exercise Library: Explore a wide range of 500+ exercises with free, high-quality video demonstrations featuring real people to ensure perfect technique, maximum results, and safety.
- Customization is Key: Create your own personalized workout routines or choose from our pre-designed, goal-oriented plans.
- Seamless Tracking: Maintain your consistency with a Daily Streak counter that helps you stay on track and build unbreakable habits.
3. Get Motivated & Stay Accountable
- Community & Social Sharing: Join the active Buff Community! Share results, follow friends' progress, celebrate your milestones, and inspire others directly within the app.
- Gamified Progress: Earn Experience Points (XP) and Medals by hitting new achievements in key categories like Strength, Endurance, and Stamina. Make tracking fun and rewarding!
BY HUMANS, FOR HUMANS (A NO-AI APPROACH)
- Most fitness apps rely on AI, but Buff uses none of it. Every workout plan, exercise tutorial, and piece of artwork was created by real people, with the singular goal of making fitness accessible and effective for you.
KEY FEATURES AT A GLANCE
- Track workouts and exercises with an easy-to-use interface.
- Access video demonstrations for proper exercise technique.
- Thoughtfully crafted plans for every fitness level (Beginner to Advanced).
- Create custom workouts and routines.
- In-depth progress graphs for total volume, reps, PRs, and bodyweight.
- Muscle usage visualization with anatomy highlights and percentage breakdowns.
- Social sharing and community features.
- Experience Points & Achievements to gamify your fitness journey.

Yearly Plan
• Duration: 1 year
• Price: $99.99/year

• Renewal charged within 24 hours before the current period ends
• Manage or turn off auto-renewal in Account Settings
• Unused trial period (if any) is forfeited upon subscription purchase

• Duration: 1 month
• Price: $12.99/month
• Payment charged to iTunes Account at purchase confirmation
• Renewal charged within 24 hours before the current period ends
• Manage or turn off auto-renewal in Account Settings
• Unused trial period (if any) is forfeited upon subscription purchase

bluejetty:00071129:ios.description:
Tap to jump, stick to stuff. Simple, right?
You control a squishy blob that can stick to almost anything. Time the moving arrow and tap to jump. Stick your way up terrain, metal beam things, pipes, moving platforms, spinning platforms, and more. wow
Be careful, however, as one wrong jump could land you back at the very beginning.

Keep your cool, improve your jumping skills, and stick with it to the very end.

bluejetty:00127760:ios.description:
Corvette Enthusiasts can use this FREE app look up Years, Models, Options, and RPO Codes to determine the Build, Rarity, Collectability and Present Value of Corvettes from 1953-Present by selecting the condition, the mileage and checking off options.
This is a must-have for anyone buying, selling, restoring, or researching a Corvette. More than a book or a website – it is an active, ever-changing database of Corvette Knowledge. Our experts regularly monitor actual sales data and update our database to keep the estimated values current. Use this App to decode build sheets, determine production quantities, and research original costs while you learn about model specifications. Enjoy reading special commentary provided for each year and noteworthy options. 
The current value numbers listed within the CorvetteDNA application surrounding specific Corvette Models and Options are provided to empower our viewers with guideline information to evaluate Corvettes. When it comes right down to it, the deciding factor that will determine the final selling amount of any Corvette is essentially what someone is willing to pay for it. No one can truly account for the emotional appeal or the personal significance that Corvettes are sometimes measured by. Because of these unpredictable variables, CorvetteDNA neither certifies nor guarantees these values. Consider these values as reasonable estimates you may use to begin a negotiation or make an assessment of a Corvette you intend to buy, sell, restore, or insure. 
Data and Application Versions are being updated regularly. Join the mailing list to stay informed about our products at: www.corvettedna.com/mailing-list-signup 
CorvetteDNA FREE is ad supported by only Corvette and car-related vendors.

bluejetty:00120777:ios.description:
You’ve discovered the Original and World Famous iFart® App. An Apple All-Time TOP 20 App. The definitive Fart Sounds app on iTunes.
----------------------------------
Featured on The Daily Show with Jon Stewart, The Today Show and many others, iFart® is considered the most infamous app of all time. 
Also seen in the Wall Street Journal, USA Today, MSNBC.com, MacDailyNews, MacForums, The New York Times, Barron's, Motley Fool, Gizmodo, Venture Beat, Ars Technica, CNET News, Geek.com, Forbes, The UK Register, Information Week, TechCrunch.com and dozens of publications all over the world!
----------------------------------
iFart® took the app world by storm in 2008. It blasted to #1 on Christmas Day of that year and clinged to number one for weeks. It continued to linger in the Top Ten for over a year! 
We can’t even tell you how much time it spent farting around at #2.
The App has been completely recoded and rebuilt for 2021. 
Here are just a few of the useful, signature features of iFart®.
* SECURITY FART *
Phones and pdas are stolen on a daily basis, but if you are using iFart's advanced security system you can stop criminals right in their tracks.
And when thieves try to snatch your phone, they'll be in for a shock when they're blasted by your chosen sound effect. Most criminals know how to lie, but "it wasn't me" isn't going to work with iFart.
Call the authorities and send these phone stealing scumbags off to the gas chamber.
* SNEAK ATTACK *
The sneak attack function can literally save your life. Let's say that you're in a warehouse gun battle. Bad guys are closing in on you, but if you only had a distraction, you could escape.
Sneak Attack is that distraction. Simply pull out your phone, choose a sound effect and set the timer up to 30 seconds. Then place your phone in a strategic location and move silently away. When the Sneak Attack goes off, slip away or take out the bad guys when they reach for their noses.
* RECORD-A-FART *
There are special moments in life that just have to be captured on your phone to be believed. 
The birth of a child, a stunning sunset, bigfoot, and of course, the after effects of a triple burrito lunch.
Using iFart’s "Record-A-Fart" feature you can now make audible memories for a lifetime and play them for friends and family. Plastic wrap optional.
* FAVE FARTS *
Using our FAVES feature you can create a playlist of your fave farts for easy access. You can also record and rename multiple farts which are stored in the FAVES list.
* BLAST *
If only there was an internationally recognized sound that alleviates stress, brings laughter, lowers blood pressure, clears a room, helps bring peace to the middle east and is enjoyed by both Democrats and Republicans.
Well Folks... just hit the BLAST button and let the healing begin. 
* BONUS FART PACKS*
iFart includes EIGHT of our funniest Fart Packs, each pack contains up to 10 fresh cuts for your enjoyment.
* Jurassic - Ever wonder what a Dinosaur fart sounds like?.
* Presidential - Joe, Kamala, Bernie, Hillary, & Donald let em rip!
* Fart Wars - May the Flatulence Be With You
* Movies - In a world without gas… this is a land that prays for a hero.
* Bands - The bands on the runs with these farts.
* Food - You can't have dessert until you play all these farts.
* Shart Toppers - Music Parody Rips 
* Celebrities - Sorry Kanye, you didn't make the cuts.
Hey, you read this far! 
We've added a bonus fart to our wheel called "Fart-O-Rater". 
Make sure you play it and while you're laughing leave us a review and let us know your what your favorite fart or fart pack is today!

bluejetty:00160552:ios.description:
Want your plants to thrive? Meet Plantility – the app that guides you through plant parenting. With Plantility, you can grow and care for your plants with ease! 
FEATURES 
ACCURATE PLANT IDENTIFICATION
Identify over 1,000,000 unique plants, flowers, trees, succulents, herbs, and mushrooms. Just take a snap or upload a photo of a plant. Scan any plant to get identification results including taxonomy, species information, care tips, and health information. Plantility quickly and accurately identifies plants using your camera. If you want to get the most accurate plant identification, use the multi-image plant identifier to take multiple photos of your plant for increased accuracy.
PLANT HEALTH ID
Is your plant looking sick? Snap a photo and use Plantility Health Scan to determine a diagnosis of your plant. Plantility will tell you how to treat your plant illness and even track the improvement of your plant’s health with the health tracking tool. Add your plant to the health tracker and receive notifications to re-scan and track your plant’s improvement. Quickly determine the health of your plants and how to treat their illness.
PLANT CARE REMINDERS
Don’t ever forget to water your plants on time again. Set up care reminders with Plantility and get notified when it’s time to water, trim, repot, or fertilize your plant. Add your plant to the Plantility health tracker and create reminders.
PLANTILITY GARDEN
Collect your plants and personalize them with Plantility’s garden feature. Organize your identified plants by room, location, or something else to easily find and track them later! If you’re the adventurous type, our garden is now integrated with a map so you can see previously identified plants and where they are in the world! Proud of your garden? Share your scans to the community with a tap! Our garden and community work seamlessly allowing everyone to share their flowers, trees, mushrooms, bushes, and more with ease! 
KEY FEATURES:
 •Identify plants, mushrooms, trees, flowers, and more instantly with your camera. 
 •Diagnose plant illness and problems automatically. Get treatment suggestions within the plant health assessment. 
 •Organize your plants in the improved garden. Group your identified plants by attributes like taxon, genus, species, or organize your scans by room, location, and even custom name. 
 •Track your identifications anywhere in the world.
 •Share your identifications with other nature enthusiasts in the community tab. 
 •Get plant care tips to help your plants stay healthy and thrive. 
 •Get more accurate identification results using a three-image scan with our new camera interface. 
 •Set plant care reminders to check on and re-scan your unhealthy plants to help them get healthier faster. 
 •Search our plant database to find endless information on any type of flower, tree, mushroom, shrub, and more. Get soil information, light requirements, pet information, and more through search. 
Take the guesswork out of gardening with this plant identifier app. Easily identify plants, get plant care tips, watering tips, and keep your plants healthy with Plantility. 
About Plantility Premium:
- Payment will be charged to your Apple account at purchase confirmation time.
- Upon purchasing a subscription, users will be granted unlimited plant scans.
- Upon purchasing a subscription, you will be granted unlimited plant health scans.
- Upon purchasing a subscription, you will be granted unlimited plant posting and sharing.
- Subscriptions can be managed and cancelled by the user in the app store subscriptions menu.
Terms: https://plantility.app/terms
Privacy: https://plantility.app/privacy/
Contact: https://plantility.app/contact/

bluejetty:00178806:ios.description:
The app installs keyboard extensions with cool, polished designs that will change the standard iOS Keyboard Colors. You can switch back to existing native keyboard anytime.
Keyboard Skins has built in Emoji keyboard and our custom smile stickers. This gives you faster, more comfortable typing experience as you don't have to change keyboard language each time you need to send smiley face.:) 
Keyboard Skins supports English, Georgian, German, Russian and Filipino keyboards.
Awesome new experience is Shortcuts function. To make life easier, you can save frequently typed info once, and use them right from the keyboard. E.g. Bank accounts, Personal ID's, Email addresses and etc. 
Have you ever created your own keyboard? Now it’s possible with built in Keyboard Skin maker. Just import or take picture and that’s it!
Get the new keyboard designs and fancy look for your iPhone or iPad with all aforesaid features now. 
After adding Georgian, German, Russian and Filipino, users can switch between 2 languages by swiping on the keyboard up or to the left.
Keyboard Skins is fully compatible with native messaging app and all major messaging apps including Viber, Whatsapp, Twitter, Skype as well.
Even more personalization available by replacing the standard typing sound with new ones bundled inside app.
The app works perfectly with all models of iOS 8 and later devices.
Keyboard Skins ver. 3.0 comes with 100+ bundled themes and weekly updates. So you always have new, trendy keyboard theme all time. :)
The app offers up to 150 different keyboard skins. Popular skins are free, some skins are locked and are available through in-app purchase.
You can get Pro features through auto-renewing subscription and if you want to continue getting premium features, your subscription should be continued.
- 3-month Pro features subscription costs $1.99 monthly after 3-day free trial.
Prices are in U.S. dollars, may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change with notice.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription.
Your account will be charged for a renewed subscription within 24 hours prior to the end of current subscription.
You can manage your subscription and switch off the auto-renewal by accessing your account settings after purchase.
You cannot cancel the current subscription during the active subscription period.
Any unused part or time-span of a free trial period will be forfeited, as soon as you purchase a subscription.
PRO features can be purchased through one time in-app purchase or through auto-renewable monthly subscription. First month of subscription is free and can be cancelled any time. After trial period, the paid subscription starts, which renews automatically unless cancelled 24 hours before the end of current period. more information can be found on the following link: https://www.lemondo.com/KeyboardSkinsTerms.html
privacy link: http://lemondo.com/privacy
We want to hear your suggestions, likes, complains.. Please leave your feedback, rate us on the AppStore or use the contact link to stay in touch.
Thanks,
Lemondo Team

bluejetty:00041440:ios.name: The Zebra Club
bluejetty:00041440:ios.summary:
The Zebra Club - Movement, Education and Community for Hypermobility, Ehlers-Danlos Syndromes, Hypermobility Spectrum Disorders, and Chronic Pain.
Discover an app designed specifically for people living with hypermobility, EDS, HSD and ch
bluejetty:00041440:ios.description:
The Zebra Club - Movement, Education and Community for Hypermobility, Ehlers-Danlos Syndromes, Hypermobility Spectrum Disorders, and Chronic Pain.
Discover an app designed specifically for people living with hypermobility, EDS, HSD and chronic pain, plus the related conditions like chronic fatigue and POTs. 
The Zebra Club is not just an exercise app. It is a movement and wellbeing community app designed by hypermobility specialist and movement therapist, author and educator, Jeannie Di Bon, who has over 20 years experience supporting people with hypermobility and complex conditions. 
Built on Jeannie’s Integral Movement Method (IMM), The Zebra Club gives you a science-backed (Russek et al 2025), gentle yet powerful approach to improving stability, reducing pain, calming the nervous system and reclaiming confidence in your body. A research paper was published into the effectiveness of the IMM in 2025, with a second paper in peer review (September 2025).
Why Choose The Zebra Club?
Living with hypermobility, EDS or HSD can make traditional exercise feel unsafe, overwhelming or even harmful. Most mainstream exercise platforms simply are not designed with a hypermobile body in mind. 
That’s why The Zebra Club exists. Jeannie lives with hEDS, POTS and chronic fatigue herself.
• Safe, accessible movement classes designed for joint instability, fatigue, POTs and pain.
• Expert led guidance from Jeannie. She truly understands the challenges of the community.
• A supportive community of zebras around the world who share your journey - so you will never feel alone.
• Trusted education backed by research and visiting experts in EDS and HSD.
The Zebra Club was created to fill the gap between exercise, physical therapy and everyday living. It gives you the tools, guidance and support to move safely, all at your own pace.
Key features to support you are:
• Ability to personalise your program 
• On demand class library 
• Educational Resources
• Guided programs
• Community and Support
• Live events and replays
• Accessibility first - classes for all levels
Who is The Zebra Club for?
• People living with EDS or HSD or suspected diagnoses
• People living with chronic pain, fatigue or instability
• People with POTs
• People recovering from injuries related to hypermobility
• Healthcare professionals who want to learn safe, effective movement practices to support their patients
If you make a one-time purchase or subscribe through Apple, payment is charged to your App Store account at purchase. All subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. You can manage your purchases on your member billing page.
The Zebra Club Terms of Service: https://www.thezebra.app/terms
The Zebra Club Privacy Policy: https://www.thezebra.app/privacy

bluejetty:00036543:ios.description:
ECOVACS HOME debuts! With awesome connected features, our latest App allows you to control your DEEBOT anytime, anywhere, and takes your cleaning experience to a new level.
By connecting to your DEEBOT, you can: 
• Start, pause, or stop cleaning
• Set a regular cleaning schedule
• Set voice report, suction power, and Do-Not-Disturb time*
• Receive notifications from your Wi-Fi enabled robot*
• Share DEEBOT with your friends through multiple accounts*
• Receive software and firmware updates*
• Access instruction manuals, video tutorials and FAQs, and contact customer service
And you can do much more with your advanced mapping DEEBOT (powered by Smart Navi™ Technology):
• Set up Virtual Boundary™ to create no-go zones*
• Use Custom Cleaning to customize any cleaning area you want*
• View real-time stats from the visual map of your home, areas cleaned, and cleaning time*
• Adjust water flow level when DEEBOT is mopping (Robots with mopping function only)*
*Features vary with models. Go to ecovacs.com to see detailed features of your model.
Plus, you can control your DEEBOT with simple commands through Amazon Alexa and Google Home**.
**Smart Home commands are available only in some countries/regions.
*** App permissions***
The application service requires the following permissions on your phone. For optional permissions, if they are not accessed, the related features will not be available, but it will not affect the basic using of the App.
[Required Permissions]
/
[Optional Permissions]
-Location: Used for device networking, discovering nearby devices, and obtaining WiFi information currently connected to the mobile device.
-Camera: Scan the QR code on the Robot for networking, and scan the sharing code for device sharing.
-Photos and Videos(Storage): Used for changing profile pictures, posting image comments, and online customer service providing feedback via images.
-Microphone: Audio and video call feature for customer service and Robot Video Manager.
-Bluetooth: Used for connecting devices via Bluetooth, enabling network configuration and robot controlling.
-Nearby Devices: Used for scanning and discovering nearby Bluetooth devices during network configuration.
-WLAN: Used for connecting to the Wi-Fi hotspot emitted by the device for network configuration.
-Notifications: Used for sending device and system notification messages to users.
-Local Network: Used to enable local network access on iOS devices, allowing connection to the Wi-Fi hotspot released by the device during network configuration.
-Music and audio: Audio and video call feature for customer service and Robot Video Manager.
Requirements:
Wi-Fi with 2.4 GHz or 2.4/5 GHz mixed band support only
Mobile device with Apple iOS 10.0 or later
Need help? Visit ecovacs.com for more information or to contact our customer service team.

 * Ability to add and save your favorite locations
 * A fully integrated GPS for current location awareness
 * Severe weather alerts from the National Weather Service
 * Opt-in push alerts to keep you safe in severe weather

bluejetty:00146971:ios.description:
Need a simple, all-in-one breastfeeding tracker and baby feeding tracker that grows with your newborn? ParentLove is here to help! Expert-designed by a mom of two and an IBCLC (International Board Certified Lactation Consultant), our baby tracking app covers everything: from breastfeeding sessions, bottle feeds, and pump logs to diaper changes, baby sleep tracking, and beyond.
WHY PARENTLOVE?
• REAL-TIME SYNC & UNLIMITED SHARING
Invite partners, grandparents, or nannies. Share feeding logs or diaper updates instantly so everyone knows when baby last ate or napped.
• ALL-IN-ONE NEWBORN TRACKER
Track every detail—breastfeeding, bottle feeding, baby food, pumping, growth, and milestones—all in one place.
• BABY SLEEP TRACKER
Log naps and overnights with ease, spot patterns, and discover how to optimize bedtime. Less guesswork, more restful nights!
• DIAPER & FEEDING LOGS
Record each wet or dirty diaper, plus breastfeeding lengths, bottle amounts, and more. Keep baby’s routine consistent and your mind at peace.
• PUMP LOG & MILK BANK
Track total ounces pumped and manage a dedicated breast milk inventory. Never lose track of how much is stored or about to expire.
• STATS & TRENDS
Glance at daily or weekly summaries for each activity. Identify your baby’s routine at a glance, or catch early signs of feeding or sleep issues.
• HEALTH & GROWTH MONITORING (Pro Upgrade)
Log doctor visits, vaccines, medication, or fever readings. Get custom pediatrician-ready reports and graph baby’s growth percentiles.
• DAY & NIGHT MODE
Switch to Night Mode during late-night feeds to reduce glare, or keep your eyes comfortable in Day Mode. Simple, soothing design at any hour.
• HIGHLY CUSTOMIZABLE
Build your own baby care activities—bath time, tummy time, reading—and track just what matters to your family.
• FRIENDLY REMINDERS & NOTIFICATIONS
Never worry about missing the next bottle or nap. Set reminders for feeding, medication, or any routine activities—like baby food introductions or pump logs.
HOW PARENTLOVE HELPS YOU
• Focus on baby instead of juggling multiple apps. ParentLove unifies your baby feeding log, pump log, sleep tracker, and diaper app all in one.
• Perfect for newborn to toddler stages: keep using ParentLove as a baby growth tracker, from first weigh-in to first steps!
• Sync with caregivers in seconds—no extra fees or complicated setups.
• Enjoy quick data entry, clean layouts, and powerful stats without the clutter or confusion.
FREE VS. PRO
• FREE: Breastfeeding tracker, baby feeding tracker, bottle, diaper, baby sleep tracker, pumping logs, and more. Unlimited sharing and basic stats included.
• PRO (One-Time Upgrade): Unlock advanced Health logs (vaccines, fevers, allergies), extended Growth Charts, Milk Bank for pumped breast milk, plus deeper Stats & Trends.
DESIGNED BY A BABY CARE SPECIALIST
ParentLove is created by a mother of two who’s also an IBCLC. We understand firsthand what new parents need—simple, intuitive tools to keep baby’s day on track without stress.
JOIN PARENTS WORLDWIDE
From first newborn days to adventurous toddlers, ParentLove is trusted by thousands to log feedings, diaper changes, and everything that supports baby’s well-being. Let us simplify your routine and bring peace of mind.
DOWNLOAD PARENTLOVE TODAY
• Stay organized, reduce worry, and celebrate every milestone.
• Finally, a baby tracking app that truly grows with you and your baby.
• It’s time to see how an expert-designed newborn tracker can transform your family’s day-to-day life!
ParentLove—One App, So Many Ways to Support You and Your Little One.

bluejetty:00163383:ios.developer: National Triple Zero Awareness Work Group
bluejetty:00163383:ios.summary:
Save the app that could save your life – Emergency Plus.
In an emergency, time and location accuracy are critical. By downloading the ‘Emergency +’ app, you’ll equip yourself with a powerful tool that will help you call Triple Zero (000)
bluejetty:00163383:ios.description:
Save the app that could save your life – Emergency Plus.
In an emergency, time and location accuracy are critical. By downloading the ‘Emergency +’ app, you’ll equip yourself with a powerful tool that will help you call Triple Zero (000) quickly, and allow you to accurately communicate your location to emergency call-takers.
‘Emergency +’ is a national app developed by Australia’s emergency services and their government industry partners, helping people to call the right number at the right time, anywhere in Australia. Emergency + also includes SES and Police Assistance Line numbers as options, so non-emergency calls are made to the most appropriate number.
When calling Triple Zero (000), remember to stay focused, stay relevant and stay on the line. Before you call ask yourself:
* Is someone seriously injured or in need of urgent medical help?
* Is your life or property being threatened?
* Have you just witnessed a serious accident or crime?
If you answered ‘Yes’ to any of these questions, call Triple Zero (000). Triple Zero (000) calls are free.
The app uses a mobile phone’s GPS functionality and what3words, so callers can provide emergency call-takers with their location information as determined by their smart phone.
With what3words available within the Emergency+ app, Triple Zero (000) callers can confirm their exact location quickly and accurately.
what3words has divided the world into 3m squares and given each one a unique three word identifier. Addressing using what3words works offline - ideal when you have no data coverage or are in a remote location.

bluejetty:00063090:ios.name: Things That Go! Vehicle Games
bluejetty:00063090:ios.summary: Vehicles are everywhere you look, and if you want to know about all the different cars, trucks, boats, and planes then it’s time for some vehicle fun with the Vehicle Games! Things That Go app! This educational and entertaining app was des
bluejetty:00063090:ios.description:
Vehicles are everywhere you look, and if you want to know about all the different cars, trucks, boats, and planes then it’s time for some vehicle fun with the Vehicle Games! Things That Go app! This educational and entertaining app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play. With over 40 vehicle flashcards including the sound the vehicle makes, and an ABC book with cool facts, this app will get everyone thrilled to learn about transportation! 
Easy Driving Games
Hop into a vehicle and have a blast driving and jumping! With 6 different vehicles including a race car, tractor, mail truck, construction truck, school bus and a car that drives in the night there is tons of fun for little drivers. And the best part is each vehicle is collecting different educational items as they drive which encourages learning through play! For example the race car collects numbers and when you collect all 50 the reward is counting along from 1 to 50, and the tractor collects shapes on the farm and when you collect them all you can tap and hear all the names of the shapes. And of course there is the alphabet also, when the dump truck drives he collects letters and when you collect them all you get to say the ABC's. It's an interactive and fun way to learn shapes, numbers, and the alphabet!
Vehicle Flashcards
If you love vehicles and transportation then delve into the vehicle sounds flashcards! With over 40 different interactive flashcards you’ll learn about cars, trucks, and all other modes of transport including a hot air balloon and a spaceship. And not only will you hear the name you will also hear the sound each vehicle makes, so it’s more enriching and fun! 
ABC Transportation Book
This entertaining and educational ABC book is sure to delight all vehicle lovers, and everyone that wants to know more about transportation! Each interactive page features a letter so you will hear the sound of the letter and the word it starts with. Studies have shown that this kind of associated letter recognition is the key to starting to read and essential for learning the ABC’s. The last page of the book features the entire alphabet to further enhance letter recognition, and it also has the traditional ABC song as well!
And along with learning the alphabet each of the 26 vehicles also have a fact that you tap to hear. These facts are very interesting and informative, and will keep you interested with each vehicle. It’s a fun and easy way to learn more about transportation and vehicles! 
Beep your horn and sound the sirens of fun when you delve into the Vehicle Games! Things That Go app, where learning through play encourages everyone to have fun driving and with flashcards while sharpening their knowledge about vehicles and transportation!

bluejetty:00151608:ios.description:

Explore a stunning collection of dreamlike images, from tranquil landscapes to magical scenes, and enjoy the pure satisfaction of putting each piece in its perfect place.
Each puzzle in Dreamscape Jigsaw Puzzle is carefully crafted to offer a smooth, satisfying experience. Choose from different difficulty levels to match your mood — whether you want a quick, soothing session or a longer, more challenging build.

Hundreds of beautiful HD puzzles inspired by dreamlike worlds.
Adjustable piece counts to suit both casual and expert players.
Calming background music to help you unwind and focus.

bluejetty:00099931:ios.description:
Solitaire Castle Royal is a relaxing, brain-training TriPeaks solitaire card game with a twist: every level you win helps you build and decorate your own royal kingdom. If you love classic solitaire, spider solitaire, or klondike card games and want something fresh, welcome home.
With 14,000+ unique solitaire levels — and new ones added every month — you'll never run out of card puzzles to solve. Play offline anywhere, anytime. No Wi-Fi needed, no time pressure.
YOUR ROYAL ADVENTURE
• Team up with Wags the dog and King Archie on an epic castle-building journey
• Restore and customize your castle, room by room
• Climb global leaderboards and compete with players worldwide
• Earn coins, boosters, and rewards with every level you conquer
• Sharpen your mind with clever card puzzles designed to train your brain
• Complete daily challenges, missions, and seasonal events for extra rewards
KEY FEATURES
• 14,000+ TriPeaks solitaire levels, with fresh levels every month
• Relaxing yet addictive card gameplay — easy to learn, satisfying to master
• Castle building & decoration: design your own royal kingdom
• Fully playable offline — perfect for travel, commutes, and cozy evenings
• Global leaderboards, daily missions, and live events
• Free to play
HOW TO PLAY
Clear the board by picking cards one higher or one lower than your open card. Chain long runs for bonus rewards, use boosters wisely, and spend your winnings making your castle the envy of the realm.
Whether you're a solitaire veteran or brand new to card games, Solitaire Castle Royal blends the timeless appeal of classic solitaire with the cozy satisfaction of building something beautiful.
Download free and begin your royal TriPeaks adventure today!

Reorder in one tap
Your complete order history is saved. Found a combination you love? Send the whole order again instantly.
Your account
Keep your details up to date, view your wallet balance, and see every order you've placed with us.
Rate your order
Tell us how it went with a quick rating and comment. We read all of it.
Dark Mode
The entire app adapts to light or dark, whichever you prefer.
Find us
Browse every Pizza Max outlet with addresses, opening hours and directions.

Order now.

bluejetty:00154085:ios.description:
Wood Out: Color Jam – Slide, Match & Solve Addictive Wooden Puzzles!
Get ready for a brain-teasing adventure! Slide, move, and clear wooden blocks to match colors, beat obstacles, and solve hundreds of tricky puzzles. Relax, train your brain, and enjoy satisfying wooden graphics with smooth animations.
Game Features:
Addictive Wooden Puzzles: Simple to play, tricky to master. Every level is a new challenge!
Exciting Obstacles: Arrow Blocks, Locked Blocks, Ice Blocks, Double Layers, and more!
Boosters & Power-Ups: Unlock clever tools to clear tough puzzles faster.
Beautiful Wooden Graphics: Relax with smooth animations and satisfying visuals.
Play Your Way: Perfect for relaxing or testing your strategy and logic.
How to Play:
Slide the Blocks – Move wooden blocks around to clear the board.
Match Colors – Send blocks to their matching doors to make them disappear.
Plan Ahead – Strategy is key! Think carefully to solve puzzles faster.
Beat Obstacles – Arrow Blocks, Locked Blocks, and Ice Blocks will test your skills!
Why You’ll Love It:
Boost Your Brain: Improve problem-solving and strategy skills with every move.
Endlessly Fun: Fresh puzzles and new obstacles keep the challenge going.
Satisfying Gameplay: Relaxing sounds, smooth animations & rewarding moves.
Slide, match, and solve! Download Wood Out: Color Jam now and start your ultimate puzzle adventure!

bluejetty:00175042:ios.description:
**Intercede: Deepen Your Catholic Prayer Life (formerly the Pray Catholic Novenas app)**
Intercede is a Catholic prayer app uniquely focused on novenas, which are multi-day prayers, some extending up to nine months. Created by a Catholic for Catholics, Intercede focuses exclusively on traditional Catholic devotions, distinguishing it from other apps that cater to a broader Christian audience.
Whether you're seeking healing, discernment, employment, or any special intention, Intercede offers novenas for every need. From the powerful Sacred Heart novena to St. Jude for impossible cases, find the perfect prayer companion.
**Key Features:**
- **Pray with Purpose** 
 Explore an extensive collection of novenas tailored for every intention—from healing to discernment—guiding you through structured prayer experiences.
- **Discover the Saints** 
 Gain inspiration from richly detailed biographies of saints whose intercessions you're seeking, deepening your spiritual connection and understanding.
- **Never Forget a Novena** 
 Stay committed to your spiritual goals with timely, gentle reminders that ensure you never miss a day of your novena prayers.
- **Pray Together** 
 Invite friends and family to join your novenas, fostering community and shared spiritual growth through collective prayer.
- **Track Your Intention** 
 Add and track your personal prayer intentions seamlessly, keeping them visible during daily prayers and enhancing your focus and devotion.
- **Your Prayer History** 
 Easily monitor your prayer progress and completed novenas, reflecting on your spiritual growth and celebrating your prayerful milestones.
**Why Catholics Love Intercede**
"Intercede has completely transformed my prayer habits—consistent, meaningful, and easy to keep up with." 
"This app is a blessing! The saint biographies have made my prayers come alive."
"Perfect for busy Catholics. The reminders keep me on track with my novenas."
Intercede Patrons support the Intercede app. When you become an Intercede Patron with a subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account when you confirm your purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off anytime by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. The current price for the Canonization Patron level is USD 29.99 per year. Depending on exchange rates, prices and currency may vary from country to country.
**Intercede's privacy policy & terms of use**
https://catholicnovenaapp.com/privacy/
https://catholicnovenaapp.com/tos/

bluejetty:00008523:android.summary: It’s amazing how pen and paper, two inventions dating back to thousands of years ago, have been almost irreplaceable. Until now. Inheriting the best inking feature from the popular Notes Plus app, now with its own automatic palm and wrist r
bluejetty:00008523:android.description:
It’s amazing how pen and paper, two inventions dating back to thousands of years ago, have been almost irreplaceable. Until now. Inheriting the best inking feature from the popular Notes Plus app, now with its own automatic palm and wrist rejection, INKredible will make writing on a tablet feel as good as, or even greater than, pen on paper. You have to try it to believe it. It’s incredible!
SIMPLE
INKredible has only ONE single mission: to create an outstanding writing experience on a tablet. It is meant to be distraction-free. In fact most of the time, you will not see any UI controls or buttons, just a blank sheet of paper to write on.
BEAUTIFUL
With more than 3 years of R&D in vector-graphics inking technology, we are confident INKredible - with a sophisticated manipulation of Bezier curves - will make your handwriting look more beautiful than on paper.
Even more specially, it will look good in any resolution, for printing or displaying purposes. Just zoom in and you will see why INKredible is unique among other handwriting apps.
… and, well, PERFECT!
OK, the INKredible writing experience on a tablet might not be perfect, but it is as close to perfection as you can find.
It is FREE. Try it today and see for yourself.

bluejetty:00145052:ios.description:
LED Banner with Scrolling Big Text and Neon Flashing Effects is a powerful Banner display app! You can create LED banners for any occasion, such as party, concert, sports game, or special event.
You can export your unique LED Banner to GIF or video format, save them easily, and set them as desktop or mobile wallpaper. You can also send your customized LED banner to your social friends.
Led Banner allows easily to change welcome sign (signboard) text, color, size, create blinking text sign. Led Banner turns your iPad or iPhone into welcome sign (text board / text banner / signboard) with big text or image . 
You can use Led Banner to display text typed in any language including emojis and symbols in full screen. 
Personalize your sign design with your own text, emojis, colors, fonts, images, and other graphic elements. There are many different kinds of signboards and outdoor signage that can Design For you, such as: Digital Signs, Outdoor signage,Informational signage, Persuasive signage, Compliant signage, Window signs, Pylon signs, Channel letters, Menu boards.
Key Features:
• Neon Flashing Effects
Easily create stunning flashing text with built-in special effects. Add multiple text elements and adjust their position (up, down, left, right) and scale. Customize fonts, colors, brightness and flashing animation speed to make your LED scroller stand out.
• Personalized LED Banner Design
Design beautiful LED banners and scrolling text with vibrant LED effects, including eye-catching neon flashing effects. Adjust font size, color and background to make your banner display APP shine.
• Unlimited Barrage Creativity
LED banner supports special characters and emojis, allowing you to use unlimited barrage creativity. Adjust the text scrolling speed to present your message in the most eye-catching way, and match it with dazzling flashing logo effects.
• Multi-Scene is Suitable
You can create LED banners for any occasion, such as party, concert, sports game, or special event. Cheer for your team in the game, or interact with your favorite anchor. Your message is no longer limited to simple text, now with dazzling neon effects.
• Highly Customizable
Choose font color, size and style from a variety of dynamic backgrounds and color schemes to enhance your LED banner with neon flickering effects. Control the direction and speed of text scrolling to add a unique style to your text banner.
• Save and Share Templates
Save your ideal LED flowing text and neon flickering text designs as templates for future use. Share your creative designs with friends and enjoy the fun of LED banners together.
Why Choose LED Banner - Big Text Display?
•Easy to Use: Design your LED scrolling text in just seconds.
•Highly Customizable: Fonts, colors, backgrounds—fully tailored to your needs.
•Dynamic Visual Effects: Flashing, scrolling, and emojis make your LED banner pop.
•Multi-Scenario Support: Perfect for concerts, events, and more.
•Shareable: Export as gif or video and share your creativity across social platforms.
We will strictly follow the privacy policy to ensure that your data is protected.
Note:
If you subscribe through Apple, payment will be charged to App Store Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Feedback:
If you like LED Banner - Big Text Display, please rate it 5 stars and give us a good review.If you have any suggestions or questions about using it, please send an email to info@chenduoduotech.com.

bluejetty:00017413:ios.description:
The WBEZ app lets you listen to the news and voices of Chicago on your schedule, wherever you are. Listen to live radio broadcasts, on-demand audio features and podcasts with the best storytelling locally and around the nation. You’ll enjoy original WBEZ Chicago programming and shows from our partners, including NPR, BBC and more.
Take your trusted news on the go. Listen to the news live wherever your day takes you. The WBEZ app delivers Chicago news, national news and international news right to your hand. 
You never have to miss a minute again. You can rewind at any moment and replay any live show from the last week to catch up on anything you missed. With the WBEZ app, continue to get investigative journalism, cultural reporting, news headlines and more on your timeline.
Discover something new. Browse through the best audio stories and shows WBEZ Chicago has to offer. Each day, featured stories are curated just for you from our newsroom. Plus, you can find popular podcasts from WBEZ, NPR and other featured partners; including titles such as Curious City, Nerdette, Motive and Wait Wait...Don’t Tell Me! There’s something for everyone with the WBEZ app.
WBEZ Chicago is listener-supported and Chicago’s NPR news station, one of the largest and most respected public media stations in the country.

bluejetty:00001876:android.description:
The SOS Recharge App is the most convenient and efficient way for you to get advance credits on your Claro Prepaid plan:
Available Services:
Credit Advance: Provides credit amounts of up to R$20.00. You choose the amount, and it goes directly to your balance so you can renew your Prepaid plan.
Balance and Outstanding Credit Management: Allows you to check your current balance and any SOS credits that are pending payment.
Extra Packages: Enables the purchase of additional internet packages.
History: Offers access to the transaction history of contracted and paid SOS credits.
Optimized Experience: The SOS Recharge App provides a simple, fast, and direct usage process. You select the desired amount, and the credit is immediately available for use in your balance.
Simplified Access: The SOS Recharge App does not require a login or password. To identify your Claro number that will receive the credits, simply leave the "Mobile Data" option enabled on your Android device in "Settings --> Connections," using your Claro SIM card.
Free Browsing: Using the App does not consume your internet balance. Access and browsing are free, and it's possible to use it even when your data balance is zero.
SOS Recharge is the Claro Prepaid recharge credit advance service. When you subscribe to the service, the advanced amount is immediately credited to your balance to renew your Prepaid plan or purchase Internet Packages.
Credit amounts are determined based on a continuous and individual analysis, which takes into account your recharge history and SOS credit subscriptions and payments.
For each recharge advance amount, a service fee will be applied to the credit amount granted.
The payment of the advanced amount, plus the service fee, will be automatically deducted from the customer's next recharge. The SOS Recharge plan must be paid off in full before you can sign up for a new one.

bluejetty:00168084:ios.description:
Discover the amazing power of yoga to get leaner, sexier, and younger looks.
Facial Yoga exercises are the simple and short exercises of face and neck based on the time tested yogic science that tone up your facial muscles and improve blood circulation to achieve incredibly youthful and radiant looks without any need for cosmetics or surgical treatment.
Facial Yoga has each exercise illustrated with a high quality animated video, audio, and textual description of ‘How to do?’.
While performing the exercises you can also choose any background music of your choice to create a blissful ambiance.
A common Facial Yoga program is recommended for men and women of all age groups.
Note: Facial Yoga should be avoided by kids because of the ongoing development of their facial structure.
*** Special Features:
* Supported Languages
English, français, Deutsche, Italiano, 日本の, 한국어, português, русский, Español, 中国
* FACIAL YOGA for YOU: Suggested facial workouts specifically for your face.
Select the type of desired facial enhancements that you need and perform the suggested yoga exercises.
* VIDEO SELFIE: Perform, record, review, and master each of the facial yoga moves along with the in-built yoga trainer.
* YOGA REMEDIES: Facial Yoga program tailored for common problems of face such as wrinkles, double chin, sagging face and skin, smoke lines, frown lines, eye puffiness, nasolabial folds, crow’s feet, chubby cheeks, lax lips, fatty face etc. Each program includes yoga poses and exercises suggested by experienced yoga instructors and professionals.
* PRACTICE SESSION: All of the yoga poses and exercises are detailed with HD videos, audio, and textual "How to do?" instructions and information on the benefits and precautions.
* MY ROUTINE: Design your own daily facial yoga routine.
* Reminder for your daily routine.
* SHARE EXPERIENCE: Connect with Facial Yoga buddies and share your knowledge and experiences.
* Gift App to your friend / family: Purchase application for your friend or family via in-app purchase and get coupon code for your friend to unlock application.
*** Key features
* More than 60 scientifically designed exercises to tone up your face and neck muscles.
* For easy learning, the exercises are grouped by the part of the face and by the problems of the face:
> Anti-Aging: Suppress the wrinkles and enhance the glow of the face
> Fat Face: Eliminate fat deposited on the cheeks and the chin area to get lean looks
> Face-lift and face toning: Tone up facial muscles and obtain youthful radiant skin
> Forehead wrinkles: Tone up the skin and muscles of the forehead
> Eyes: Tone up the muscles around the eyes to remove puffy eyes and bags under the eyes
> Chubby Cheeks: Trim cheek muscles to get lean facial expressions
> Sexier Lips: Achieve well-toned and youthful lips
> Mouth and Tongue: Tone up the muscles around your mouth
> Double Chin: Suppress double chin by burning the unwanted fat
> Jaws Line: Enhance your jaw line to get an attractive face
Facial Yoga offers an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account on confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You may manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of free trail period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

bluejetty:00068854:ios.name: Learn Japanese - HeyJapan
bluejetty:00068854:ios.summary: HeyJapan helps you learn Japanese starting from what you already love: anime, Japanese culture, travel, or simply the wish to speak Japanese. With a beginner-friendly method and just 15 minutes a day, Japanese learning feels natural from da
bluejetty:00068854:ios.description:
HeyJapan helps you learn Japanese starting from what you already love: anime, Japanese culture, travel, or simply the wish to speak Japanese. With a beginner-friendly method and just 15 minutes a day, Japanese learning feels natural from day one - you speak more as you learn
- Over 10,000,000 learners worldwide
- 4.8 stars from more than 50,000 reviews
- An easy, effective way to start your Japanese learning
Why learners choose HeyJapan?
For beginners, Japanese often comes with a few familiar hurdles: an unfamiliar alphabet, shaky pronunciation, overwhelming kanji, and the feeling of learning Japanese for months without ever really speaking. HeyJapan understands this and builds every feature to remove those roadblocks - so you don't just memorize, you truly learn Japanese and speak it
Key features
- In-depth Hiragana & Katakana - Master the full alphabet with spaced repetition, native audio, and demonstration videos
- Learn to speak Japanese through anime dubbing - Dub your favorite characters and get instant scoring and pronunciation feedback, so your progress is easy to see
- 1,500+ topic-based vocabulary words - Each word comes with example sentences, images, and audio; a smart review system helps you remember longer.
- Build lessons around what you love - Anime, travel, food… or any topic of your own, complete with vocabulary, sample sentences, and relevant conversations
- Stroke-order writing practice - Write each character in the correct stroke order to remember its shape and write more beautifully
- Systematic Kanji & grammar - Learn kanji by meaning and reading; grammar is split into small lessons with short, clear explanations
With HeyJapan, you can
- Say your first Japanese sentences in your very first week
- Handle basic conversations with confidence on a trip to Japan
- Watch your favorite anime without subtitles
- Understand Japanese culture more deeply with every lesson
We're always here to help and to listen. HeyJapan works hard to deliver quality Japanese lessons, but bugs are sometimes unavoidable - we'd love your feedback to keep making the app better. Reach us anytime at heyjapan@eupgroup.net.
Terms and Policies, please read at: https://eupgroup.net/apps/heyjapan/terms.html

bluejetty:00089715:ios.description:
AWorld is more than just an app—it’s a space where every action counts toward saving the Planet.
Join the AWorld Community: the app for anyone who wants to live sustainably, take action against climate change, and improve their lifestyle.
Track and improve your lifestyle
Measure and reduce your impact with AWorld’s Carbon Footprint tool. We provide practical tips to help you adopt a greener, more sustainable way of living.
Earn rewards for sustainable mobility
Choose eco-friendly ways to get around: walk, bike, or use public transport. AWorld rewards your low-impact choices.
Learn and act for a better future
Explore Stories and Quizzes that make sustainability fun, accessible, and simple. Get inspired by Actions that help you build a brighter tomorrow.
A global Community of changemakers
Join a worldwide Community of people who share your commitment to the climate and the environment. Challenge friends and colleagues, earn points, climb leaderboards, and share your progress. Together, we can make a difference!
Challenges, rewards, and sustainability
AWorld celebrates your dedication to saving the Planet. Take on Missions, collect gems, and unlock sustainable rewards in the Marketplace.
Why choose AWorld?
It’s intuitive, easy, and tailored just for you!
Trusted by:
- Awarded “Best App for Good” by Google (2023)
- Official app of the United Nations for the ACT NOW Campaign
- Partner of the European Commission’s European Climate Pact
Download AWorld and join our Mission to save the Planet. Change is in our hands!

bluejetty:00144512:ios.description:
Vagas de emprego - Vagas.com
Busque e se candidate às melhores vagas com o aplicativo de emprego da Vagas.com.
No nosso app de emprego, são divulgadas mensalmente mais de 10.000 vagas pelas melhores empresas de todo país. E não se preocupe, seus dados contam com um ambiente totalmente seguro =)
Não cobramos por serviços adicionais e não há conta Premium, nada disso. Você pode se candidatar a centenas de oportunidades!
Vagas em diversas áreas e níveis de atuação
Com nosso app de vagas de emprego, você se candidata a vagas em diversas áreas e níveis de atuação. Você também encontra programas de estágio e trainee das melhores empresas, além de vagas exclusivas para PCD.
Acesse funcionalidades exclusivas do aplicativo de emprego Vagas.com:
• Busca de vagas
Mais de 2.000 empresas de todo Brasil divulgam oportunidades de emprego em nossa plataforma. Busque pelo cargo ou área de interesse.
• Buscas recentes
Ganhe tempo utilizando as últimas buscas salvas.
• Alerta de vagas
Ative o alerta de vagas de acordo com sua busca e receba por e-mail novas oportunidades de emprego assim que forem abertas.
• Filtros de busca
Filtre vagas de acordo com o que você procura. Utilize os filtros de região, benefícios (como home office ou assistência médica), nível, área, programas de estágio e trainee e vagas para PCD.
• Match do dia 
A cada dia, veja oportunidades recomendadas para o seu perfil!
• Dica do dia
Todo dia um conteúdo diferente para impulsionar seu crescimento profissional. Acompanhe as dicas e tendências do mercado de trabalho.
• Chat VAGAS
Caso alguma empresa se interesse pelo seu perfil, ela poderá entrar em contato com você diretamente pelo Chat do aplicativo de emprego.
• Histórico
Acompanhe seu histórico de candidaturas e o andamento dos processos seletivos diretamente no nosso app de vagas de emprego.
• Edição de perfil
Mantenha seu currículo atualizado e aumente suas chances de conseguir emprego. Com o aplicativo Vagas.com.br, você insere novas informações no perfil a qualquer momento.
Baixe o app de emprego da Vagas.com e aproxime-se da sua próxima conquista profissional.

bluejetty:00177254:ios.description:
Wheel With Me Adapt Fit is the Fitness App for wheelchair users created by Jesi Stracham & Nikki Walsh.
Jesi & Nikki were tired of having to piece together workouts from nondisabled trainers, and came together to create a better fitness resource for seated workouts!
This app provides customized programs and workouts to help you push past your limits to achieve independence as a wheelchair user.
Wheel With Me Adapt Fit was designed to be convenient and easy to use. We focus solely on the fitness experience, so you have confidence when you work out. We are excited to work together on improving and evolving our app with our Wheel With Me Adapt Fit Community.
The app was built by wheelchair users for wheelchair users.
The Wheel With Me Adapt Fit App features
-Strength Programs
-Functional Mobility
-Bands
-Floor workouts
-Cardio
-Strength
-Daily Inspiration
-Private Facebook Group
-Community
-& so much more!
Improve your fitness and support your independence from anywhere with the Wheel With Me Fit App!

Terms & Conditions: https://app.breakthroughapps.io/terms_and_conditions.html

bluejetty:00024651:ios.name: EVO: Crazy Beasts 3D
bluejetty:00024651:ios.summary:
Join the epic battle between giant monsters! Choose your beast and destroy the city as quickly as possible. Evolve and show who is the boss in the city!
Destroy the city and evolve
The gameplay of Evo Crazy Beasts 3D is straightforward -
bluejetty:00024651:ios.description:
Join the epic battle between giant monsters! Choose your beast and destroy the city as quickly as possible. Evolve and show who is the boss in the city!
Destroy the city and evolve
The gameplay of Evo Crazy Beasts 3D is straightforward - choose your monster and cause maximum damage in the time allotted for the round. For each destroyed object, you get experience. When your monster levels up, it evolves, getting bigger, and its appearance changes. Turn the little animal into a huge dragon bigger than skyscrapers! But keep in mind that it won’t be easy at all, you are surrounded by opponents who are eager to throw you off the top of the leaderboard and take all your earned experience. Fight and crush them before they have time to understand anything. Smash the city in the allotted time and rise to the top of evolution!
Fight in different modes
Evo Crazy Beasts 3D has 2 main game modes - “classic” and “destruction”. In classic mode you have to fight against other monsters, evolve your beast and climb to the top of the leaderboard. Will you be able to defeat all opponents and remain the only survivor on the map? But remember, it won't be simple. Giant opponents can be dangerous, so try to avoid them until you are the same size as them. And when you evolve into the biggest monster on the map - charge into battle and dominate!
In the ""destruction"" mode, your goal is to destroy the city in a limited amount of time. Destroy buildings, uproot trees, trample cars - in general, do everything in your power to cause maximum destruction as quickly as possible. Here, as in the classics, evolution will help you. Grow a monster so big that he can't fit into the screen. Become strong, destroy buildings and prove that your beast is the biggest and scariest!
Unlock new monsters
Play, complete the progress and unlock new beasts to fight and destroy even more effectively. There are many different monsters in the game, so you can definitely find the companion you looking for. Do you want to play as a cute electric cat? Or maybe a werewolf or a dragon? Unlock new characters, follow their evolution and smash the city with a style!
Level up to deal as much damage as possible 
After each round, you get a currency that you can use to improve your monster. Do you want your beast to be the fastest? Then pump up the speed. Or maybe you want your monster to deal more damage? Then power is your choice. What if you don't want to choose? Then take the income bonus and buy all the upgrades at once! Use your logic and come up with a strategy for the best way to spend the money you earn. Pump up the monster and break into the battle, smash the opponents and destroy the city!
Game features:
- Grow your beasts and uncover new forms for them
- Unlock new monsters by being the biggest monster in town
- Destroy the surroundings and clear the whole area
- Avoid clashing into someone bigger than you
- Set your high score in two different game modes
- Smash your opponents and grow bigger every time!
- Addictive gameplay and easy controls
- Simple and user-friendly UI
- Good-looking minimalistic graphics
- It is just a game, so don’t forget to have fun!
Get ready for destruction and battle in the city against giant monsters. Upgrade and evolve to set new records. Unlock new animals and play as a real dragon. Play the best evolution game for free! Download and fight!

bluejetty:00183116:ios.description:
The Imperial Court is on the brink of collapse. Selfish officials have forgotten their oath and plunder what they can. Fight corruption and see if you have what it takes to make the right decisions as you judge the destiny of those accused of crime. 
Start your journey as a freshly appointed magistrate. Determined to bring prosperity back to the people.
You will not be alone in your quest to restore order to the empire. New friends are eager to join your cause and lend you their services. Expand your coffers and raise your troops to defeat familiar foes and unexpected adversaries. 
FEATURES:
Recruit & Upgrade Retainers
No one man can do it alone. Recruit retainers with unique abilities to help you on your journey. Great generals, fearless warriors, and brilliant advisers are ready to join your cause. Upgrade them to help you overcome the many enemies and challenges.
Cherish Confidants
As you prestige, you will attract many beautiful ladies; perhaps even those of other lands. Cherish them for what they offer is more than meets the eye.
Fortify Alliances
Join an alliance or build your own, the choice is yours. Unite with your friends to take on others in the battle for supremacy. Work together to unlock Alliance-only perks such as unique buildings, boss fights and more...
Raise Offspring
Raise your children and nourish their talents. Establish your dynasty by arranging marriages with other players.
Establish Trade
Trade with the other ancient kingdoms of the Orient and make a fortune. Beware! The oceans are treacherous and others are looking to do the same.
Study in Academy
Brush up on your study of the arts. Your dedication to poetry and the arts may earn you the honorary yellow jacket.
Much more~~
This is your destiny. Be the King and may your wisdom bring prosperity to the Empire.
Join our Be The King community and learn more about the game:

With The First State Bank’s (Columbus, Texas) Mobile App, you can access your accounts anytime, anywhere from your mobile device. You must use your Retail Online Banking/Business Online Banking username and password to access your account information. If you do not have a username and password, please enroll in Retail Online Banking/Business Online Banking at https://fsbcolumbus.com. 
The First State Bank’s Mobile App is FREE and allows you to: 
• View your account balance
• View account activity and deposit history
• Transfer money between accounts
• Send money to friends and family with Pop Money
• Deposit checks by snapping a picture of each check
• Bill Pay
• Cash Management
• Receive alert messages about your account*
• Contact our Customer Service Dept.
Security is our top priority! Rest assured that your personal information is kept safe and secure.
If you have any questions about The First State Bank’s Mobile App, please contact us at (979) 732-2332; or stop by 420 Walnut St., Columbus, TX and we would be glad to help you.
*Carrier’s data rates may apply.

bluejetty:00023557:ios.name: Visited: Travel Tracker & Map
bluejetty:00023557:ios.summary:
Beat your own travel stats. Get inspired to visit exotic new destinations. With Visited you will finally be able to tick off all those locations on your bucket list as you track your your experiences around the world.
MAP YOUR TRAVELS
Des
bluejetty:00023557:ios.description:
Beat your own travel stats. Get inspired to visit exotic new destinations. With Visited you will finally be able to tick off all those locations on your bucket list as you track your your experiences around the world.
MAP YOUR TRAVELS
Design your personal travel map consisting of countries, states, regions and cities of where you have been, lived or want to visit. You can also delve deeper by creating regional maps for over 20 countries, including United States, Canada, Australia, Germany, UK, Russia, France amongst others.
ULTIMATE TRAVEL LIST
You can keep track of all the myriad of places you want to go and experiences you wish to have with our extensive travel lists. Visited provides over 150 different categories that will be sure to fit your lifestyle, ranging to food destinations to heritage sites and beyond! You can then see all your selections on a unique travel map and share it with your friends as you plan your next adventure. 
TRAVEL ITINERARY
Are you wondering where to travel next? We got you covered. Select different cities, destinations and places based on travel lists, experiences and inspirational photos. We'll show you which countries have the highest numbers of places you wish to visit. You can also add dates, hotels and travel notes for the optimal travel plan.
TRAVEL GOALS
Keep up with your travel goals by selecting all the countries of the world that you want to visit. Your personalized travel dashboard will show you what percentage of the world you visited and what is still left. You can see what type of traveler you are and how you compare to other international travelers. 
GET INSPIRED
Have you ever struggled with where to travel to next? Now you get get inspired for your future travels by swiping through beautiful photos and adding them to your bucket list. The world is full of beautiful and surprising locations. Discover new places and experiences that may lead you down the road less traveled. 
TRAVEL EXPERIENCES
Track your experiences by country such as where you’ve gone golfing, snorkelling/diving, skiing, wine tours and others.
GET YOUR OWN TRAVEL POSTER
Do you want your own scratch map printed so you can display it as a poster on your wall? You can now have your travel map professionally printed onto a high quality and glossy poster then shipped directly to you, wherever you might find yourself. 
KEEP TRACK OF YOUR TRAVEL JOURNEY
Add travel journal notes by country of your travel dates, points of interest or personal memories. 
FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE
You can adjust your travel map to choose different colors or design your own based on your travel type. Pick from fully accessible, high contrast colors for your map. Dark mode is supported to make the app easier to use while taking a red eye flight. Adjust the sovereignty for disputed territories. Map aficionados can even choose between Mercator or Equirectangular map projections.
EXAMPLE OF TRAVEL LISTS: 
Lists include: African Safaris, Capitals of the World, Wonders of the World, Pyramids, Culinary Experiences, Ancient Sites, Churches, Greek & Roman Ruins, Cruise Ports, Beer Destinations, Palaces, US national parks, Ski Slops, World's Top Beaches, Shopping Destinations, LGBTQ+ Destinations, Popular Hiking Trails, Lakes, Bridges, Snorkelling/Diving Locations, Chocolate Destinations, Castles, Wine Regions, Kids Attractions, Temples, Mountain Ranges, Rock Climbing Locations, Monasteries, Opera Houses, Funicular Railways, Waterfalls, Volcanos, Mosques, US National Monuments, Hot Springs, Tunnels, US Memorial, Dance Shows, Deserts, Famous Prisons, Canal Cruises, Formula One Circuits, Top Surf Spots, Underground Cities, Whale Watching Spots, Synagogues, Caves, US National Historic Site, Tennis Destinations, Film Festivals, US National Battlefields and Scotch Distillery Regions. 
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00089191:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00089191:ios.description:
Vimcal is the ultimate calendar designed for busy professionals and their teams.
We invested two years into understanding the pain points of our first 10,000 users through 1:1 Zoom calls. This allowed us to map out all the different scenarios of corporate scheduling. 
The result? The world's fastest and most intuitive calendar app, built to streamline scheduling and boost your productivity at work, as well as the most robust harness for agentic scheduling. 
In Vimcal, you can accomplish anything you would in another calendar, but in half the steps or fewer and with no error.
AGENTIC SCHEDULING
Scheduling with voice, screenshots, or your AI personal assistant. 
Vimcal holds proprietary context about your meetings such as whether it's internal vs external, how important it is, or how many times it's already been rescheduled. Vimcal provides you the sturdiest guardrails for your time. 
BUILT FOR TEAMS
Scheduling with your team is so much more complicated than just seeing what's open or blocked on the calendar. When your entire team uses Vimcal, all of Vimcal's context allows for the most accurate scheduling that aligns with everyone's schedules.
NO MORE TIME ZONE PROBLEMS
Time Travel — Find the best time between you and any other time zone in the world without any mental math.
SCHEDULE WITH A PERSONAL TOUCH
Slots — Sending a booking link feels transactional, but typing out your free times instead is tedious. Get the best of both worlds with our drag-and-copy availability feature!
DECLUTTER BEAUTIFULLY
Rainbow Events — No one likes seeing a full calendar. Let Vimcal take care of unnecessary meetings and declutter your mind.
BUTTERY SMOOTH EVERYTHING
100ms Rule — We obsessively test every tap and interaction to give you the silkiest, fastest mobile experience.
Upgrade your productivity and take control of your schedule with Vimcal. Download now and revolutionize the way you manage your time.

bluejetty:00041675:ios.description:
Este é o aplicativo da versão digital do Jornal A TARDE para os assinantes.
Agora é possível compartilhar o que lê, com conteúdo multimídia e matérias
acompanhadas de vídeo e áudio. Todos os fatos sobre a Bahia o Brasil e
o mundo, diariamente, ao alcance das mãos.
Quem não é assinante poderá adquirir as edições avulsas.
Fundado em 15 de outubro de 1912, o Jornal A TARDE, é o principal veículo
do Grupo A TARDE - Sistema Integrado de Comunicação -, foi um dos primeiros
jornais a circular na Bahia, acompanhou acontecimentos dos séculos XX e XXI
e até hoje mantém seu compromisso de informar o que é notícia. Apresenta,
diariamente, em seu conteúdo, informações e coberturas esportivas e culturais,
notícias sobre economia, política, educação e saúde. Além de cadernos, com
periodicidade semanal e mensal, sobre autos, concursos e negócios,
mercado imobiliário, sustentabilidade, Enem, pós-graduação e empreendedorismo.
A exemplo da revista MUITO que acompanha o jornal aos domingos e traz dicas
de moda, gastronomia e cultura.
Seja bem-vindo e boa leitura!

bluejetty:00122622:ios.description:
Enjoy one more way for your organization to quickly and conveniently access your company’s account information and approve payments through Comerica Treasury Mobile®. Our easy-to-use mobile app for businesses includes these abilities and features: 
- Your organization’s administrator manages which employees are given access to the mobile app through the Customer Administration Tool in Comerica Business Connect®
- View current-day information reporting
- Both summary and detailed information is available for your Comerica depository accounts and Controlled Disbursement accounts
- View prior-day information reporting
- See up to five business days of prior-day summary and detailed information reporting, including check images, for your Comerica depository accounts, Controlled Disbursement accounts, multi-bank accounts and Sweep accounts
- System administration notifications
- An administrator can assign access to users through the Customer Administration Tool
- Ability to configure which accounts and features each user has
- Access and account changes occur in real-time
- Access and payment approvals utilize a secure code via hardware or software token
- A software token is available within Treasury Mobile or separately
- Robust search criteria
- Search by transaction amount, transaction type, specific text or a BAI code
- Manage Automated Clearing House (ACH), Wires, Real-Time Payments
- View status, Approve, unapprove, delete or reject pending payments
- Deposit one or multiple checks at a time and view user check deposit history
- Create domestic wires using freeform or template entry
- Create international wire payments using template entry
To obtain a list of supported Apple mobile phone and tablet devices, please call Treasury Management Relationship Services at 800.852.3649.
Comerica Bank is a Member of FDIC. To access/login to this app, you must sign a Comerica Treasury Mobile® Service Agreement with Comerica and must be granted access by your company’s administrator.

bluejetty:00168829:ios.description:
We present to you the most beautiful fish tank in the world.
Fill your fish tank with a variety of tropical fish and design the aquarium with your own concept.
1. The fun of raising various fish
You can purchase eggs from over 180 types of fish and hatch and grow them yourself.
Over time, the fish get hungry and the tank gets dirty.
