Grow your fish to 100% and upgrade levels as you gain experience.
Each time you level up, fish tanks with more diverse concepts await you.

Do you feel like the time spent growing fish is boring?

bluejetty:00148578:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00148578:ios.description:
LET'S CHANGE THE WAY WE HEAR THE WORLD.
Soundworks provides access to unique and modern sounds designed by professional artists from the electronic music scene to deepen your daily meditation practice.
Rediscover your sense of hearing from a biological and cultural perspective, using simple techniques for working with sound as an object of mindfulness.
> Timeless techniques meet modern sound design.
Soundworks combines various meditative disciplines with the precision and clarity of modern electronic sound design. Building on a decade of experimentation in immersive media experience and psychoacoustic research, Soundworks offers a uniquely honed sound palette to enhance the quality of your daily meditations.
> Created by artists, grounded in neuroscience.
Soundworks offers sound meditations and listening sessions designed to enable clarity, insight and calm. Our artists, experienced meditators in their own right, take cues from the neuroscience of sound and aesthetic perception to create unique experiences in auditory mindfulness.
> Your space to cultivate inner and outer inquiry.
The Soundworks app includes a new daily sound every day as well as courses, extended sessions and conversations. Courses touch upon scientific, artistic or philosophical themes with a contemplative spirit. In conversations, we involve artists, scientists or thinkers to discuss meditation, science, music and health.
FEATURES
- Daily Sounds: a new sound meditation every day, with the ability to add time at the end of the sound to continue meditating in silence. 
- Apple Health integration: keep track of your mindfulness activity by connecting your Health app.
- Courses: from learning the mysteries of dreaming, to exploring time and space, or observing the nature of our perception and cognition, we offer a series of contemplative learning experiences using sound as a gateway towards insight.
- Extended Sessions: purely sonic adventures for longer and hypnotic meditation sessions.
- Conversations: talks or interviews with artists, scientists and thinkers about meditation, science, music and health.
- Timer: a meditation timer including a choice of intro and interval sounds.
ABOUT US
We are a small team of producers, designers, and technologists with a fierce belief that the quality of our attention underpins our very notion of reality and influences every aspect of how we think, feel and communicate.
Join the Soundworks community!

So chances are, dieting or counting calori
bluejetty:00036538:ios.description:
Did you know that only 2 in 10 people who diet or count calories manage to keep the weight off? And, at the same time, more than 3 in 10 people end up gaining more weight than before they started.
So chances are, dieting or counting calories will leave you worse off overall.
Eating Buddy offers a different approach
Your body is designed to regulate weight naturally. But highly processed foods, dieting, and chronic stress can override its signals to a point where eating feels out of control.
That’s where Eating Buddy steps in. It helps you return to a more natural, intuitive way of eating through awareness.
How it works
Log meals and body cues in seconds:
Quickly log meals, hunger, and fullness to build awareness.
Track what affects your eating:
Note mood, workouts, sleep, and drinks to see what influences how you eat.
Reflect and organize:
Use notes or tags to add context and categorize meals.
See Patterns over time:
Eating Buddy helps surface patterns so connections become easier to notice.
Choose challenges that fit you:
Based on your patterns, pick supportive challenges to focus on one small, meaningful change at a time.
If you are tired of starting over with dieting and want a calmer, more sustainable way to relate to food, download Eating Buddy now to get started.
--------------------------
We offer monthly and yearly subscription plans for our optional challenges system. Both plans include a one-week free trial.
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
For more information, see our terms of use at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula and our privacy policy at https://www.eatingbuddy.app/privacy-policy .

bluejetty:00134944:ios.name: Christmas Jigsaw Puzzles.
bluejetty:00134944:ios.summary: Discover the fun of Christmas Puzzle Games, a joyful and engaging jigsaw puzzle adventure that’s all about celebrating the holiday season. This game is perfect for anyone who loves Christmas and enjoys the classic style of jigsaw puzzles.
bluejetty:00134944:ios.description:
Discover the fun of Christmas Puzzle Games, a joyful and engaging jigsaw puzzle adventure that’s all about celebrating the holiday season. This game is perfect for anyone who loves Christmas and enjoys the classic style of jigsaw puzzles.
Game Highlights:
- Lots of Christmas Themes: Jump into a world full of Christmas trees, Santa Claus, shiny ornaments and beautiful winter scenes. Every puzzle is a new piece of the holiday magic.
- New Puzzles Every Day: Keep the excitement alive with new puzzles added daily and a special "Daily Puzzle" to look forward to each day.
- Earn Coins and Unlock New Puzzles: As you solve puzzles, you earn coins that let you unlock even more awesome and colorful pictures. The fun never stops!
- Christmas Tunes: Enjoy the holiday vibes with a selection of cheerful Christmas music playing as you piece together your puzzles.
- Pick Your Level: Whether you’re looking for an easy puzzle (36 pieces) or a real challenge (up to 400 pieces), we’ve got you covered.
- Great for Seniors: If you prefer larger puzzle pieces, we’ve got a setting for that, making it perfect for players of all ages.
- Save Your Progress: Jump back into your puzzle anytime with our handy save feature. You won’t lose a single piece.
- Bright and Beautiful Pictures: Get ready to be wowed by our collection of amazing, vibrant HD pictures, all with a Christmas theme.
- Simple and Fun: No need for complicated rules or setups—just pure, straightforward jigsaw puzzle joy.
- Feel the Christmas Spirit: It’s like having Christmas cheer right at your fingertips, all year long.
So, if you’re looking to add a sprinkle of Christmas joy and a bit of puzzle fun to your day, this is the perfect game for you! Get ready to dive into a world of colorful puzzles, Christmas tunes, and endless fun!

bluejetty:00120712:ios.name: Visual Anatomy Lite
bluejetty:00120712:ios.summary:
Interactive anatomy reference with muscle action movies, 3D rotational models, 1247 Gray's anatomy images add-on, Latin names, a muscle highlighting tool and full description!
• No.1 free anatomical app in UK Appstore!
• Visual Anatomy Li
bluejetty:00120712:ios.description:
Interactive anatomy reference with muscle action movies, 3D rotational models, 1247 Gray's anatomy images add-on, Latin names, a muscle highlighting tool and full description!
• No.1 free anatomical app in UK Appstore!
• Visual Anatomy Lite is recommended by top U.S.-licensed doctors on HealthTap (https://www.healthtap.com/#apps/375) 
• Support English, French, Spanish and German languages 
OVERVIEW:
Visual Anatomy Lite is an interactive reference, and education tool. The Lite version contains muscle action movies, 130 high-resolution images and more than 350 feature points which can be interactively selected. Each feature has its own label and short description. Add-on Images from all chapters of Gray's anatomy can be used as a quick reference. 6 chapters are bones, muscles and circulation system. In additional, a quiz with 23 multi-choice questions also is included.
USES:
This app’s primary use is as a learning tool but can also be used for any professional who needs the occasional reminder. Additionally, this app is ideal for physicians, educators or professionals, allowing them to visually show detailed areas to their patients or students - helping to educate or explain conditions, ailments and injuries. It can be also used as human anatomy guide or anatomy dictionary.
FEATURES:
• Muscle action movies
• Audio pronunciations.
• Latin names
• Rotational models (views from different angles)
• Muscle description (ORIGIN, INSERTION, NERVE, ACTIONS).
• Tap and Pinch Zoom - zoom into and identify any region, bone or other feature.
• Quiz mode - test yourself with an option to switch off the label of the feature point.
• Quick Navigation - jump to a different system or organ by selecting the thumbnail.
• Muscle highlighting tool to visualize the individual muscle.
• Great for learning anatomy and physiology
• High-resolution images.
• Free periodic updates.
CONTENTS:
Organ 3D, Muscular System (whole body anterior and posterior, facial muscles, leg muscles, arm muscles), Skeletal System (anterior, posterior and lateral views), Skull, Circulation System (Principle Veins and Arteries, Heart), Respiratory System, Digestive System, Urinary System, Nervous System, Female and Male Reproductive Systems, Ear Structure, Nasal Cavity, Eye,Body Region.
FEEDBACK
I am open to suggestions so don't hesitate send me an email if you have any feedback

bluejetty:00185269:ios.description:
■ L’INFORMATION EN DIRECT SOUS TOUTES SES FORMES :
• TV en direct : Regardez les actualités en direct sur LCI ou visionnez les journaux télévisés de TF1. Informez-vous sur l’actualité locale, nationale et internationale.
• Onglet “Toute l’info” : Découvrez les actualités en direct et ainsi ne manquez plus les événements en cours (la situation géopolitique en Europe et à l’international, l’inflation en France, la crise de l'énergie, les enjeux climatiques, etc.).
• Rubriques : Accédez aux actualités par thématique : Politique, Économie, Conso et tendances, Environnement / Écologie, International, Santé et bien être, Sujets de société, Sports, Famille et éducation, Police - Justice et faits divers, Sciences, Culture et divertissement, Météo et intempéries et Au cœur des régions.
• Retrouvez les documentaires exclusifs, les extraits et replay des éditions du journal de 13H et 20H de TF1 présentées par Marie-Sophie Lacarrau, Anne-Claire Coudray et Gilles Bouleau. Re-visionnez les émissions et magazines de l’information de TF1, dont 7 à 8 et Reportages.
• Regardez également en replay vos émissions LCI préférées : Le 6-9 avec Jean-Baptiste Boursier, 24H Pujadas, L'invité d'Adrien Gindre, Le 20H de Darius Rochebin, Un œil sur le monde avec Julien Arnaud et Amélie Carrouër, Le temps de l’info avec Elizabeth Martichoux, Brunet, Broussouloux et Cie, et bien d’autres émissions d’actualités.”
• Écoutez nos Podcasts : Le débat avec Arlette Chabot, En toute Franchise, L'Événement du dimanche l'invité d'Adrien Gindre, L’interview politique d’Elizabeth Martichoux, 24H Pujadas - Les partis pris, Perri Scope, Le 20H Darius Rochebin, Lenglet Déchiffre, Au cœur des régions, Impact Positif, Far West, Les gens qui lisent sont plus heureux, Expertes à la Une, Le cinéma c’est la vie en mieux. À écouter où vous voulez et quand vous le souhaitez. 
■ ACTUALITÉS SUR MESURE :
• L’actualité pour vous : Retrouvez les actualités qui vous intéressent et l’info près de chez vous dans votre espace dédié intitulé “POUR VOUS”. Une simple création de compte est nécessaire pour profiter de cette fonctionnalité.
• Votre JT personnalisé : Regardez votre JT (journal télévisé) personnalisé spécialement fabriqué pour vous en fonction de vos centres d’intérêts. Une simple création de compte est nécessaire pour en profiter.
■ UNE EXPÉRIENCE UTILISATEUR REPENSÉE, ÉPURÉE ET IMMERSIVE :

bluejetty:00090978:ios.description:
Studying for the New York State driver's permit knowledge test? This app puts the official driver's manual and hundreds of practice questions in one place — free, with no account to create.
PRACTICE UNTIL IT'S EASY
360 practice questions covering what the written test actually asks: road signs, right of way, speed limits, parking, sharing the road, and safe driving. They are split into short tests of 5 questions each — 42 tests in English and 30 in French — so a study session fits into a coffee break, and you see your score the moment you finish.
THE OFFICIAL MANUAL, BUILT IN
The New York State Driver's Manual ships inside the app and opens offline. No download step, no connection needed, no hunting for a PDF.
ENGLISH AND FRENCH
Choose the language your questions appear in — 210 questions in English, 150 in French. The app's interface follows your device language.
A STUDY ASSISTANT WHEN YOU'RE STUCK
Ask in plain language why an answer is right and get an explanation, so a wrong answer teaches you something instead of just costing you a point.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
The app remembers which questions you have answered correctly, so you always know how much ground you have covered.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• 360 practice questions (210 English, 150 French)
• 72 short practice tests of 5 questions each
• The official New York State Driver's Manual, bundled for offline reading
• Progress tracking that carries across sessions
• A study assistant for explanations
• Free to use
This app is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the New York State Department of Motor Vehicles. Check dmv.ny.gov for official requirements before your test.

bluejetty:00069695:ios.description:
Do you like themed word puzzle or crossword game? If you enjoy it, Word Free Time will give you a different experience and BIG surprise!
Word Free Time is a relaxing Word Game where you spell related words according a clue on a crossword-style board. With tons of levels available, you’ll enjoy the challenge of testing your vocabulary skills daily, while earning tons of coins!
FEATURES:
• Each puzzle has a CLUE. Use it to find the related words in each puzzle!
• 10,000+ levels with tons of words await you!
• Various level types, coin level, butterfly level, wooden block level.
• Special daily challenge offers free coins!
• Daily Bonuses! Get rewards for playing daily.
• Want to check previous levels? Go back to the Level List and play again!
• With no time limits, discover new words at your own pace!
• No internet connection needed! Play anytime, anywhere you want!
• Supported on both iPhone and iPad!
How to play:
• Each puzzle has a clue shown at the top. All words in the puzzle are related to this clue.
• Tap to change the selected cell.
• Choose the right letter to fill in the word.
• Tap the unlocked letter to correct the misspelled word.
• Use a hint to reveal a letter in a specific blank cell.
Want to challenge your brain and grow your vocabulary? Come and play the Word Free Time with your friends!
For more information, please refer to:
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1kMtKeXJbTm8HsgDh63OoVDrxLSM3eaKxLO28OX84R40/edit?usp=sharing

bluejetty:00081916:ios.description:
Hi Rasmus: The Modern Platform for Collaborative, Data-Driven Care
Hi Rasmus empowers clinicians, educators, and caregivers with smarter tools to deliver high-quality care, track outcomes, and stay connected—no matter the setting. Whether you're part of a large ABA organization, a small clinic, or a school district, Hi Rasmus scales with your needs while simplifying day-to-day workflows.
Built by BCBAs and used by thousands of professionals across globe, Hi Rasmus combines real-time data collection, AI-powered documentation, customizable templates, and outcomes reporting in one intuitive platform—so your team can spend more time focused on the learner in front of them.
◆ Key Features:
▪ AI That Works for You
From generating session notes and treatment plans to suggesting skill acquisition targets, our AI tools save time while preserving clinical integrity. Notes are auto-populated with session data and customizable voice-to-text input—so you can complete documentation before you even leave the room.
▪ Outcomes Reporting Made Easy
Aggregate and export learner progress across programs, providers, or sites with just a few clicks. Our reporting tools are built for leadership, funding conversations, and tracking organizational impact.
▪ Customizable Templates & Libraries
Maintain consistency across teams with reusable templates for behavior plans, programs, treatment plans, and reports. Share best practices across locations and tailor them to each learner.
▪ Collaboration-First Design
Invite unlimited team members to a learner’s profile—BCBAs, RBTs, teachers, school staff, and caregivers. Comment directly on sessions, reports, and plans. Participate in live sessions, leave video feedback, and make real-time updates.
▪ Instant Data Visualization
Track skill acquisition and behavior trends as they happen. View progress at a glance and receive notifications for mastered or regressing goals. Use graphs and dashboards to guide supervision and adjust programming as needed.
▪ Built to Scale and Flex
Hi Rasmus is designed for everyone from individual providers to multi-location enterprises. Launch new locations, onboard new teams, and support more learners—all without switching systems.
▪ Purpose-Built for ABA, Schools, and Beyond
 • Enterprise ABA Organizations: Ensure consistency, reduce documentation time, and expand access to care without sacrificing quality.
 • Small & Mid-Sized Clinics: Get up and running fast with an easy-to-use interface that supports flexible programming and streamlined workflows.
 • Schools & Districts: Support collaboration across educational and behavioral teams, align with IEP goals, and use offline mode for fieldwork.
▪ Secure, Reliable, and Compliant
Hi Rasmus meets industry standards for data privacy and security, including HIPAA compliance, and is designed with clinical integrity at its core.
Hi Rasmus isn’t just another data platform. It’s a partnership. We build alongside the clinicians and educators we serve—constantly improving based on your feedback. Join us in transforming care, one session at a time.

bluejetty:00092686:ios.description:
SPORTS OFFICIAL SCHEDULING AND PAYMENTS
Join thousands of assignors and officials who've eliminated scheduling chaos and streamlined their game management on the #1 FASTEST PLATFORM.
Stop juggling emails, phone calls, and spreadsheets. Notch puts your entire officiating workflow in your pocket from assignments to payments, so you can focus on what matters: the game.
WHY ASSIGNORS CHOOSE NOTCH
Assignors are reaching assignment fill rates as high as 99.7% when using Notch. 
They can assign club, league and tournament games in seconds, and not hours! 
Effortless Assignments:
- Post assignments in seconds and automatically notify available officials
- Our smart matching algorithm finds the right officials for the right games based on experience, location, age and availability 
- Automatic conflict detection prevents double-bookings if you enable officials to self-request games
Real-Time Availability Tracking:
- See which officials are available instantly
- The app flags potential assignment conflicts, helping you avoid double bookings
Efficient Communication:
- SMS and email messaging tools for efficient communication in one place, whether it's sending game-day reminders or addressing last-minute unassigned roles
- Reduce back-and-forth phone calls and emails by 80%
Payment and 1099s:
- Pay officials faster than any other platform and increase retention 
- Let us do the heavy lifting by managing all 1099s
Customized Reporting:
- Real-time analytics on pending outflows versus inflows ($)
- Generate reports on official performance, game coverage, financials, and more. Whether you need to provide feedback to officials or report on assignments to league administrators, Notch makes data management simple and intuitive! 
WHY OFFICIALS CHOOSE NOTCH
Never miss another assignment:
- Instant notifications for new assigned games, changes, and cancellations
- Calendar sync keeps your personal schedule updated automatically
- Real-time availability management means it's easy to update your availability anywhere, anytime
Get Paid Faster:
- Get notified when you receive a payment
- Smart balance tracks your earnings for every game in real-time
- Request instant payouts sent directly to your bank account in minutes, including weekends and holidays
- Schedule an auto payout 
Stay in Control:
- Accept or decline assignments with a single tap
- View all upcoming games in one organized dashboard
- Receive direct messaging from assignors for quick communication
BUILT FOR EVERY SPORT, EVERY LEVEL
From recreational youth leagues to elite competitions, Notch supports:
Soccer • Basketball • Football • Volleyball • Baseball • Softball • Hockey • And more!
Whether you’re working with recreational leagues or elite competitions, our app adapts to your needs.
TRUSTED BY THOUSANDS NATIONWIDE
Thousands of officials and assignors across the country rely on Notch to manage 100,000+ games annually. Join the community that's revolutionizing sports officiating.
Don't wait! Download Notch today and take control of your game assignments.

** Do you want to boost your media sound volume? This app allows you to increase the volume of your music, video, audio, audiobooks, and voice files. Boost the volume by up to 1000%!
** The Powerful Bass Booster amplifies your bass and offers brilliant sound quality! 
** The Media Converter converts your audio and video files to nearly any major video or audio format!

* Deep Bass Booster boosts bass by up to 200%. 
* Boost audio and video volume by up to 1000%.
* Boost the volume of all media, including audio and video files.
* Boost nearly any audio/video format: MP3, M4A, AAC, AIFF, mp4, MKV, MOV, AVI, etc.
* Lower or mute the sound of your audio/video file.
* Supports batch mode. 
* Convert nearly any video file to: 
MP4, MOV, GIF, OGG, WEBM, MKV (H.264), MKV (H.265), MPG, WMV, M2TS, AVI
* Convert nearly any audio file to: 
MP3, M4A, AAC, OGG, WAV, FLAC, WMA, AIFF, CAF, ADX, OPUS
* Stabilize shaky videos. 
* Add/Embed Music in your Video. 
* Add/Embed Subtitles in your Video. 
* Quick and Easy to Use. 
* Import audio/video files from Photos Library, Music Library, iCloud, or iTunes File Sharing. 
* Supported input formats include: 
MP4, MOV, GIF, OGG, WEBM, MKV (H.264), MKV (H.265), MPG, WMV, M2TS, AVI, MP3, M4A, AAC, OGG, WAV, FLAC, WMA, AIFF, CAF, ADX, OPUS, etc. 
* Export/Share your converted media files to other apps.
* AirDrop your converted files to other Apple devices. 
* Save your converted files to a local library or iCloud. 
* In-app File Browser: Search, Preview, Rename, and Delete your audio and video files. Sort by Name, Date, and Duration. 
* The built-in universal media player can play any audio or video format: 
MP4,AVI,MKV,RMVB,FLV,WMV,WAV,3GP,MOV,SWF,MPEG,MPG,VOB,M4V,RM,M2TS,ASF,WEBM,DAT,TS,ASX,MP3,F4V,OGV,DIVX,DV,GXF,M2P,MPEG1,MPEG2,MPEG4,MTS,MXF,OGM,QT,WM
How to Boost Volume or Convert to Other Formats: 
1. Tap the '+' button (at top left corner) to import your audio/video file. 
2. After you import the file, tap the file in the list view and select "Boost Volume". 
3. Choose the Volume Level and Output Format you want. 
4. For video conversion, you can also choose to stabilize your video, add music to your output video, or add subtitles to your output video. 
5. Finally, tap the "Boost Now" button to start the conversion. Once the conversion is complete, you can preview (playback) your boosted files or share them to another app or device easily.
Subscription: 
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. 
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan. 
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. 
Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

bluejetty:00022979:ios.description:
Featured on 50+ news and media channels including Newsweek, Parade, Trendhunter, CTV, City News, Global News, Curiocity, and many more
Trusted by 100,000 pet owners in 75+ countries worldwide
Pawmates is your friendly neighborhood pet social network! Designed to help pets and their owners find new friends, playmates, and trusted local pet services! Share your pet's most special moments on our News Feed, search for compatible playmates based on age, breed, size, and much more, or find the top rated vets, groomers, walkers, daycares, and much more on our special pet services map!
Pawmates is here to meet your every pet need and we're growing daily! We want to build the biggest community of dog lovers around the world. So come join our family today!
Key Features:
News Feed
Post your favorite moments with your pet on our news feed! Show off their unique personality, silly moments, and their cutest quirks! Like and comment on other people's posts, and enjoy a fun, drama free social environment!
Meet Playmates
Looking for like-minded pet parents in your area, or the perfect playmate for your pets? Unlimited free browsing of the cutest pets in your area! Our intelligent matching algorithm lets you match based on age, distance, size, and much more! Finding your perfect and most compatible playmates has never been so easy!
Unlimited Chats
Endless free chatting with your new friends where you can discuss anything pet related, and arrange playdates! Make friends with other people who love pets just as much as you do, and build your community the way you want! Group chats coming soon!
Pet Service Map
Looking for the top rated vets, pet stores, walkers, daycares, or parks? Hop on over to our Pawmates Pet Service Map and check out all the pet services near you! Check out what their rating is and find places you can trust with your fur babies! Check out their hours, website, location, and connect directly with them from our map! Add new locations you love and bring them some love from other Pawmates! More locations coming soon!
Your Custom Pet Profile
Show off what makes your pet special with our completely customizable profiles! Tell the story of how you met them, what they mean to you, and everything else that makes them special! Share what their favorite treats are, where they like to go, how they like to have fun, whatever you want! Your profile is one of a kind just like your pet is!
Pawmates is here not only to help you find your pet's favorite playmates, but to help with every other need that us pet owners have! Join us on our mission to connect pets and bring our community around the world!
Contact Us
Have questions, problems, or feedback? Feel free to contact us at info@pawmatesapp.com. We monitor our emails daily and take all feedback into account. Visit us on Instagram, Facebook, or Tiktok to keep up to date with us, see our favorite pet moments, and also win amazing prizes and giveaways!
Privacy Policy
Your privacy and safety is extremely important to us. We will never sell your information or put your privacy in jeopardy. Please read the terms and policies of Pawmates, as well as the privacy policy carefully. All data is handled under the terms and policies of Pawmates privacy policy. More details can be found here: https://pawmatesapp.com/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00187845:ios.description:
Dental Speed: tudo para o dentista, o estudante e o técnico em prótese em um só app.
Com o app da Dental Speed, você acessa mais de 30 mil produtos odontológicos com entrega rápida, condições exclusivas e vantagens para seu consultório, clínica, laboratório ou formação acadêmica.
Encontre materiais e equipamentos odontológicos, soluções para especialidades, descartáveis e instrumentos, tudo direto no seu celular.
A Dental Speed é referência nacional em odontologia e oferece soluções completas para dentistas, TPDs (Técnicos em Prótese Dentária), estudantes e instituições de ensino.
Universitários podem enviar a lista acadêmica diretamente pelo app, garantir brindes, kits completos e parcelamento facilitado.
Dentistas encontram produtos para clínicas e consultórios odontológicos com as melhores marcas, como resinas, anestésicos, brocas, adesivos, scanners, seladoras e EPIs, com preços especiais.
TPDs contam com uma seleção completa de materiais para laboratórios de prótese, como silicones, ceras, resinas, acrílicos e fornos odontológicos. 
O app oferece soluções para todas as especialidades: endodontia, ortodontia, estética, harmonização orofacial, implantodontia, radiologia, odontopediatria, periodontia, cirurgia, prótese clínica e laboratorial.
Busque facilmente produtos por categoria ou nome, compare preços, veja avaliações e compre com poucos cliques. Favoritos, histórico de pedidos, recompra rápida e emissão de boleto estão disponíveis direto no app.
Você encontra resina composta, resina odontológica, silicone de adição, clareador dental, lima endodôntica, anestésicos odontológicos, brocas diamantadas, braquetes, escovas, EPIs, ligadura elástica e tudo para o dia a dia clínico.
Abasteça seu estoque com descartáveis como luvas, máscaras, sugadores, kits cirúrgicos e microaplicadores, garantindo biossegurança completa.
Monte seu kit acadêmico ou equipe sua clínica com cadeira odontológica, autoclave, caneta de alta rotação, fotopolimerizador, scanner intraoral e soluções para odontologia digital.
Recursos exclusivos do app:
- Recompra rápida de produtos que você já adquiriu
- Envio de lista acadêmica com condições especiais
- Rastreamento de pedidos em tempo real
- Emissão de 2ª via de boletos
- Lista de favoritos personalizada
- Programa de Fidelidade Mais Speed com ofertas especiais
Conte também com:
- Blog com conteúdo educativo para atualização profissional
- Atendimento especializado com suporte técnico
- Ofertas relâmpago e condições comerciais exclusivas
Baixe o app da Dental Speed e descubra uma nova forma de comprar produtos odontológicos com praticidade, agilidade e economia.
Ative as notificações para receber ofertas, lançamentos e vantagens em primeira mão.

bluejetty:00073649:ios.description:
Total Adblock is the ultimate solution for eliminating unwanted ads and pop-ups while browsing on your iOS device. With our advanced technology, Total Adblock ensures a fast, smooth and uninterrupted browsing experience by blocking all types of ads, including banners, pop-ups, video ads, and more.
Not only does Total Adblock speed up your browsing experience, but it also helps to reduce data usage and prolong battery life. By eliminating ads and other unwanted content, you can browse faster and save on your data plan.
Total Adblock is easy to use and comes with ad blocking presets, so you can tailor ad blocking for speed, enhanced privacy or to block annoyances. Total Adblock also includes an Allow list, enabling you to add trusted websites and perhaps those you want to support by allowing ads to your exceptions list.
With Total Adblock, you can enjoy a cleaner, faster, and more private browsing experience on your iOS device. Download now and start browsing ad-free!
To utilize Total Adblock’s features a paid account is required.
The full list of Total Adblock features includes:
Safari Ad blocking
The endless scrolling past ads is over, Total Adblock removes banners, video ads and pop-ups by default. Websites can be added to an allow list to turn off ad blocking if required.
Web annoyance blocking
A custom filter to block frustrating web elements, not necessarily ads, but page elements that take up screen real estate.
Social media tracking blocking
A filter for blocking social media platforms tracking you around the web. It prevents big platform ‘like’ and ‘share’ buttons appearing on websites and pages.
Cookie warning blocking
Removes cookie and privacy warnings that interrupt ands slow down access to loading pages.
Dangerous website blocking
Outright blocks websites and webpages known to distribute malware, keeping you protected online.
Less Data usage
Ads consume a huge amount of data usage, by blocking them you don’t only speed up your web experience but also can cut data usage in half.
Increased battery life
Every page load full of ads consumes more memory, and therefore puts pressure on your battery. High quality video ads especially impact battery usage.
Sign up today and use Total Adblock to improve your Safari experience, it’s quick and easy!
Total Adblock is part of the TotalAV cybersecurity and protection suite. We help millions of users enjoy a cleaner and safer browsing experience the world over.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the same price. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
About Total Adblock Subscriptions:
Renewal of your annual Total Adblock subscription is automatic. You can cancel this automatic renewal at any time, at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period
Payment is charged to your App Store Account
Subscriptions are managed on iOS devices by tapping Settings > tap your name > Subscriptions. You will be able to see when your next payment is due, or cancel your automatic renewal.
Privacy policy: https://www.totaladblock.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://www.totaladblock.com/terms

bluejetty:00152185:ios.description:
Preview makes working with PDFs and images easier than ever, with built-in tools to create, edit, annotate, markup, and export.
Access & Scan PDFs
Easily find and access all the PDFs and images you have saved in the Files app right from Preview. Or use your camera to quickly scan multiple pages of a document and save it as a PDF.

Markup your PDFs with Apple Pencil on iPad, resize them, or rotate them. You can also use AutoFill to quickly fill out PDF forms with your contact information and details in an instant.

Create a new image with Apple Pencil on iPad or from images in your clipboard. You can also crop, flip, rotate, and resize images.
Export with Ease
Export images and PDFs as different file types like HEIC, JPEG, JPEG-2000, PDFs, PNGs, or TIFF. And adjust your exports with different options for resolution and size.

bluejetty:00071284:ios.description:
Learn to count the numbers with 123 Dots.
*** Learning games for all ages *** 
123 Dots entertains while they learn numbers from 1 to 50 with their inseparable friends: the Dots. 
The game includes more than 100 educational activities for your child to learn while having fun. 123 Dots also helps children develop important basic skills such as creativity, basic skills, attention span and memory.
In addition to teaching numbers and counting, your children can learn geometric shapes, letters, the alphabet and logical series. All in one!
This educational game is translated to 8 different languages: English, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, French and Swedish. Preschoolers can also learn colors, geometric shapes, numbers, animals, foods and vehicles in other languages!
* EDUCATIONAL OBJECTIVES
- Learn the numbers.
- Learn to count 123.
- Remember numerical order.
- Develop mathematical skills.
- Develop basic skills.
- Expand vocabulary with: animals, geometric shapes, colors, professions, objects, clothing, nature, etc. 
- Develop literacy.
- Learn the letters of the alphabet
* DETAILED DESCRIPTION
With spectacular results, the games help children learn how to count numbers, as well as improve their language acquisition skills by expanding their vocabulary. 
The menu interface is attractive and simple so that kids can play alone without the need of an adult. 
The fun Dots will lead the way and teach children by creating an exciting and diverse interactive experience that mixes gameplay with learning at all times. Kids will stay engaged as they interact with the Dots and make them jump and play. 
And, in order to unlock them, the child simply has to complete educational activities such as counting forward, counting backward, solving logical series and sorting the letters of the alphabet. 
- Privacy Policy: https://www.didactoons.com/privacypolicy/
* COMPANY: Didactoons Games SL
* CONTACT
We want to hear your opinion! Please contact us with any questions, technical problems, or suggestions you may have. Or, feel free to share anything else you like!

bluejetty:00031534:ios.description:
Welcome to "Is It Vegan? AI Scanner" - your ultimate companion for a cruelty-free lifestyle! Have you ever found yourself scrutinizing food labels or wondering if a certain product aligns with your vegan values? Our app is here to simplify your life. Simply snap a photo of the ingredients list or the food item itself, and let our AI-powered technology do the rest.
Key Features
Instant Vegan Status: Take a photo of any food item or ingredient list, and our AI will instantly tell you if it's vegan-friendly.
Comprehensive Database: Access a vast database of vegan and non-vegan ingredients, including those tricky additives.
How It Works
1. Photograph the Product: Capture the ingredients list or the actual food item.
2. AI Analysis: The app uses advanced AI algorithms to analyze the contents.
3. Instant Results: Receive immediate feedback on the vegan status of the item.
Why Choose "Is It Vegan? AI Scanner"?
Efficient & Easy: No more guesswork or time-consuming label reading.
Educational: Learn about hidden non-vegan ingredients.
Supports a Vegan Lifestyle: Essential tool for anyone committed to veganism or exploring plant-based living.
Environmentally Conscious: Promote sustainable and ethical choices.
Note: This app requires camera permissions for scanning functionalities. All data is processed with respect to user privacy and confidentiality

Private by Design

bluejetty:00094144:android.name: MOBIX
bluejetty:00094144:android.summary: MOBIX is transforming the way you charge and move sustainably: Say goodbye to range anxiety and hello to seamless parking and electric vehicle (EV) charging with MOBIX Park & Charge! With the new Park & Charge feature, you can easily find p
bluejetty:00094144:android.description:
MOBIX is transforming the way you charge and move sustainably: Say goodbye to range anxiety and hello to seamless parking and electric vehicle (EV) charging with MOBIX Park & Charge! With the new Park & Charge feature, you can easily find public charging stations as well as find, book, and pay for EV charging at private chargers made available by the MOBIX community! 
::: EFFORTLESS PARKING & EV CHARGING :::
- Locate nearby private parking spots and EV chargers, reserve in advance
- Flexible payment options: Pay securely with PayPal or send MOBX tokens 
- AI Agent-managed auto-rescheduling* automatically updates your Park & Charge reservation if delays are detected
- Add your private parking and/or EV charging spot: Manage availability, bookings, and payments in one place 
- Community-powered charging: Access underutilized parking & charging points and expand the EV infrastructure 
::: EARN REWARDS FOR SUSTAINABLE MOBILITY :::
MOBIX also incentivizes eco-friendly transportation. Earn MOBIX Miles every time you use an e-scooter, bike or e-bike instead of a car. Your MOBIX Miles can be redeemed, like for MOBX tokens on every Monday.
MOBIX is redefining urban mobility by combining seamless EV charging with sustainability incentives. Make your journey smarter, greener, and more rewarding!
*powered by fetch.ai 
::: FAQ :::
Q: What is MOBIX Park & Charge?
A: With MOBIX, drivers can find, book, and pay for private parking and EV charging spots. These spots are offered by other MOBIX users.
Q: How does a charging session work?
A: You'll be notified when someone books your charging point (make sure to allow push notifications for MOBIX!). To start, go to the Park & Charge location and start the session in the MOBIX app. Check out via the app when done.
Q: What does it cost to charge my EV with MOBIX?
A: The charging provider sets the price per hour for parking and charging. This will appear in the app before booking, and the total price is evaluated as time x price per hour.
Q: Are there any fees?
A: Yes, there are two fees: 1) A booking fee, payable through the app. 2) Providers receive payment minus the MOBIX platform fee (15%) and PayPal service fee (if applicable, 2.49% + 0.30 USD). Depending on the transaction method, the amount of the fees are either displayed in the MOBIX app wallet or in the PayPal account.
Q: Are there any legal regulations I need to consider when using MOBIX?
A: Depending on the country and region where you use MOBIX, local laws and regulations may apply—especially when providing private charging spots. Please check the relevant legal requirements in your area.

bluejetty:00080534:ios.name: Walkie Talkie: Talk to Friends
bluejetty:00080534:ios.summary:
The best Walkie Talkie app for you to chat with friends and feel connected at a distance, get emojis while chatting. 
Stay in touch with your friends or meet strangers during this special time. Don't have to leave the house or join the squ
bluejetty:00080534:ios.description:
The best Walkie Talkie app for you to chat with friends and feel connected at a distance, get emojis while chatting. 
Stay in touch with your friends or meet strangers during this special time. Don't have to leave the house or join the squad, just stay home and use this walkie talkie app and have a live chat with friends. It simulates real walkie talkie devices based on online services, featuring an online one-click PTT walkie talkie function. 
Highlights
- Widget for iOS 14 users. You can access channels directly by using this amazing widget feature.
- Push to talk: one-click to start talking
- Live group voice chat: chat with people on the same channel
- Customizable Walkie Talkie channel name: gather up for the same topic or the same interest
- Public channels for unlimited users: get to know more friends and inspired by new ideas
- Browse the channel lists: focus on what you like and pop in to have fun
- Emojis dropping while talking: find out the trigger words together
- Report, Mute & Block others
- Manage your following and followers list
- Text free: get closer with others purely through voices
- Smooth and clear: guarantee high-quality voice chat with almost zero latency
- Available 7*24: always here for you when you want to find someone to talk to
- Share your channels: invite friends to your channel from other social networks and chat apps such as Facebook, Twitter, Snapchat, Whatsapp, Messengers
Hidden Feature - "Emoji Showers"
It is activated when users say one of more than 200 commonly-used words. An emoji shower is activated, where many emojis float and fall from the top of the screen once the secret word is spoken. For example, when the word "hi" is spoken, smiley face emojis will fall from the top of the screen creating an "emoji shower". This can make chats more exciting.
*Meet one-of-a-kind strangers:
In this Walkie Talkie app, you can even talk to strangers. By simply entering numbers or words randomly, choose the Walkie Talkie channel and your chatlive starts. You may find friends who share the same thoughts with you at the moment. Isn't it amazing to have someone who is like-minded and you never met before? Walkie Talkie makes it all possible for you to make friends all over the world.
*Have a closer connection with people you met online: 
Want to keep in touch with new friends you met on Reddit, Facebook, Tumblr, Twitch, or Kakao, and to have a better understanding with each other? Invite them to use Walkie Talkie. 
Whether they're new friends you met on Kik or Houseparty, or teammates in mobile games and video games, or longtime friends on Facebook, Twitter, Snapchat, Whatsapp, Messengers, TikTok and other social media apps, just share Walkie Talkie with them, tell them your channel ID, invite them to use this Walkie Talkie app and enjoy real-time chatting with each other together just like having a face-to-face chat!
*Create private communities for games or clubs:
Want to have a secret squad? Use Walkie Talkie to speak and play as a team. Use your team name as the Walkie Talkie channel name, and ask your friends to join. This channel is totally yours. No one would interrupt unless you invite them. Team up and this is for the squad only!
*Explore more possibilities of Walkie Talkie:
It could be your communicator just like Discord when you play games like PUBG or Rules of Survival in a squad;
It could be your voice meeting room just like zoom when you need to discuss something with our friends;
It could be your chat room just like Skype when you need to voice group chat with others;
It could even be your study lounge with study mates, your own radio station, your audio live stream channel, your online band music space...
We always aim at eliminating boundaries of distances and get people connected to the world.
Just talk now. Start to experience the new way of chats with one click.
Privacy Policy: https://walkietalkie.live/policy.html
Terms of Use: https://walkietalkie.live/term.html

bluejetty:00087869:ios.description:
Embark on an epic journey in Avalar, an immersive Action RPG set in a fantastical world of medieval mystique. Dive into fast-paced combat, where strategic thinking meets adrenaline-pumping action. Assemble your own team, each with unique abilities and skills, to take on the challenges within the dungeon's depths.
RAID THE DUNGEON:
Engage in heart-pounding battles as you venture through mysterious dungeons teeming with mythical creatures and ancient secrets. Navigate intricate mazes, overcome traps, and confront hordes of enemies. Your combat skills will be put to the test in this dynamic and engaging experience.
CREATE YOUR OWN TEAM:
Set your team from a diverse roster of characters, each with their own abilities and elemental power. Build the ultimate team by strategically selecting characters that complement each other. Unleash powerful combos and synergies to overcome even the toughest adversaries.
DEFEAT INSANE BOSSES:
Challenge colossal bosses that guard the treasures hidden within the depths of Avalar. These mythical creatures will test your team's mettle and strategy. Adapt your tactics, exploit weaknesses, and emerge victorious to claim legendary rewards.
COLLECT THE CHARACTERS:
Discover a vast array of characters, from valiant knights and mystical mages to cunning rogues and enigmatic creatures. Unlock and collect these characters to diversify your team and uncover the rich lore of Avalar.
UPGRADE THE STRENGTH:
Forge your heroes into formidable champions by upgrading their skills, talents, and equipment. Enhance your team's strength to face increasingly challenging foes as you progress through the game. Equip the mythical weapon to match your character and dominate the battlefield.
Avalar awaits, and only the bravest will prevail. Are you ready to Raid the Dungeon and become a legend in this thrilling fantasy adventure? Download now and embark on an epic quest in a world where danger and glory go hand in hand!

bluejetty:00016301:ios.summary:
You have a naughty dog? Forget about expensive dog training classes! Here comes the best handy Dog Whistle app that will help you for sure.
Normally, a dog whistle is within the range of 16000 Hz to 40000 Hz with only the frequencies below
bluejetty:00016301:ios.description:
You have a naughty dog? Forget about expensive dog training classes! Here comes the best handy Dog Whistle app that will help you for sure.
Normally, a dog whistle is within the range of 16000 Hz to 40000 Hz with only the frequencies below 20000 Hz audible to the human ear. Our whistle has adjustable sliders for active control of the frequency produced.These kind of whistles are also used to determine the hearing range of people or for physics demonstrations.
*Use this new "leash" at a distance and never miss your friend!*
Everyone knows the situation: a dog runs out into the street, you want to call him. Traffic noise is, however, stronger than your voice and the dog does not respond. In that situation only a dog whistle can help, because the dog can discern it from all the other sounds.
Features:
-Variable frequency tone generator
- Dog Clicker to help you train your dog
- Express emotions with different dog sounds
- Play with your dog with Human to Bark Simulator
- Collection of Dog sounds
-Saved Settings Bar
How to communicate with your dog?
There are two modes available:
-Manual: Touch the screen to play the dog whistle training up sound and move your finger to stop it
-Continuous: Touch the screen to play the sound and touch again to stop it
How to train your dog?
Here are some useful puppy training tips you should use. The first step in dog whistle training process is to select series of commands that will be used as signals. For example: two short whistle sounds could mean the command "stop", or one long whistle sound to command "sit". To help you teach the dog, combine verbal commands with the whistle commands. So for the command "sit", give the verbal command accompanied with a dog whistle noise to connect the verbal command with a whistle sound. Applying this and other commands to the dog, you will make the understanding of whistle sounds easier.
TRAINING INSTRUCTIONS:
 - Pick a frequency for positive response. Then use it the times when your pet does something right. We suggest a low frequency because they are more pleasant for pets' ears. - Pick a higher frequency for wrong response. Use it at times when your pet does something wrong.
 - You may also pick a frequency to call your pet. Use highest frequency since higher frequencies reach further.
positive response 12000Hz, short sound, wrong response 15000Hz, short sound call 18000Hz, about 1sec.
Subscription Information :
Dog Whistle offers an auto-renewing yearly subscription Whistle Yearly Premium at $19.99 USD/year and Whistle Weekly Premium $6.99/week to provide you with unlimited access to all features, No Ads and premium features while you maintain an active subscription.
Payment will be charged to the payment method connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase.

apple-macos:6449238261.description:
Procrastination, distractions, and an endless to-do list that never seems to get done?
PomoFocus integrates the Pomodoro Timer, To-Do List, and Time Management into one powerful app. It helps you get into the zone faster and effortlessly complete your most important tasks.
Whether you are a student preparing for exams, a professional handling daily work, or someone looking to beat procrastination, PomoFocus turns your "to-dos" into "done."
Why Choose PomoFocus?
Most productivity tools only track tasks OR time. PomoFocus combines them, seamlessly taking you from planning to execution.
Key Features:
Pomodoro Focus Timer
Set your focus and break intervals to minimize distractions and easily enter a state of deep flow.
Daily To-Do List
Quickly capture today's tasks, prioritize what matters, and never lose track of your goals.
Visual Time Planning
Schedule tasks directly onto a visual timeline. See your day at a glance to reduce chaos and procrastination.
Focus Statistics
Track your focus sessions, completion rates, and efficiency trends to continuously optimize your time.
Home Screen Widgets
View your tasks and focus status instantly from your home screen to stay on track.
Perfect For:
Studying & Exams
Ideal for exam prep, self-study, and homework to maintain laser-sharp focus.
Work & Productivity
Manage daily tasks, prioritize projects, and boost your execution efficiency.
Personal Growth
Build self-discipline, overcome procrastination, and manage long-term goals.
How to use PomoFocus:
